package com.skatesuv.eskate

/**
 * Parser preparado para el protocolo BMS ya estudiado.
 * Aún no está conectado a un transporte Bluetooth real.
 */
object BmsProtocol {
    private const val START = 0xDD
    private const val READ = 0xA5
    private const val END = 0x77

    fun buildReadCommand(command: Int): ByteArray {
        val checksum = (-(command)) and 0xFFFF
        return byteArrayOf(
            START.toByte(), READ.toByte(), command.toByte(), 0x00,
            ((checksum shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte(),
            (checksum and 0xFF).toByte(), END.toByte()
        )
    }

    fun basicInfoRequest(): ByteArray = buildReadCommand(0x03)
    fun cellVoltagesRequest(): ByteArray = buildReadCommand(0x04)
    fun hardwareVersionRequest(): ByteArray = buildReadCommand(0x05)

    data class BasicInfo(
        val totalVoltageV: Double,
        val currentA: Double,
        val remainingAh: Double,
        val nominalAh: Double,
        val cycles: Int,
        val protectionBits: Int,
        val softwareVersionRaw: Int,
        val soc: Int,
        val fetStatus: Int,
        val seriesCount: Int,
        val temperaturesC: List<Double>
    )

    fun parseBasicInfo(frame: ByteArray): BasicInfo {
        require(frame.size >= 7 && (frame[0].toInt() and 0xFF) == START && (frame.last().toInt() and 0xFF) == END)
        val status = frame[2].toInt() and 0xFF
        require(status == 0x00) { "BMS status error: $status" }
        val len = frame[3].toInt() and 0xFF
        require(frame.size >= 4 + len + 3)
        val data = frame.copyOfRange(4, 4 + len)
        fun u16(i: Int) = ((data[i].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (data[i + 1].toInt() and 0xFF)
        fun s16(i: Int): Int { val v = u16(i); return if (v and 0x8000 != 0) v - 0x10000 else v }
        val ntcCount = data[22].toInt() and 0xFF
        val temps = (0 until ntcCount).map { n -> u16(23 + n * 2) / 10.0 - 273.1 }
        return BasicInfo(
            totalVoltageV = u16(0) / 100.0,
            currentA = s16(2) / 100.0,
            remainingAh = u16(4) / 100.0,
            nominalAh = u16(6) / 100.0,
            cycles = u16(8),
            protectionBits = u16(16),
            softwareVersionRaw = data[18].toInt() and 0xFF,
            soc = data[19].toInt() and 0xFF,
            fetStatus = data[20].toInt() and 0xFF,
            seriesCount = data[21].toInt() and 0xFF,
            temperaturesC = temps
        )
    }

    fun parseCellVoltages(frame: ByteArray): List<Double> {
        require(frame.size >= 7)
        val len = frame[3].toInt() and 0xFF
        require(len % 2 == 0)
        val data = frame.copyOfRange(4, 4 + len)
        return data.toList().chunked(2).map { pair ->
            val mv = ((pair[0].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (pair[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
            mv / 1000.0
        }
    }
}

private const val MAX_ROUTE_PHOTOS = 6

private fun saveRoutePhoto(context: Context, bitmap: Bitmap, position: GpsPoint?, altitudeMeters: Double?, routeId: Long? = null): Boolean {
    val dir = File(context.filesDir, "route_photos").apply { mkdirs() }
    if (routeId != null) {
        // Count both new photos explicitly tagged with this route and legacy photos
        // whose timestamp falls inside the route window, matching History's loader.
        val routeEndMs = loadTelemetryRoutes(context)
            .firstOrNull { it.id == routeId }
            ?.samples
            ?.lastOrNull()
            ?.recordedAtMs
            ?: System.currentTimeMillis()
        val existing = loadRoutePhotos(context, routeId, routeEndMs).size
        if (existing >= MAX_ROUTE_PHOTOS) return false
    }
    val takenAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
    val photo = File(dir, "route_$takenAt.jpg")
    photo.outputStream().use { bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 92, it) }
    val metadata = JSONObject().apply {
        put("takenAtMs", takenAt)
        routeId?.let { put("routeId", it) }
        if (position != null) { put("latitude", position.latitude); put("longitude", position.longitude) }
        if (altitudeMeters != null) put("altitudeMeters", altitudeMeters)
        put("file", photo.name)
    }
    File(dir, "route_$takenAt.json").writeText(metadata.toString())
    return true
}

private data class RoutePhoto(val file: File, val takenAtMs: Long)

private fun loadRoutePhotos(context: Context, routeId: Long, routeEndMs: Long): List<RoutePhoto> {
    val dir = File(context.filesDir, "route_photos")
    if (!dir.exists()) return emptyList()
    return dir.listFiles { file -> file.extension == "json" }?.mapNotNull { meta ->
        runCatching {
            val json = JSONObject(meta.readText())
            val takenAt = json.optLong("takenAtMs")
            val explicitRouteId = if (json.has("routeId")) json.optLong("routeId") else null
            val belongs = explicitRouteId == routeId || (explicitRouteId == null && takenAt in routeId..routeEndMs)
            if (!belongs) return@runCatching null
            val image = File(dir, json.optString("file"))
            if (image.exists()) RoutePhoto(image, takenAt) else null
        }.getOrNull()
    }?.filterNotNull()?.sortedBy { it.takenAtMs }.orEmpty()
}

private enum class TelemetryMetric(val label: String, val unit: String, val accent: Color) {
    POWER("Potencia", "W", Cyan),
    VOLTAGE("Voltaje", "V", Color(0xFF58A6FF)),
    CURRENT("Corriente", "A", Orange),
    SPEED("Velocidad", "km/h", Color(0xFFB7A6FF)),
    BMS_TEMP("Temp. BMS", "°C", Yellow),
    CELL_TEMP("Temp. celdas", "°C", Green),
    BATTERY("Batería", "%", Cyan),
    CAPACITY("Capacidad", "Ah", Color(0xFF72E0FF)),
    CELL_DELTA("Δ celdas", "mV", Red)
}

private fun TelemetrySample.metricValue(metric: TelemetryMetric): Double = when (metric) {
    TelemetryMetric.POWER -> powerW
    TelemetryMetric.VOLTAGE -> voltage
    TelemetryMetric.CURRENT -> currentA
    TelemetryMetric.SPEED -> speedKmh
    TelemetryMetric.BMS_TEMP -> temperatureBms
    TelemetryMetric.CELL_TEMP -> temperatureCells
    TelemetryMetric.BATTERY -> soc.toDouble()
    TelemetryMetric.CAPACITY -> remainingAh
    TelemetryMetric.CELL_DELTA -> {
        val minimum = cells.minOrNull()
        val maximum = cells.maxOrNull()
        if (minimum == null || maximum == null) 0.0 else (maximum - minimum) * 1000.0
    }
}

private fun telemetryRouteGpx(route: TelemetryRoute): String? {
    val gps = route.samples.filter { it.latitude != null && it.longitude != null }
    if (gps.isEmpty()) return null
    val points = gps.joinToString("\n") { sample ->
        val ele = sample.altitudeMeters?.let { "<ele>${format1(it)}</ele>" }.orEmpty()
        val time = java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'", Locale.US).apply {
            timeZone = java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
        }.format(java.util.Date(sample.recordedAtMs))
        """<trkpt lat="${sample.latitude}" lon="${sample.longitude}">${ele}<time>${time}</time></trkpt>"""
    }
    return """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx version="1.1" creator="E-SKATE" xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1"><trk><name>E-SKATE ${route.id}</name><trkseg>
${points}
</trkseg></trk></gpx>"""
}

private fun exportTelemetryRouteGpx(context: Context, route: TelemetryRoute): File? {
    val gpx = telemetryRouteGpx(route) ?: return null
    return runCatching {
        val dir = File(context.filesDir, "exports").apply { mkdirs() }
        File(dir, "E-SKATE_${route.id}.gpx").apply { writeText(gpx) }
    }.getOrNull()
}

private fun shareTelemetryRouteGpx(context: Context, route: TelemetryRoute): Boolean {
    val file = exportTelemetryRouteGpx(context, route) ?: return false
    return runCatching {
        val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.fileprovider", file)
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
            type = "application/gpx+xml"
            putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri)
            addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
        }
        context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(intent, "Compartir ruta GPX"))
        true
    }.getOrDefault(false)
}

@Composable
private fun MapLibreRouteOverview(routePoints: List<GpsPoint>) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val mapView = remember(context) {
        MapLibre.getInstance(context)
        MapView(context).apply { onCreate(null) }
    }
    DisposableEffect(mapView) {
        mapView.onStart(); mapView.onResume()
        onDispose { mapView.onPause(); mapView.onStop(); mapView.onDestroy() }
    }
    AndroidView(
        factory = {
            mapView.apply {
                getMapAsync { map ->
                    map.uiSettings.isCompassEnabled = false
                    map.setStyle(Style.Builder().fromJson(ESKATE_SATELLITE_STYLE)) {
                        if (routePoints.size > 1) {
                            map.addPolyline(
                                PolylineOptions()
                                    .addAll(routePoints.map { LatLng(it.latitude, it.longitude) })
                                    .color(android.graphics.Color.rgb(19, 207, 255))
                                    .width(8f)
                            )
                            val first = routePoints.first()
                            val last = routePoints.last()
                            map.addMarker(MarkerOptions().position(LatLng(first.latitude, first.longitude)).title("Inicio"))
                            map.addMarker(MarkerOptions().position(LatLng(last.latitude, last.longitude)).title("Fin"))
                            val bounds = LatLngBounds.Builder().apply {
                                routePoints.forEach { point ->
                                    include(LatLng(point.latitude, point.longitude))
                                }
                            }.build()
                            // History overview only: fit the complete recorded track to the
                            // real map viewport instead of estimating zoom from degree span.
                            // Equal padding keeps the route visually centred on every screen.
                            map.moveCamera(
                                CameraUpdateFactory.newLatLngBounds(bounds, 46)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
    )
}

private fun deleteTelemetryRoute(context: Context, routeId: Long): Boolean {
    return try {
        val telemetryFile = File(File(context.filesDir, "telemetry"), "route_${routeId}.jsonl")
        if (telemetryFile.exists() && !telemetryFile.delete()) return false

        // Route deletion is complete: remove its photos/metadata and per-route History state too.
        val photoDir = File(context.filesDir, "route_photos")
        photoDir.listFiles { file -> file.extension == "json" }?.forEach { meta ->
            runCatching {
                val json = JSONObject(meta.readText())
                if (json.optLong("routeId", Long.MIN_VALUE) == routeId) {
                    val image = File(photoDir, json.optString("file"))
                    if (image.exists()) image.delete()
                    meta.delete()
                }
            }
        }
        context.getSharedPreferences("eskate_history", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .remove("favorite_$routeId")
            .remove("note_$routeId")
            .apply()
        true
    } catch (_: Exception) { false }
}

private fun loadTelemetryRoutes(context: Context): List<TelemetryRoute> {
    return try {
        val directory = java.io.File(context.filesDir, "telemetry")
        if (!directory.exists()) return emptyList()
        directory.listFiles { file -> file.name.startsWith("route_") && file.extension == "jsonl" }
            ?.sortedByDescending { it.nameWithoutExtension.removePrefix("route_").toLongOrNull() ?: 0L }
            ?.take(20)
            ?.mapNotNull { file ->
                val id = file.nameWithoutExtension.removePrefix("route_").toLongOrNull()
                    ?: return@mapNotNull null
                val samples = file.useLines { lines ->
                    lines.mapNotNull { line ->
                        try {
                            JSONObject(line).toTelemetrySample()
                        } catch (_: Exception) {
                            null
                        }
                    }.toList()
                }
                TelemetryRoute(id, samples)
            }
            ?.filter { it.samples.isNotEmpty() }
            .orEmpty()
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        emptyList()
    }
}

private data class BmsTelemetry(
    val voltage: Double? = null,
    val currentA: Double? = null,
    val remainingAh: Double? = null,
    val nominalAh: Double? = null,
    val cycles: Int? = null,
    val soc: Int? = null,
    val cellCount: Int? = null,
    val temperatures: List<Double>? = null,
    val cells: List<Double>? = null,
    val protectionStatus: Int? = null,
    val balancing: Boolean? = null,
    val charging: Boolean? = null,
    val chargeMosEnabled: Boolean? = null,
    val dischargeMosEnabled: Boolean? = null
)

private class BluetoothGattController(
    private val context: Context,
    private val onStatus: (connected: Boolean, address: String?, message: String) -> Unit,
    private val onTelemetry: (BmsTelemetry) -> Unit
) {
    private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var activeGatt: BluetoothGatt? = null
    private var writeCharacteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic? = null
    private var notifyCharacteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic? = null
    private val receiveBuffer = mutableListOf<Byte>()
    private var connectedAddress: String? = null

    private val pollRunnable = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            if (activeGatt != null && writeCharacteristic != null) {
                sendRead(0x03)
                mainHandler.postDelayed({ sendRead(0x04) }, 300L)
                mainHandler.postDelayed(this, 1600L)
            }
        }
    }

    fun connect(address: String, name: String) {
        try {
            close()
            val manager = context.getSystemService(Context.BLUETOOTH_SERVICE) as BluetoothManager
            val device = manager.adapter?.getRemoteDevice(address)
            if (device == null) {
                onStatus(false, null, "No se pudo localizar el dispositivo")
                return
            }
            connectedAddress = address
            onStatus(false, address, "Conectando con $name…")
            activeGatt = device.connectGatt(
                context,
                false,
                object : BluetoothGattCallback() {
                    override fun onConnectionStateChange(gatt: BluetoothGatt, status: Int, newState: Int) {
                        mainHandler.post {
                            when {
                                status == BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS && newState == BluetoothProfile.STATE_CONNECTED -> {
                                    activeGatt = gatt
                                    connectedAddress = address
                                    onStatus(true, address, "Bluetooth conectado · preparando BMS…")
                                    try {
                                        gatt.discoverServices()
                                    } catch (_: SecurityException) {
                                        onStatus(false, address, "Permiso Bluetooth necesario")
                                    }
                                }
                                newState == BluetoothProfile.STATE_DISCONNECTED -> {
                                    stopPolling()
                                    if (activeGatt === gatt) activeGatt = null
                                    writeCharacteristic = null
                                    notifyCharacteristic = null
                                    receiveBuffer.clear()
                                    try { gatt.close() } catch (_: Exception) {}
                                    onStatus(false, null, "Conexión finalizada")
                                }
                                else -> onStatus(false, address, "No se pudo conectar con $name")
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    override fun onServicesDiscovered(gatt: BluetoothGatt, status: Int) {
                        mainHandler.post {
                            if (status != BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) {
                                onStatus(false, address, "No se pudieron leer los servicios del BMS")
                                return@post
                            }
                            val characteristics = gatt.services.flatMap { it.characteristics }
                            val preferredNotify = characteristics.firstOrNull {
                                uuidEndsWith(it.uuid, "ff01") && supportsNotify(it)
                            }
                            val preferredWrite = characteristics.firstOrNull {
                                uuidEndsWith(it.uuid, "ff02") && supportsWrite(it)
                            }
                            notifyCharacteristic = preferredNotify ?: characteristics.firstOrNull(::supportsNotify)
                            writeCharacteristic = preferredWrite
                                ?: characteristics.firstOrNull {
                                    it !== notifyCharacteristic && supportsWrite(it)
                                }
                                ?: notifyCharacteristic?.takeIf(::supportsWrite)

                            val notify = notifyCharacteristic
                            if (notify == null || writeCharacteristic == null) {
                                onStatus(false, address, "El dispositivo no ofrece el canal UART JBD")
                                return@post
                            }
                            try {
                                gatt.setCharacteristicNotification(notify, true)
                                val cccd = notify.getDescriptor(CCCD_UUID)
                                if (cccd != null) {
                                    cccd.value = if (
                                        notify.properties and BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_INDICATE != 0
                                    ) BluetoothGattDescriptor.ENABLE_INDICATION_VALUE
                                    else BluetoothGattDescriptor.ENABLE_NOTIFICATION_VALUE
                                    if (!gatt.writeDescriptor(cccd)) beginPolling(address)
                                } else {
                                    beginPolling(address)
                                }
                            } catch (_: SecurityException) {
                                onStatus(false, address, "Permiso Bluetooth necesario")
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    override fun onDescriptorWrite(gatt: BluetoothGatt, descriptor: BluetoothGattDescriptor, status: Int) {
                        mainHandler.post {
                            if (descriptor.uuid == CCCD_UUID && status == BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) {
                                beginPolling(address)
                            } else if (descriptor.uuid == CCCD_UUID) {
                                onStatus(false, address, "No se pudieron activar los datos del BMS")
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    @Deprecated("Compatibilidad con Android 12 y anteriores")
                    override fun onCharacteristicChanged(gatt: BluetoothGatt, characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic) {
                        characteristic.value?.let(::consumeBytes)
                    }

                    override fun onCharacteristicChanged(
                        gatt: BluetoothGatt,
                        characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic,
                        value: ByteArray
                    ) {
                        consumeBytes(value)
                    }
                },
                BluetoothDevice.TRANSPORT_LE
            )
        } catch (_: SecurityException) {
            onStatus(false, null, "Permiso Bluetooth necesario")
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            onStatus(false, null, "No se pudo conectar con $name")
        }
    }

    fun setPower(enabled: Boolean) {
        // JBD V12 switch control (0xFB): category 0x00 controls DISCHARGE only.
        // state 0x00 = discharge ON/open, 0x01 = discharge OFF/closed.
        // Charging MOS is intentionally left untouched.
        stopPolling()
        sendCommand(0xFB, byteArrayOf(0x00, if (enabled) 0x00 else 0x01))
        mainHandler.postDelayed({ sendRead(0x03) }, 350L)
        mainHandler.postDelayed({ sendRead(0x03) }, 900L)
        mainHandler.postDelayed(pollRunnable, 1500L)
    }

    private fun beginPolling(address: String) {
        stopPolling()
        onStatus(true, address, "BMS JBD conectado · recibiendo datos")
        // El BMS puede estar dormido y omitir la primera trama; enviamos una activación previa.
        sendRead(0x03)
        mainHandler.postDelayed(pollRunnable, 450L)
    }

    private fun stopPolling() {
        mainHandler.removeCallbacks(pollRunnable)
    }

    private fun sendRead(command: Int) {
        sendCommand(command, byteArrayOf(), read = true)
    }

    private fun sendCommand(command: Int, payload: ByteArray, read: Boolean = false) {
        val gatt = activeGatt ?: return
        val characteristic = writeCharacteristic ?: return
        val frame = buildFrame(command, payload, read)
        try {
            characteristic.writeType =
                if (characteristic.properties and BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_WRITE_NO_RESPONSE != 0)
                    BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_NO_RESPONSE
                else BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT
            characteristic.value = frame
            gatt.writeCharacteristic(characteristic)
        } catch (_: SecurityException) {
            onStatus(false, connectedAddress, "Permiso Bluetooth necesario")
        }
    }

    private fun buildFrame(command: Int, payload: ByteArray, read: Boolean): ByteArray {
        val length = payload.size
        var sum = command + length
        payload.forEach { sum += it.toInt() and 0xFF }
        val checksum = (-sum) and 0xFFFF
        return byteArrayOf(
            0xDD.toByte(),
            if (read) 0xA5.toByte() else 0x5A.toByte(),
            command.toByte(),
            length.toByte(),
            *payload,
            (checksum shr 8).toByte(),
            checksum.toByte(),
            0x77
        )
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun consumeBytes(bytes: ByteArray) {
        receiveBuffer.addAll(bytes.toList())
        while (true) {
            val start = receiveBuffer.indexOfFirst { (it.toInt() and 0xFF) == 0xDD }
            if (start < 0) {
                receiveBuffer.clear()
                return
            }
            repeat(start) { receiveBuffer.removeAt(0) }
            if (receiveBuffer.size < 4) return
            val dataLength = receiveBuffer[3].toInt() and 0xFF
            val frameLength = dataLength + 7
            if (receiveBuffer.size < frameLength) return
            val frame = ByteArray(frameLength) { receiveBuffer.removeAt(0) }
            if ((frame.last().toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x77) parseFrame(frame)
        }
    }

    private fun parseFrame(frame: ByteArray) {
        val command = frame[1].toInt() and 0xFF
        val status = frame[2].toInt() and 0xFF
        val length = frame[3].toInt() and 0xFF
        if (status != 0 || frame.size != length + 7) return
        val data = frame.copyOfRange(4, 4 + length)
        val telemetry = when (command) {
            0x03 -> parseBasicInfo(data)
            0x04 -> parseCellVoltages(data)
            else -> null
        }
        if (telemetry != null) mainHandler.post { onTelemetry(telemetry) }
    }

    private fun parseBasicInfo(data: ByteArray): BmsTelemetry? {
        if (data.size < 23) return null
        val voltage = u16(data, 0) / 100.0
        val currentRaw = u16(data, 2)
        val signedCurrent = if (currentRaw and 0x8000 != 0) currentRaw - 0x10000 else currentRaw
        val remainingAh = u16(data, 4) / 100.0
        val nominalAh = u16(data, 6) / 100.0
        val cycles = u16(data, 8)
        val balanceLow = u16(data, 12).toLong()
        val balanceHigh = u16(data, 14).toLong()
        val protection = u16(data, 16)
        val soc = data[19].toInt() and 0xFF
        val fet = data[20].toInt() and 0xFF
        val cellCount = data[21].toInt() and 0xFF
        val ntcCount = data[22].toInt() and 0xFF
        val temperatures = (0 until ntcCount)
            .mapNotNull { index ->
                val offset = 23 + index * 2
                if (offset + 1 < data.size) (u16(data, offset) - 2731) / 10.0 else null
            }
        return BmsTelemetry(
            voltage = voltage,
            currentA = signedCurrent / 100.0,
            remainingAh = remainingAh,
            nominalAh = nominalAh,
            cycles = cycles,
            soc = soc.coerceIn(0, 100),
            cellCount = cellCount,
            temperatures = temperatures,
            protectionStatus = protection,
            balancing = balanceLow != 0L || balanceHigh != 0L,
            charging = signedCurrent > 5,
            // JBD basic-info FET byte: bit 0 = charge MOS, bit 1 = discharge MOS.
            // These are BMS-confirmed states, not button-request states.
            chargeMosEnabled = fet and 0x01 != 0,
            dischargeMosEnabled = fet and 0x02 != 0
        )
    }

    private fun parseCellVoltages(data: ByteArray): BmsTelemetry? {
        if (data.size < 2 || data.size % 2 != 0) return null
        return BmsTelemetry(
            cells = data.indices.step(2).map { u16(data, it) / 1000.0 }
        )
    }

    private fun u16(data: ByteArray, offset: Int): Int =
        ((data[offset].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (data[offset + 1].toInt() and 0xFF)

    fun close() {
        stopPolling()
        try {
            activeGatt?.disconnect()
            activeGatt?.close()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
        activeGatt = null
        writeCharacteristic = null
        notifyCharacteristic = null
        receiveBuffer.clear()
        connectedAddress = null
    }

    companion object {
        private val CCCD_UUID: UUID = UUID.fromString("00002902-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb")

        private fun uuidEndsWith(uuid: UUID, short: String): Boolean =
            uuid.toString().lowercase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith("0000$short-")

        private fun supportsNotify(characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic): Boolean =
            characteristic.properties and (
                BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_NOTIFY or
                    BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_INDICATE
                ) != 0

        private fun supportsWrite(characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic): Boolean =
            characteristic.properties and (
                BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_WRITE or
                    BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_WRITE_NO_RESPONSE
                ) != 0
    }
}


private class LightGattController(
    private val context: Context,
    private val onStatus: (connected: Boolean, address: String?, message: String) -> Unit
) {
    private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var activeGatt: BluetoothGatt? = null
    private var writeCharacteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic? = null
    private var connectedAddress: String? = null

    fun connect(address: String, name: String) {
        try {
            close()
            val manager = context.getSystemService(Context.BLUETOOTH_SERVICE) as BluetoothManager
            val device = manager.adapter?.getRemoteDevice(address)
            if (device == null) {
                onStatus(false, null, "No se pudo localizar el controlador")
                return
            }
            connectedAddress = address
            onStatus(false, address, "Conectando con $name…")
            activeGatt = device.connectGatt(
                context,
                false,
                object : BluetoothGattCallback() {
                    override fun onConnectionStateChange(gatt: BluetoothGatt, status: Int, newState: Int) {
                        mainHandler.post {
                            if (status == BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS && newState == BluetoothProfile.STATE_CONNECTED) {
                                activeGatt = gatt
                                onStatus(false, address, "Detectando controlador de luces…")
                                try { gatt.discoverServices() } catch (_: SecurityException) {
                                    onStatus(false, address, "Permiso Bluetooth necesario")
                                }
                            } else if (newState == BluetoothProfile.STATE_DISCONNECTED) {
                                if (activeGatt === gatt) activeGatt = null
                                writeCharacteristic = null
                                try { gatt.close() } catch (_: Exception) {}
                                onStatus(false, null, "Luces desconectadas")
                            } else {
                                onStatus(false, address, "No se pudo conectar con $name")
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    override fun onServicesDiscovered(gatt: BluetoothGatt, status: Int) {
                        mainHandler.post {
                            if (status != BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) {
                                onStatus(false, address, "No se pudo leer el controlador")
                                return@post
                            }
                            val characteristics = gatt.services.flatMap { it.characteristics }
                            writeCharacteristic = characteristics.firstOrNull {
                                it.uuid.toString().lowercase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith("0000fff3-") && supportsWrite(it)
                            } ?: characteristics.firstOrNull(::supportsWrite)
                            if (writeCharacteristic == null) {
                                onStatus(false, address, "Controlador no compatible")
                            } else {
                                onStatus(true, address, "Luces conectadas")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                BluetoothDevice.TRANSPORT_LE
            )
        } catch (_: SecurityException) {
            onStatus(false, null, "Permiso Bluetooth necesario")
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            onStatus(false, null, "No se pudo conectar con $name")
        }
    }

    fun setPower(enabled: Boolean) {
        write(
            if (enabled) byteArrayOf(0x7E, 0x00, 0x04, 0xF0.toByte(), 0x00, 0x01, 0xFF.toByte(), 0x00, 0xEF.toByte())
            else byteArrayOf(0x7E, 0x00, 0x04, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xFF.toByte(), 0x00, 0xEF.toByte())
        )
    }

    fun setColor(color: Color) {
        val argb = color.toArgb()
        write(byteArrayOf(
            0x7E, 0x00, 0x05, 0x03,
            ((argb shr 16) and 0xFF).toByte(),
            ((argb shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte(),
            (argb and 0xFF).toByte(),
            0x00, 0xEF.toByte()
        ))
    }

    fun setBrightness(value: Float) {
        val level = (value.coerceIn(.08f, 1f) * 255f).roundToInt()
        write(byteArrayOf(0x7E, 0x00, 0x01, level.toByte(), 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xEF.toByte()))
    }

    private fun write(bytes: ByteArray) {
        val gatt = activeGatt ?: return
        val characteristic = writeCharacteristic ?: return
        try {
            characteristic.writeType =
                if (characteristic.properties and BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_WRITE_NO_RESPONSE != 0)
                    BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_NO_RESPONSE
                else BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT
            characteristic.value = bytes
            gatt.writeCharacteristic(characteristic)
        } catch (_: SecurityException) {
            onStatus(false, connectedAddress, "Permiso Bluetooth necesario")
        }
    }

    fun close() {
        try {
            activeGatt?.disconnect()
            activeGatt?.close()
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
        activeGatt = null
        writeCharacteristic = null
        connectedAddress = null
    }

    companion object {
        private fun supportsWrite(characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic): Boolean =
            characteristic.properties and (
                BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_WRITE or
                    BluetoothGattCharacteristic.PROPERTY_WRITE_NO_RESPONSE
                ) != 0
    }
}

private fun decodeJbdProtectionAlerts(
    status: Int,
    temperatures: List<Double>
): List<String> {
    val maximumTemperature = temperatures.maxOrNull()
    val minimumTemperature = temperatures.minOrNull()
    fun temperatureDetail(base: String, value: Double?): String =
        if (value == null) base else "$base (${format1(value)} °C)"

    val alerts = mutableListOf<String>()
    if (status and (1 shl 0) != 0) alerts += "Sobretensión en una celda"
    if (status and (1 shl 1) != 0) alerts += "Subtensión en una celda"
    if (status and (1 shl 2) != 0) alerts += "Sobretensión del pack de batería"
    if (status and (1 shl 3) != 0) alerts += "Subtensión del pack de batería"
    if (status and (1 shl 4) != 0) alerts += temperatureDetail("Temperatura alta durante la carga", maximumTemperature)
    if (status and (1 shl 5) != 0) alerts += temperatureDetail("Temperatura baja durante la carga", minimumTemperature)
    if (status and (1 shl 6) != 0) alerts += temperatureDetail("Temperatura alta durante la descarga", maximumTemperature)
    if (status and (1 shl 7) != 0) alerts += temperatureDetail("Temperatura baja durante la descarga", minimumTemperature)
    if (status and (1 shl 8) != 0) alerts += "Sobrecorriente durante la carga"
    if (status and (1 shl 9) != 0) alerts += "Sobrecorriente durante la descarga"
    if (status and (1 shl 10) != 0) alerts += "Cortocircuito detectado"
    if (status and (1 shl 11) != 0) alerts += "Fallo del circuito de control del BMS"
    if (status and (1 shl 12) != 0) alerts += "MOS bloqueado por software"
    if (status and 0xE000 != 0) alerts += "Protección adicional del BMS (código 0x${status.toString(16).uppercase()})"
    return alerts.distinct()
}

@Composable
private fun StartupStaticSplash(onFinished: () -> Unit) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val cover = remember(context) {
        runCatching {
            val encoded = (0..7).joinToString(separator = "") { index ->
                context.assets.open("static20_%02d.part".format(index))
                    .bufferedReader()
                    .use { it.readText() }
            }
            val bytes = Base64.decode(encoded, Base64.DEFAULT)
            BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.size)?.asImageBitmap()
        }.getOrNull()
    }

    var fadeOut by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val splashAlpha by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = if (fadeOut) 0f else 1f,
        animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 350),
        label = "startup-splash-fade"
    )

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        delay(2_650L)
        fadeOut = true
        delay(350L)
        onFinished()
    }

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(Color.Black)
            .graphicsLayer { alpha = splashAlpha },
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        cover?.let { bitmap ->
            Image(
                bitmap = bitmap,
                contentDescription = null,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
            )
        }
    }
}
