    var keepScreenOn by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    var appOrientation by remember { mutableStateOf(AppOrientation.AUTO) }
    var lightsConnected by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var lightsConnectedAddress by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var lightsTargetAddress by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var lightsConnectionStatus by remember { mutableStateOf("Luces sin vincular") }
    var lightsPowerOn by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var lightsBrightness by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(.85f) }
    var lightsColor by remember { mutableStateOf(Cyan) }
    var lightsBlinkEnabled by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var lightsBlinkSpeed by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(.45f) }

    val appContext = LocalContext.current
    var alertSettings by remember(appContext) { mutableStateOf(loadAlertSettings(appContext)) }
    fun updateAlertSettings(next: AlertSettings) {
        alertSettings = next
        saveAlertSettings(appContext, next)
    }
    val currentTelemetrySamples = remember { mutableStateListOf<TelemetrySample>() }
    val liveTelemetrySamples = remember { mutableStateListOf<TelemetrySample>() }
    val liveTelemetryStartMs = remember { android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() }
    var savedTelemetryRoutes by remember(appContext) {
        mutableStateOf(loadTelemetryRoutes(appContext))
    }
    var currentTelemetryRouteId by remember { mutableStateOf<Long?>(null) }
    var telemetryRouteStartDistanceKm by remember { mutableStateOf(0.0) }
    var routeRecordingActive by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var routeRecordingPaused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var routeRecordingStartSeconds by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }

    LaunchedEffect(keepScreenOn) {
        val window = (appContext as? ComponentActivity)?.window
        if (keepScreenOn) {
            window?.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON)
        } else {
            window?.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON)
        }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(appOrientation) {
        (appContext as? ComponentActivity)?.requestedOrientation = when (appOrientation) {
            AppOrientation.AUTO -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_UNSPECIFIED
            AppOrientation.PORTRAIT -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT
            AppOrientation.LANDSCAPE -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        }
    }

    var gpsPreviousPoint by remember { mutableStateOf<GpsPoint?>(null) }
    var gpsCurrentLatitude by remember { mutableStateOf<Double?>(null) }
    var gpsCurrentLongitude by remember { mutableStateOf<Double?>(null) }
    var gpsCurrentAltitudeMeters by remember { mutableStateOf<Double?>(null) }
    var gpsTripDistanceKm by remember { mutableStateOf(0.0) }
    var gpsTotalDistanceKm by remember { mutableStateOf(0.0) }
    var gpsMaximumSpeedKmh by remember { mutableStateOf(0.0) }
    var gpsInclinePercent by remember { mutableStateOf(0.0) }
    var inclineReferenceLocation by remember { mutableStateOf<Location?>(null) }

    // Autonomía adaptativa: aprende del consumo REAL mientras se circula.
    // Se calcula por bloques estables de marcha y se suaviza para evitar saltos absurdos.
    var rangeLearningEnergyWh by remember { mutableStateOf(0.0) }
    var rangeLearningSeconds by remember { mutableStateOf(0.0) }
    var rangeLearningStartDistanceKm by remember { mutableStateOf<Double?>(null) }
    var rangeSegmentEnergyWh by remember { mutableStateOf(0.0) }
    var rangeSegmentSeconds by remember { mutableStateOf(0.0) }
    var rangeSegmentStartDistanceKm by remember { mutableStateOf<Double?>(null) }
    var rangeLearnedWhKm by remember { mutableStateOf<Double?>(null) }
    var rangeDisplayedKm by remember { mutableStateOf<Double?>(null) }
    var lastBmsEnergySampleMs by remember { mutableStateOf<Long?>(null) }

    var connectedBluetoothAddress by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var targetBluetoothAddress by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var bluetoothConnectionStatus by remember { mutableStateOf("Sin conexión") }
    val bluetoothController = remember(appContext) {
        BluetoothGattController(
            context = appContext,
            onStatus = { connected, address, message ->
                bluetooth = connected
                bluetoothConnectionStatus = message
                targetBluetoothAddress = address
                connectedBluetoothAddress = if (connected) address else null
                if (connected) {
                    // Defined startup behavior: every fresh BMS connection starts with
                    // the discharge port requested ON and without a port alarm.
                    powerOn = true
                    dischargeUserRequestedOff = false
                    portStateAlertMessage = null
                } else {
                    lastBmsEnergySampleMs = null
                    rangeLearningEnergyWh = 0.0
                    rangeLearningSeconds = 0.0
                    rangeLearningStartDistanceKm = null
                    rangeSegmentEnergyWh = 0.0
                    rangeSegmentSeconds = 0.0
                    rangeSegmentStartDistanceKm = null
                    rangeLearnedWhKm = null
                    rangeDisplayedKm = null
                    chargePortOpen = null
                    dischargePortOpen = null
                    powerOn = false
                    demo = demo.copy(
                        voltage = 0.0,
                        currentA = 0.0,
                        powerW = 0,
                        remainingAh = 0.0,
                        nominalAh = 0.0,
                        cycles = 0,
                        soc = 0,
                        temperature = 0.0,
                        cellTemperature = 0.0,
                        cells = emptyList(),
                        hasAlarm = false,
                        activeAlerts = emptyList(),
                        charging = false,
                        balancing = false,
                        whKm = 0.0,
                        rangeKm = 0
                    )
                }
            },
            onTelemetry = { bms ->
                val nextVoltage = bms.voltage ?: demo.voltage
                val nextCurrent = bms.currentA ?: demo.currentA
                val nextRemainingAh = bms.remainingAh ?: demo.remainingAh
                val temperatures = bms.temperatures.orEmpty()
                val nextPowerW = kotlin.math.abs(nextVoltage * nextCurrent)

                var calculatedWhKm = demo.whKm
                var calculatedRangeKm = demo.rangeKm
                if (bms.currentA != null) {
                    val nowMs = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                    val previousSampleMs = lastBmsEnergySampleMs
                    lastBmsEnergySampleMs = nowMs
                    val sampleSeconds = previousSampleMs
                        ?.let { ((nowMs - it) / 1000.0).coerceIn(0.0, 5.0) }
                        ?: 0.0

                    // GPS lento o parado no sirve para aprender consumo por kilómetro.
                    // Tampoco se aprende durante carga/regeneración.
                    val movingAndDischarging = demo.speed >= 3 && nextCurrent < -0.3
                    if (movingAndDischarging && sampleSeconds > 0.0) {
                        if (rangeLearningStartDistanceKm == null) {
                            rangeLearningStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                        }
                        if (rangeSegmentStartDistanceKm == null) {
                            rangeSegmentStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                        }

                        val sampleWh = nextPowerW * sampleSeconds / 3600.0
                        rangeLearningEnergyWh += sampleWh
                        rangeLearningSeconds += sampleSeconds
                        rangeSegmentEnergyWh += sampleWh
                        rangeSegmentSeconds += sampleSeconds

                        val learnedDistanceKm = rangeLearningStartDistanceKm
                            ?.let { (gpsTripDistanceKm - it).coerceAtLeast(0.0) }
                            ?: 0.0
                        val segmentDistanceKm = rangeSegmentStartDistanceKm
                            ?.let { (gpsTripDistanceKm - it).coerceAtLeast(0.0) }
                            ?: 0.0

                        // Revisión aproximadamente cada minuto de marcha real.
                        // Exige también distancia suficiente para que un semáforo, una cuesta
                        // corta o un pico de aceleración no cambien la autonomía de golpe.
                        val segmentReady =
                            rangeSegmentSeconds >= 60.0 &&
                                segmentDistanceKm >= 0.15 &&
                                rangeSegmentEnergyWh > 0.0
                        val learningReady =
                            rangeLearningSeconds >= 180.0 &&
                                learnedDistanceKm >= 0.50 &&
                                rangeLearningEnergyWh > 0.0

                        if (segmentReady) {
                            if (learningReady) {
                                val sessionWhKm = (rangeLearningEnergyWh / learnedDistanceKm)
                                    .coerceIn(3.0, 120.0)
                                val rawSegmentWhKm = (rangeSegmentEnergyWh / segmentDistanceKm)
                                    .coerceIn(3.0, 120.0)

                                // La primera referencia usa toda la marcha acumulada.
                                // Después cada bloque nuevo pesa solo un 20 %, evitando bandazos.
                                val previousWhKm = rangeLearnedWhKm
                                val boundedSegmentWhKm = previousWhKm?.let { previous ->
                                    rawSegmentWhKm.coerceIn(previous * 0.55, previous * 1.65)
                                } ?: rawSegmentWhKm
                                val learnedWhKm = previousWhKm?.let { previous ->
                                    previous * 0.80 + boundedSegmentWhKm * 0.20
                                } ?: sessionWhKm
                                rangeLearnedWhKm = learnedWhKm
                                calculatedWhKm = learnedWhKm

                                // Para energía restante usamos tensión nominal del pack cuando
                                // conocemos el número de celdas. Así el sag instantáneo de tensión
                                // bajo aceleración no desploma los kilómetros mostrados.
                                val cellCount = bms.cellCount?.takeIf { it > 0 }
                                    ?: demo.cells.size.takeIf { it > 0 }
                                val referenceVoltage = cellCount
                                    ?.let { it * 3.6 }
                                    ?: nextVoltage
                                val remainingEnergyWh =
                                    (referenceVoltage * nextRemainingAh).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
                                val rawRangeKm = (remainingEnergyWh / learnedWhKm)
                                    .coerceIn(0.0, 999.0)

                                // Suavizado final del dato visible. Cada revisión solo puede mover
                                // la cifra aproximadamente 1 km respecto a la anterior.
                                val previousDisplayed = rangeDisplayedKm
                                val nextDisplayed = if (previousDisplayed == null) {
                                    rawRangeKm
                                } else {
                                    val softlyMoved =
                                        previousDisplayed + (rawRangeKm - previousDisplayed) * 0.25
                                    softlyMoved.coerceIn(
                                        previousDisplayed - 1.0,
                                        previousDisplayed + 1.0
                                    )
                                }.coerceIn(0.0, 999.0)

                                rangeDisplayedKm = nextDisplayed
                                calculatedRangeKm = nextDisplayed.roundToInt()
                            }

                            rangeSegmentEnergyWh = 0.0
                            rangeSegmentSeconds = 0.0
                            rangeSegmentStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                        }
                    }

                    if (rangeLearnedWhKm == null) {
                        calculatedWhKm = 0.0
                        calculatedRangeKm = 0
                    }
                }

                val decodedAlerts = bms.protectionStatus
                    ?.let { decodeJbdProtectionAlerts(it, temperatures) }
                    ?: demo.activeAlerts

                demo = demo.copy(
                    voltage = nextVoltage,
                    currentA = nextCurrent,
                    powerW = nextPowerW.roundToInt(),
                    remainingAh = nextRemainingAh,
                    nominalAh = bms.nominalAh ?: demo.nominalAh,
                    cycles = bms.cycles ?: demo.cycles,
                    soc = bms.soc ?: demo.soc,
                    temperature = temperatures.getOrNull(0) ?: demo.temperature,
                    cellTemperature = temperatures.getOrNull(1)
                        ?: temperatures.getOrNull(0)
                        ?: demo.cellTemperature,
                    cells = bms.cells ?: demo.cells,
                    hasAlarm = decodedAlerts.isNotEmpty(),
                    activeAlerts = decodedAlerts,
                    charging = bms.charging ?: demo.charging,
                    balancing = bms.balancing ?: demo.balancing,
                    whKm = calculatedWhKm,
                    rangeKm = calculatedRangeKm
                )

                val nextDischarge = bms.dischargeMosEnabled
                val nextCharge = bms.chargeMosEnabled
                if (nextDischarge != null || nextCharge != null) {
                    nextDischarge?.let { confirmed ->
                        if (!mosBaselineReady) {
                            // First valid MOS reading is never an alarm. By definition a
                            // fresh Bluetooth session wants DISCHARGE ON.
                            if (dischargeUserRequestedOff) {
                                dischargePortOpen = confirmed
                                powerOn = confirmed
                                portStateAlertMessage = if (confirmed) null else "Puerto de descarga apagado"
                            } else {
                                dischargePortOpen = true
                                powerOn = true
                                portStateAlertMessage = null
                                if (!confirmed) restoreDischargeOnRequested = true
                            }
                        } else if (!confirmed && !dischargeUserRequestedOff) {
                            // If the BMS reports discharge OFF without a user OFF request,
                            // restore the defined ON state silently instead of raising an alarm.
                            dischargePortOpen = true
                            powerOn = true
                            portStateAlertMessage = null
                            restoreDischargeOnRequested = true
                        } else {
                            val previous = dischargePortOpen
                            dischargePortOpen = confirmed
                            powerOn = confirmed
                            if (dischargeUserRequestedOff && !confirmed) {
                                portStateAlertMessage = "Puerto de descarga apagado"
                            } else if (confirmed) {
                                val wasOff = previous == false || portStateAlertMessage != null
                                portStateAlertMessage = null
                                dischargeUserRequestedOff = false
                                if (wasOff) {
                                    stateAlertMessage = "Puerto de descarga encendido"
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    nextCharge?.let { chargePortOpen = it }
                    mosBaselineReady = true
                }
            }
        )
    }
    DisposableEffect(bluetoothController) {
        onDispose { bluetoothController.close() }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(restoreDischargeOnRequested, bluetooth) {
        if (restoreDischargeOnRequested && bluetooth) {
            restoreDischargeOnRequested = false
            bluetoothController.setPower(true)
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(stateAlertMessage) {
        if (stateAlertMessage == "Puerto de descarga conectado") {
            delay(4000L)
            if (stateAlertMessage == "Puerto de descarga conectado") stateAlertMessage = null
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(bluetooth) {
        val previous = previousBluetoothState
        previousBluetoothState = bluetooth
        if (!bluetooth) {
            mosBaselineReady = false
            dischargeUserRequestedOff = false
            chargePortOpen = null
            dischargePortOpen = null
            portStateAlertMessage = null
        }
        if (previous == true && !bluetooth) {
            stateAlertMessage = "Bluetooth desconectado"
            delay(4000L)
            if (stateAlertMessage == "Bluetooth desconectado") stateAlertMessage = null
        }
    }

    var distanceAlertPulse by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var lastDistanceAlertBucket by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var distanceAlertWasEnabled by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    LaunchedEffect(gpsTripDistanceKm, alertSettings.distanceOn, alertSettings.distanceThreshold) {
        if (!alertSettings.distanceOn || alertSettings.distanceThreshold <= 0f) {
            lastDistanceAlertBucket = 0
            distanceAlertWasEnabled = false
            distanceAlertPulse = null
        } else {
            val threshold = alertSettings.distanceThreshold.toDouble()
            val bucket = kotlin.math.floor((gpsTripDistanceKm + 1e-6) / threshold).toInt()
            if (!distanceAlertWasEnabled) {
                lastDistanceAlertBucket = bucket
                distanceAlertWasEnabled = true
            } else if (bucket > lastDistanceAlertBucket && bucket > 0) {
                lastDistanceAlertBucket = bucket
                distanceAlertPulse = "Distancia: ${format1(bucket * threshold)} km"
                delay(4000L)
                distanceAlertPulse = null
            }
        }
    }

    var speedAlertPulse by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var speedAlertArmed by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    LaunchedEffect(demo.speed, alertSettings.speedOn, alertSettings.speedThreshold) {
        val limit = alertSettings.speedThreshold.coerceIn(15f, 50f)
        if (!alertSettings.speedOn) {
            speedAlertArmed = true
            speedAlertPulse = null
        } else {
            // Announce once when crossing upward. Re-arm only after dropping 3 km/h
            // below the chosen limit so GPS jitter cannot repeat the warning.
            if (speedAlertArmed && demo.speed >= limit) {
                speedAlertArmed = false
                speedAlertPulse = "Velocidad: has superado los ${limit.roundToInt()} kilómetros por hora"
                delay(4000L)
                speedAlertPulse = null
            } else if (!speedAlertArmed && demo.speed <= limit - 3f) {
                speedAlertArmed = true
            }
        }
    }

    var inclineAlertPulse by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var inclineAlertArmed by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    LaunchedEffect(gpsInclinePercent, alertSettings.inclineOn, alertSettings.inclineThreshold) {
        val limit = alertSettings.inclineThreshold.coerceIn(10f, 40f)
        val magnitude = kotlin.math.abs(gpsInclinePercent)
        if (!alertSettings.inclineOn) { inclineAlertArmed = true; inclineAlertPulse = null }
        else if (inclineAlertArmed && magnitude >= limit) {
            inclineAlertArmed = false
            val direction = if (gpsInclinePercent >= 0.0) "subida" else "bajada"
            inclineAlertPulse = "Pendiente: $direction del ${magnitude.roundToInt()} por ciento"
            delay(4000L); inclineAlertPulse = null
        } else if (!inclineAlertArmed && magnitude <= limit - 3f) inclineAlertArmed = true
    }

    var upcomingInclineAlertPulse by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var upcomingInclineAlertArmed by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    LaunchedEffect(mapNavigationActive, mapNavigationSession.currentPosition.value, mapNavigationSession.routeData.value, alertSettings.inclineOn, alertSettings.inclineThreshold) {
        val route = mapNavigationSession.routeData.value
        val position = mapNavigationSession.currentPosition.value
        if (!alertSettings.inclineOn || !mapNavigationActive || route == null || position == null) {
            upcomingInclineAlertArmed = true
            upcomingInclineAlertPulse = null
        } else {
            val grade = upcomingRouteGradePercent(position, route.profilePoints, route.elevationsMeters)
            val limit = alertSettings.inclineThreshold.coerceIn(10f, 40f).toDouble()
            val magnitude = kotlin.math.abs(grade ?: 0.0)
            if (upcomingInclineAlertArmed && grade != null && magnitude >= limit) {
                upcomingInclineAlertArmed = false
                val direction = if (grade >= 0.0) "subida" else "bajada"
                upcomingInclineAlertPulse = "Pendiente: atención, $direction pronunciada próxima, ${magnitude.roundToInt()} por ciento"
                delay(5000L)
                upcomingInclineAlertPulse = null
            } else if (!upcomingInclineAlertArmed && magnitude <= limit - 4.0) {
                upcomingInclineAlertArmed = true
            }
        }
    }

    var batteryStepPulse by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var previousBatterySoc by remember { mutableIntStateOf(-1) }
    LaunchedEffect(bluetooth, demo.soc, alertSettings.batteryStepOn, alertSettings.batteryStep) {
        if (!bluetooth) {
            previousBatterySoc = -1
            batteryStepPulse = null
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }
        val currentSoc = demo.soc.coerceIn(0, 100)
        if (!alertSettings.batteryStepOn) {
            previousBatterySoc = currentSoc
            batteryStepPulse = null
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }
        val step = ((alertSettings.batteryStep.coerceIn(5f, 20f) / 5f).roundToInt() * 5).coerceIn(5, 20)
        val previous = previousBatterySoc
        // Seed silently on connect/enable. Only announce milestones actually crossed downward.
        if (previous >= 0 && currentSoc < previous) {
            val crossed = (previous - 1 downTo currentSoc).firstOrNull { it > 0 && it % step == 0 }
            if (crossed != null) {
                batteryStepPulse = "Batería al $crossed por ciento"
                delay(4000L)
                batteryStepPulse = null
            }
        }
        previousBatterySoc = currentSoc
    }

    var lowBatteryAlertArmed by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    var temperatureAlertArmed by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    var cellDeltaAlertArmed by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    var thresholdAlertPulse by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    LaunchedEffect(bluetooth, demo.soc, demo.temperature, demo.cells, alertSettings) {
        if (!bluetooth) {
            lowBatteryAlertArmed = true; temperatureAlertArmed = true; cellDeltaAlertArmed = true
            thresholdAlertPulse = null
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }
        if (!alertSettings.batteryOn) lowBatteryAlertArmed = true
        else if (lowBatteryAlertArmed && demo.soc in 1..alertSettings.batteryThreshold.roundToInt()) {
            lowBatteryAlertArmed = false
            thresholdAlertPulse = "Batería baja: ${demo.soc}%"
        } else if (!lowBatteryAlertArmed && demo.soc >= alertSettings.batteryThreshold.roundToInt() + 3) lowBatteryAlertArmed = true

        if (!alertSettings.tempOn) temperatureAlertArmed = true
        else if (temperatureAlertArmed && demo.temperature >= alertSettings.tempThreshold) {
            temperatureAlertArmed = false
            thresholdAlertPulse = "Temperatura BMS: ${format1(demo.temperature)} °C"
        } else if (!temperatureAlertArmed && demo.temperature <= alertSettings.tempThreshold - 2f) temperatureAlertArmed = true

        val cellDeltaMv = if (demo.cells.size >= 2) ((demo.cells.maxOrNull()!! - demo.cells.minOrNull()!!) * 1000.0) else 0.0
        if (!alertSettings.cellOn) cellDeltaAlertArmed = true
        else if (cellDeltaAlertArmed && demo.cells.size >= 2 && cellDeltaMv >= alertSettings.cellThreshold) {
            cellDeltaAlertArmed = false
            thresholdAlertPulse = "Diferencia entre celdas: ${cellDeltaMv.roundToInt()} mV"
        } else if (!cellDeltaAlertArmed && cellDeltaMv <= alertSettings.cellThreshold - 10f) cellDeltaAlertArmed = true

        if (thresholdAlertPulse != null) {
            delay(4000L)
            thresholdAlertPulse = null
        }
    }

    val configuredAlerts = buildList {
        stateAlertMessage?.let { add(it) }
        portStateAlertMessage?.let { add(it) }
        if (bluetooth) {
            if (alertSettings.bmsOn) addAll(demo.activeAlerts)
        }
        thresholdAlertPulse?.let { add(it) }
        distanceAlertPulse?.let { add(it) }
        batteryStepPulse?.let { periodic ->
            val lowBatteryAlreadyPresent = bluetooth &&
                alertSettings.batteryOn &&
                demo.soc in 1..alertSettings.batteryThreshold.roundToInt()
            if (!lowBatteryAlreadyPresent) add(periodic)
        }
        speedAlertPulse?.let { add(it) }
        inclineAlertPulse?.let { add(it) }
        upcomingInclineAlertPulse?.let { add(it) }
    }.distinct()

    var alertTtsReady by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val tts = remember(appContext) {
        TextToSpeech(appContext) { status -> alertTtsReady = status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(alertTtsReady) {
        if (alertTtsReady) {
            tts.language = Locale("es", "ES")
            tts.setAudioAttributes(
                AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ASSISTANCE_NAVIGATION_GUIDANCE)
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                    .build()
            )
        }
    }
    DisposableEffect(tts) { onDispose { tts.stop(); tts.shutdown() } }
    fun confirmAlertVoice(message: String) {
        if (alertTtsReady) tts.speak(message, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, null, "eskate_alert_check_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    }
    var previousConfiguredAlerts by remember { mutableStateOf<Set<String>>(emptySet()) }
    var configuredAlertsSeeded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    LaunchedEffect(configuredAlerts, alertSettings, alertTtsReady) {
        val now = configuredAlerts.toSet()
        if (!configuredAlertsSeeded) {
            previousConfiguredAlerts = now
            configuredAlertsSeeded = true
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }
        val fresh = now - previousConfiguredAlerts
        fresh.forEach { alert ->
            val isBattery = alert.startsWith("Batería baja") || alert.startsWith("Batería al ")
            val isTemp = alert.startsWith("Temperatura BMS")
            val isCell = alert.startsWith("Diferencia entre celdas")
            val isDistance = alert.startsWith("Distancia:")
            val isSpeed = alert.startsWith("Velocidad:")
            val isIncline = alert.startsWith("Pendiente:")
            val isState = alert == "Puerto de descarga desconectado" || alert == "Puerto de descarga conectado" || alert == "Puerto de descarga apagado" || alert == "Puerto de descarga encendido" || alert == "Bluetooth desconectado"
            val sound = when { isState->appSoundsEnabled; isBattery->alertSettings.batterySound; isTemp->alertSettings.tempSound; isCell->alertSettings.cellSound; isDistance->alertSettings.distanceSound; isSpeed->alertSettings.speedSound; isIncline->alertSettings.inclineSound; else->alertSettings.bmsSound }
            val voice = when { isState->criticalVoiceAlerts; isBattery->alertSettings.batteryVoice; isTemp->alertSettings.tempVoice; isCell->alertSettings.cellVoice; isDistance->alertSettings.distanceVoice; isSpeed->alertSettings.speedVoice; isIncline->alertSettings.inclineVoice; else->alertSettings.bmsVoice }
            if (sound) runCatching { android.media.ToneGenerator(android.media.AudioManager.STREAM_NOTIFICATION, 85).apply { startTone(android.media.ToneGenerator.TONE_PROP_BEEP2, 350); Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({ release() }, 500L) } }
            if (voice && alertTtsReady) tts.speak(alert, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_ADD, null, "eskate_alert_${alert.hashCode()}_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
        }
        previousConfiguredAlerts = now
    }

    val lightController = remember(appContext) {
        LightGattController(
            context = appContext,
            onStatus = { connected, address, message ->
                lightsConnected = connected
                lightsConnectedAddress = if (connected) address else null
                lightsTargetAddress = if (connected) null else address
                lightsConnectionStatus = message
            }
        )
    }
    DisposableEffect(lightController) {
        onDispose { lightController.close() }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(lightsConnected, lightsPowerOn, lightsBlinkEnabled, lightsBlinkSpeed) {
        if (!lightsConnected) return@LaunchedEffect
        if (!lightsPowerOn) {
            lightController.setPower(false)
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }
        if (!lightsBlinkEnabled) {
            lightController.setPower(true)
            return@LaunchedEffect
        }
        val intervalMs = (900L - (lightsBlinkSpeed.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * 760f).roundToInt())
            .coerceIn(140L, 900L)
        var illuminated = true
        while (true) {
            lightController.setPower(illuminated)
            illuminated = !illuminated
            delay(intervalMs)
        }
    }

    var gpsPermissionGranted by remember {
        mutableStateOf(
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(appContext, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED ||
                ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(appContext, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        )
    }
    val gpsPermissionLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()
    ) { result ->
        gpsPermissionGranted = result.values.any { it }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        if (!gpsPermissionGranted) {
            gpsPermissionLauncher.launch(
                arrayOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION)
            )
        }
    }

    DisposableEffect(gpsPermissionGranted) {
        val locationManager = appContext.getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE) as LocationManager
        var lastAcceptedTripLocation: Location? = null
        val listener = object : LocationListener {
            override fun onLocationChanged(location: Location) {
                if (location.hasAccuracy() && location.accuracy > 30f) return
                val nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis()
                if (location.time > 0L && nowMs - location.time > 15_000L) return
                val rawSpeedKmh = if (location.hasSpeed()) location.speed * 3.6 else 0.0
                val previous = lastAcceptedTripLocation
                val movedMeters = previous?.distanceTo(location)?.toDouble() ?: Double.MAX_VALUE
                val reportedAccuracyMeters = if (location.hasAccuracy()) location.accuracy.toDouble() else 12.0
                val accuracyGateMeters = maxOf(7.0, reportedAccuracyMeters * 0.75)
                // A phone at rest can jump well beyond its reported accuracy. Do not move the rider
                // from isolated low-speed fixes; real movement is accepted once speed is credible.
                val stationaryHoldMeters = maxOf(18.0, reportedAccuracyMeters * 1.5)
                val stationary = previous != null && rawSpeedKmh < 2.5 && movedMeters < stationaryHoldMeters
                val implausibleStationaryJump = previous != null && rawSpeedKmh < 1.5 && movedMeters <= 60.0
                if (stationary || implausibleStationaryJump) {
                    demo = demo.copy(speed = 0)
                    return
                }
                val nextPoint = GpsPoint(location.latitude, location.longitude)
                gpsCurrentLatitude = location.latitude
                gpsCurrentLongitude = location.longitude
                gpsCurrentAltitudeMeters = if (location.hasAltitude()) location.altitude else gpsCurrentAltitudeMeters
                val inclineRef = inclineReferenceLocation
                if (location.hasAltitude() && inclineRef != null && inclineRef.hasAltitude()) {
                    val horizontalMeters = inclineRef.distanceTo(location).toDouble()
                    if (horizontalMeters >= 35.0 && horizontalMeters <= 140.0 && rawSpeedKmh >= 4.0) {
                        val rawGrade = ((location.altitude - inclineRef.altitude) / horizontalMeters) * 100.0
                        // GPS altitude is noisy: use a longer baseline and conservative smoothing.
                        if (kotlin.math.abs(rawGrade) <= 50.0) gpsInclinePercent = gpsInclinePercent * 0.78 + rawGrade * 0.22
                        inclineReferenceLocation = Location(location)
                    }
                } else if (location.hasAltitude()) inclineReferenceLocation = Location(location)
                var addedKm = 0.0
                if (previous != null && rawSpeedKmh >= 2.0) {
                    val segmentMeters = previous.distanceTo(location).toDouble()
                    val dtSeconds = when {
                        location.time > 0L && previous.time > 0L -> ((location.time - previous.time) / 1000.0).coerceIn(0.25, 5.0)
                        else -> 1.0
                    }
                    val speedMetersPerSecond = rawSpeedKmh / 3.6
                    val physicallyPlausibleMeters = maxOf(accuracyGateMeters, speedMetersPerSecond * dtSeconds * 1.8 + 8.0)
                    if (segmentMeters >= accuracyGateMeters && segmentMeters <= physicallyPlausibleMeters) addedKm = segmentMeters / 1000.0
                }
                lastAcceptedTripLocation = Location(location)
                gpsPreviousPoint = nextPoint
                val newTripKm = gpsTripDistanceKm + addedKm
                val newTotalKm = gpsTotalDistanceKm + addedKm
                gpsTripDistanceKm = newTripKm
                gpsTotalDistanceKm = newTotalKm
                val filteredSpeedKmh = if (rawSpeedKmh < 6.0) 0.0 else rawSpeedKmh
                if (filteredSpeedKmh > 0.0) gpsMaximumSpeedKmh = maxOf(gpsMaximumSpeedKmh, filteredSpeedKmh)
                demo = demo.copy(
                    speed = filteredSpeedKmh.roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(0),
                    tripKm = newTripKm,
                    totalKm = newTotalKm
                )
            }
        }

        if (gpsPermissionGranted) {
            try {
                val tripProvider = when {
                    locationManager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER) -> LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER
                    locationManager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER) -> LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER
                    else -> null
                }
                if (tripProvider != null) {
                    locationManager.getLastKnownLocation(tripProvider)
                        ?.takeIf { it.time <= 0L || System.currentTimeMillis() - it.time <= 15_000L }
                        ?.let { listener.onLocationChanged(it) }
                    locationManager.requestLocationUpdates(tripProvider, 1000L, 1f, listener, Looper.getMainLooper())
                }
            } catch (_: Exception) {
            }
        }

        onDispose {
            try {
                locationManager.removeUpdates(listener)
            } catch (_: Exception) {
            }
        }
    }

    // Una muestra unificada por segundo: el GPS no depende del ritmo de notificaciones del BMS.
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        while (true) {
            delay(1000)
            val bmsAvailable = bluetooth
            val liveSample = TelemetrySample(
                recordedAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                elapsedSeconds = ((android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - liveTelemetryStartMs) / 1000L).toInt(),
                distanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm,
                speedKmh = demo.speed.toDouble(),
                voltage = if (bmsAvailable) demo.voltage else 0.0,
                currentA = if (bmsAvailable) demo.currentA else 0.0,
                powerW = if (bmsAvailable) kotlin.math.abs(demo.voltage * demo.currentA) else 0.0,
                soc = if (bmsAvailable) demo.soc else 0,
                temperatureBms = if (bmsAvailable) demo.temperature else 0.0,
                temperatureCells = if (bmsAvailable) demo.cellTemperature else 0.0,
                remainingAh = if (bmsAvailable) demo.remainingAh else 0.0,
                cells = if (bmsAvailable) demo.cells else emptyList(),
                latitude = gpsCurrentLatitude,
                longitude = gpsCurrentLongitude,
                altitudeMeters = gpsCurrentAltitudeMeters
            )
            while (liveTelemetrySamples.size >= 360) liveTelemetrySamples.removeAt(0)
            liveTelemetrySamples.add(liveSample)

            if ((routeRecordingActive || mapNavigationActive) &&
                !routeRecordingPaused &&
                stopwatchRunning &&
                stopwatchOwner == StopwatchOwner.MAP) {
                val routeId = currentTelemetryRouteId ?: System.currentTimeMillis().also {
                    currentTelemetryRouteId = it
                    telemetryRouteStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                    currentTelemetrySamples.clear()
                }
                val routeSample = liveSample.copy(
                    elapsedSeconds = (stopwatchSeconds - routeRecordingStartSeconds).coerceAtLeast(0),
                    distanceKm = (gpsTripDistanceKm - telemetryRouteStartDistanceKm).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
                )
                currentTelemetrySamples.add(routeSample)
                appendTelemetrySample(appContext, routeId, routeSample)
            }
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(stopwatchRunning) {
        while (stopwatchRunning) {
            delay(1000)
            stopwatchSeconds += 1
            demo = demo.copy(tripMinutes = stopwatchSeconds / 60)
        }
    }

    val riderBridgeRoute = mapNavigationSession.routeData.value
    val riderBridgePosition = mapNavigationSession.currentPosition.value
    val riderBridgeRemainingKm = if (mapNavigationActive && riderBridgeRoute != null) {
        remainingRouteDistanceKm(riderBridgePosition, riderBridgeRoute.points, riderBridgeRoute.distanceKm)
    } else null
    val riderBridgeRemainingMinutes = if (riderBridgeRemainingKm != null && riderBridgeRoute != null && riderBridgeRoute.distanceKm > 0.0) {
        (riderBridgeRoute.durationMinutes * (riderBridgeRemainingKm / riderBridgeRoute.distanceKm))
            .roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(0)
    } else null

    LaunchedEffect(
        demo.speed, demo.soc, demo.rangeKm, bluetooth, gpsTripDistanceKm, gpsMaximumSpeedKmh,
        stopwatchSeconds, mapNavigationActive, routeRecordingActive, routeRecordingPaused,
        riderBridgeRoute, riderBridgePosition, mapNavigationSession.currentInstruction.value,
        mapNavigationSession.currentInstructionDistanceMeters.value, gpsPermissionGranted
    ) {
        val averageSpeed = if (stopwatchSeconds > 0) {
            gpsTripDistanceKm / (stopwatchSeconds / 3600.0)
        } else 0.0
        val snapshot = JSONObject().apply {
            put("timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis())
            put("speedKmh", demo.speed)
            put("tripDistanceKm", gpsTripDistanceKm)
            put("averageSpeedKmh", averageSpeed)
            put("maximumSpeedKmh", gpsMaximumSpeedKmh)
            put("elapsedSeconds", stopwatchSeconds)
            put("bmsConnected", bluetooth)
            put("batteryPercent", if (bluetooth) demo.soc else JSONObject.NULL)
            put("rangeKm", if (bluetooth) demo.rangeKm else JSONObject.NULL)
            put("gpsAvailable", gpsPermissionGranted && gpsCurrentLatitude != null && gpsCurrentLongitude != null)
            put("navigationActive", mapNavigationActive)
            put("remainingDistanceKm", riderBridgeRemainingKm ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            put("remainingMinutes", riderBridgeRemainingMinutes ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            put(
                "etaEpochMs",
                riderBridgeRemainingMinutes?.let { System.currentTimeMillis() + it * 60_000L } ?: JSONObject.NULL
            )
            put("nextInstruction", mapNavigationSession.currentInstruction.value ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            put(
                "nextInstructionDistanceMeters",
                mapNavigationSession.currentInstructionDistanceMeters.value ?: JSONObject.NULL
            )
            put("recordingActive", routeRecordingActive)
            put("recordingPaused", routeRecordingPaused)
        }
        appContext.getSharedPreferences("rider_assistant_bridge", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit().putString("snapshot", snapshot.toString()).apply()
    }

    DisposableEffect(Unit) {
        RiderAssistantControlBridge.handler = { rawAction ->
            when (rawAction.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)) {
                "navigation_start", "navigation_resume" -> {
                    if (mapNavigationSession.routeData.value == null) {
                        false to "Calcula primero una ruta en SKATESUV"
                    } else {
                        if (!mapNavigationActive && currentTelemetryRouteId == null) {
                            currentTelemetryRouteId = System.currentTimeMillis()
                            telemetryRouteStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                            currentTelemetrySamples.clear()
                            routeRecordingStartSeconds = stopwatchSeconds
                        }
                        mapNavigationActive = true
                        routeRecordingPaused = false
                        stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.MAP
                        stopwatchRunning = true
                        true to "Navegación en marcha"
                    }
                }
                "navigation_pause" -> {
                    if (!mapNavigationActive) false to "La navegación no está activa"
                    else {
                        stopwatchRunning = false
                        if (routeRecordingActive) routeRecordingPaused = true
                        true to "Navegación pausada"
                    }
                }
                "navigation_stop" -> {
                    if (!mapNavigationActive) false to "La navegación no está activa"
                    else {
                        mapNavigationActive = false
                        if (!routeRecordingActive) {
                            stopwatchRunning = false
                            stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.NONE
                        }
                        mapNavigationSession.routeData.value = null
                        mapNavigationSession.currentInstruction.value = null
                        mapNavigationSession.currentInstructionDistanceMeters.value = null
                        mapNavigationSession.instructionIndex.intValue = 0
                        true to "Navegación parada"
                    }
                }
                "record_start", "record_resume" -> {
                    if (!routeRecordingActive) {
                        currentTelemetryRouteId = System.currentTimeMillis()
                        telemetryRouteStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                        currentTelemetrySamples.clear()
                        routeRecordingStartSeconds = stopwatchSeconds
                        routeRecordingActive = true
                    }
                    routeRecordingPaused = false
                    stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.MAP
                    stopwatchRunning = true
                    true to "Grabando ruta"
                }
                "record_pause" -> {
                    if (!routeRecordingActive) false to "No hay una grabación activa"
                    else {
                        routeRecordingPaused = true
                        if (!mapNavigationActive) stopwatchRunning = false
                        true to "Grabación pausada"
                    }
                }
                "record_stop" -> {
                    if (!routeRecordingActive) false to "No hay una grabación activa"
                    else {
                        routeRecordingActive = false
                        routeRecordingPaused = false
                        savedTelemetryRoutes = loadTelemetryRoutes(appContext)
                        currentTelemetryRouteId = null
                        currentTelemetrySamples.clear()
                        if (!mapNavigationActive) {
                            stopwatchRunning = false
                            stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.NONE
                        }
                        true to "Ruta guardada"
                    }
                }
                else -> false to "Orden SKATESUV no compatible"
            }
        }
        onDispose {
            RiderAssistantControlBridge.handler = null
        }
    }

    MaterialTheme(colorScheme = darkColorScheme(background = Bg, surface = Panel, primary = Cyan)) {
        Surface(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(Color.Black)
                .graphicsLayer { alpha = appAlpha },
            color = Bg
        ) {
            Column(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .pointerInput(screen) {
                        awaitEachGesture {
                            awaitFirstDown(requireUnconsumed = false)
                            if (screen == Screen.LIGHTS || screen == Screen.SETTINGS) {
                                inactivityPulse++
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF071726), Bg)))
            ) {
                Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    when (screen) {
                        Screen.HOME -> HomeScreen(
                            s = demo.copy(
                                hasAlarm = demo.hasAlarm ||
                                    stateAlertMessage != null ||
                                    portStateAlertMessage != null
                            ),
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            powerOn = powerOn,
                            stopwatchSeconds = stopwatchSeconds,
                            stopwatchRunning = stopwatchRunning,
                            averageDistanceKm = (gpsTripDistanceKm - stopwatchStartDistanceKm).coerceAtLeast(0.0),
                            onPower = {
                                if (bluetooth) {
                                    val requestedOn = !powerOn
                                    dischargeUserRequestedOff = !requestedOn
                                    // OFF becomes an alert only after the BMS confirms it.
                                    // ON clears the alert only after confirmation.
                                    bluetoothController.setPower(requestedOn)
                                }
                            },
                            onAlert = { screen = Screen.SYSTEM },
                            onStopwatchStart = {
                                if (!stopwatchRunning) stopwatchStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                                stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.HOME
                                stopwatchRunning = true
                            },
                            onStopwatchPause = { stopwatchRunning = false },
                            onStopwatchReset = {
                                stopwatchRunning = false
                                stopwatchSeconds = 0
                                stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.NONE
                                gpsMaximumSpeedKmh = 0.0
                            },
                            onResetTotalKm = {
                                gpsTotalDistanceKm = 0.0
                                demo = demo.copy(totalKm = 0.0)
                            },
                            onJump = { screen = it }
                        )
                        Screen.PERFORMANCE -> PerformanceScreen(
                            s = demo,
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            powerOn = powerOn,
                            onTelemetry = { screen = Screen.TELEMETRY }
                        )
                        Screen.TELEMETRY -> TelemetryScreen(
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            powerOn = powerOn,
                            savedRoutes = savedTelemetryRoutes,
                            currentRouteId = currentTelemetryRouteId,
                            currentSamples = currentTelemetrySamples.toList(),
                            liveSamples = liveTelemetrySamples.toList(),
                            orientation = appOrientation
                        )
                        Screen.MAP -> MapScreen(
                            s = demo,
                            session = mapNavigationSession,
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            powerOn = powerOn,
                            stopwatchSeconds = stopwatchSeconds,
                            stopwatchRunning = stopwatchRunning && stopwatchOwner == StopwatchOwner.MAP,
                            navigationActive = mapNavigationActive,
                            stopwatchOwner = stopwatchOwner,
                            gpsDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm,
                            gpsMaximumSpeedKmh = gpsMaximumSpeedKmh,
                            fullscreen = mapFullscreen,
                            orientation = appOrientation,
                            voiceEnabled = voiceNavigationEnabled,
                            voiceVolume = voiceVolume,
                            voiceRate = voiceRate,
                            onVoiceEnabledChange = { voiceNavigationEnabled = it },
                            currentRouteId = currentTelemetryRouteId,
                            routeRecordingActive = routeRecordingActive,
                            routeRecordingPaused = routeRecordingPaused,
                            onRecordToggle = {
                                if (!routeRecordingActive) {
                                    currentTelemetryRouteId = System.currentTimeMillis()
                                    telemetryRouteStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                                    currentTelemetrySamples.clear()
                                    routeRecordingStartSeconds = stopwatchSeconds
                                    routeRecordingActive = true
                                    routeRecordingPaused = false
                                    stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.MAP
                                    stopwatchRunning = true
                                } else if (routeRecordingPaused || !stopwatchRunning) {
                                    // GRABAR has one job: resume the same recording.
                                    // Finishing/resetting belongs exclusively to STOP↻.
                                    routeRecordingPaused = false
                                    stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.MAP
                                    stopwatchRunning = true
                                }
                            },
                            onSharedPauseToggle = {
                                val nextRunning = !stopwatchRunning
                                stopwatchRunning = nextRunning
                                if (routeRecordingActive) routeRecordingPaused = !nextRunning
                            },
                            onFullscreenChange = { mapFullscreen = it },
                            onResetGpsDistance = {
                                gpsTripDistanceKm = 0.0
                                rangeLearningEnergyWh = 0.0
                                rangeLearningSeconds = 0.0
                                rangeLearningStartDistanceKm = null
                                lastBmsEnergySampleMs = null
                                demo = demo.copy(tripKm = 0.0, whKm = 0.0, rangeKm = 0)
                            },
                            onResetTrip = {
                                gpsPreviousPoint = null
                                gpsTripDistanceKm = 0.0
                                gpsMaximumSpeedKmh = 0.0
                                rangeLearningEnergyWh = 0.0
                                rangeLearningSeconds = 0.0
                                rangeLearningStartDistanceKm = null
                                lastBmsEnergySampleMs = null
                                stopwatchSeconds = 0
                                stopwatchRunning = false
                                stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.NONE
                                mapNavigationActive = false
                                currentTelemetryRouteId = null
                                currentTelemetrySamples.clear()
                                demo = demo.copy(speed = 0, tripKm = 0.0, tripMinutes = 0, whKm = 0.0, rangeKm = 0)
                            },
                            onStopwatchStart = {
                                stopwatchStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                                if (!mapNavigationActive) {
                                    currentTelemetryRouteId = System.currentTimeMillis()
                                    telemetryRouteStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                                    currentTelemetrySamples.clear()
                                    routeRecordingStartSeconds = stopwatchSeconds
                                }
                                mapNavigationActive = true
                                routeRecordingPaused = false
                                stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.MAP
                                stopwatchRunning = true
                            },
                            onStopwatchPause = {
                                stopwatchRunning = false
                                if (routeRecordingActive) routeRecordingPaused = true
                            },
                            onStopwatchReset = {
                                mapNavigationActive = false
                                stopwatchRunning = false
                                routeRecordingActive = false
                                routeRecordingPaused = false
                                if (currentTelemetryRouteId != null) {
                                    savedTelemetryRoutes = loadTelemetryRoutes(appContext)
                                }
                                stopwatchSeconds = 0
                                stopwatchOwner = StopwatchOwner.NONE
                                stopwatchStartDistanceKm = gpsTripDistanceKm
                                gpsPreviousPoint = null
                                gpsTripDistanceKm = 0.0
                                gpsMaximumSpeedKmh = 0.0
                                rangeLearningEnergyWh = 0.0
                                rangeLearningSeconds = 0.0
                                rangeLearningStartDistanceKm = null
                                lastBmsEnergySampleMs = null
                                currentTelemetryRouteId = null
                                currentTelemetrySamples.clear()
                                mapNavigationSession.query.value = ""
                                mapNavigationSession.routeData.value = null
                                mapNavigationSession.routeStatus.value = "Esperando señal GPS…"
                                mapNavigationSession.searching.value = false
                                mapNavigationSession.currentInstruction.value = null
                                mapNavigationSession.currentInstructionDistanceMeters.value = null
                                mapNavigationSession.instructionIndex.intValue = 0
                                mapNavigationSession.recenterSignal.intValue += 1
                                demo = demo.copy(tripKm = 0.0, tripMinutes = 0, whKm = 0.0, rangeKm = 0)
                                savedTelemetryRoutes = loadTelemetryRoutes(appContext)
                            }
                        )
                        Screen.COMMUNITY -> CommunityHubScreen()
                        Screen.LIGHTS -> LightsScreen(
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            powerOn = powerOn,
                            lightsConnected = lightsConnected,
                            lightsStatus = lightsConnectionStatus,
                            lightsPowerOn = lightsPowerOn,
                            brightness = lightsBrightness,
                            selectedColor = lightsColor,
                            blinkEnabled = lightsBlinkEnabled,
                            blinkSpeed = lightsBlinkSpeed,
                            onBluetooth = { screen = Screen.LIGHT_BLUETOOTH },
                            onPowerChange = {
                                lightsPowerOn = it
                                if (lightsConnected) lightController.setPower(it)
                            },
                            onBrightnessChange = {
                                lightsBrightness = it
                                if (lightsConnected) lightController.setBrightness(it)
                            },
                            onColorChange = {
                                lightsColor = it
                                if (lightsConnected) lightController.setColor(it)
                            },
                            onBlinkEnabledChange = { lightsBlinkEnabled = it },
                            onBlinkSpeedChange = { lightsBlinkSpeed = it }
                        )
                        Screen.LIGHT_BLUETOOTH -> BluetoothScreen(
                            bluetooth = lightsConnected,
                            connectedAddress = lightsConnectedAddress,
                            targetAddress = lightsTargetAddress,
                            connectionStatus = lightsConnectionStatus,
                            screenTitle = "BLUETOOTH · LUCES",
                            preferredKeywords = listOf("elk", "bledom", "duoco", "strip", "rgb", "led"),
                            onConnect = { device ->
                                lightsTargetAddress = device.address
                                lightController.connect(device.address, device.name)
                            },
                            onBack = { screen = Screen.LIGHTS }
                        )
                        Screen.HISTORY -> HistoryScreen(
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            powerOn = powerOn,
                            savedRoutes = savedTelemetryRoutes,
                            orientation = appOrientation,
                            onFullscreenChange = { mapFullscreen = it },
                            onRouteDeleted = { deletedId -> savedTelemetryRoutes = savedTelemetryRoutes.filterNot { it.id == deletedId } }
                        )
                        Screen.ALERTS -> AlertsScreen(
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            activeAlerts = configuredAlerts,
                            settings = alertSettings,
                            onSettingsChange = ::updateAlertSettings,
                            onVoiceCheck = ::confirmAlertVoice,
                            onBack = { screen = Screen.HOME }
                        )
                        Screen.SETTINGS -> SettingsScreen(
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            onBluetooth = { screen = Screen.BLUETOOTH },
                            onAlerts = { screen = Screen.ALERTS },
                            onSystem = { screen = Screen.SYSTEM },
                            onFirmware = { screen = Screen.FIRMWARE },
                            onLegal = { screen = Screen.LEGAL }
                        )
                        Screen.BLUETOOTH -> BluetoothScreen(
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            connectedAddress = connectedBluetoothAddress,
                            targetAddress = targetBluetoothAddress,
                            connectionStatus = bluetoothConnectionStatus,
                            onConnect = { device ->
                                bluetoothController.connect(device.address, device.name)
                            },
                            onBack = { screen = Screen.SETTINGS }
                        )
                        Screen.SYSTEM -> SystemScreen(
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            activeAlerts = configuredAlerts,
                            voiceEnabled = voiceNavigationEnabled,
                            keepScreenOn = keepScreenOn,
                            orientation = appOrientation,
                            onKeepScreenOnChange = { keepScreenOn = it },
                            onOrientationChange = { appOrientation = it },
                            onRestoreSettings = {
                                keepScreenOn = true
                                appOrientation = AppOrientation.AUTO
                                voiceNavigationEnabled = true
                                voiceVolume = .85f
                                voiceRate = 1f
                                appSoundsEnabled = true
                                criticalVoiceAlerts = true
                                batteryVoiceAlerts = true
                                distanceVoiceAlerts = true
                            },
                            onBack = { screen = Screen.SETTINGS }
                        )
                        Screen.FIRMWARE -> FirmwareScreen(
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            connectionStatus = bluetoothConnectionStatus,
                            onBack = { screen = Screen.SETTINGS }
                        )
                        Screen.LEGAL -> LegalNoticeScreen(
                            bluetooth = bluetooth,
                            onBack = { screen = Screen.SETTINGS }
                        )
                    }
                }
                if (!mapFullscreen) BottomNav(screen) { screen = it }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BottomNav(current: Screen, onSelect: (Screen) -> Unit) {

@Composable
private fun SpeedGauge(
    speed: Int,
    alertColor: Color,
    onAlert: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Box(modifier, contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            val diameter = size.minDimension * 0.94f
            val stroke = diameter * 0.075f
            val topLeft = Offset((size.width - diameter) / 2f, (size.height - diameter) / 2f)
            val arcSize = Size(diameter, diameter)
            val start = 140f
            val sweep = 260f

            drawArc(
                color = Color(0xFF12334B),
                startAngle = start,
                sweepAngle = sweep,
                useCenter = false,
                topLeft = topLeft,
                size = arcSize,
                style = Stroke(stroke, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
            )
            val displayedSpeed = speed.coerceIn(0, 60).toFloat()
            fun drawSpeedRange(from: Float, to: Float, color: Color) {
                val end = displayedSpeed.coerceAtMost(to)
                if (end > from) {
                    drawArc(
                        color = color,
                        startAngle = start + sweep * (from / 60f),
                        sweepAngle = sweep * ((end - from) / 60f),
                        useCenter = false,
                        topLeft = topLeft,
                        size = arcSize,
                        style = Stroke(stroke, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                    )
                }
            }
            drawSpeedRange(0f, 25f, Cyan)
            drawSpeedRange(25f, 35f, Yellow)
            drawSpeedRange(35f, 45f, Orange)
            drawSpeedRange(45f, 60f, Red)

            val center = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height / 2f)
            val outerRadius = diameter / 2f - stroke * 0.25f
            for (i in 0..30) {
                val angle = (start + sweep * i / 30f) * PI.toFloat() / 180f
                val major = i % 5 == 0
                val innerRadius = outerRadius - if (major) stroke * 1.08f else stroke * 0.66f
                val p1 = Offset(center.x + cos(angle) * outerRadius, center.y + sin(angle) * outerRadius)
                val p2 = Offset(center.x + cos(angle) * innerRadius, center.y + sin(angle) * innerRadius)
                val tickSpeed = i * 2f
                val thresholdColor = when {
                    tickSpeed <= 25f -> Cyan
                    tickSpeed <= 35f -> Yellow
                    tickSpeed <= 45f -> Orange
                    else -> Red
                }
                val tickColor = if (tickSpeed <= displayedSpeed) thresholdColor else Color(0xFF36566A)
                drawLine(tickColor, p1, p2, strokeWidth = if (major) 3.4f else 1.6f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
            }
            val haloInset = stroke * 1.35f
            drawArc(
                color = Cyan.copy(alpha = 0.20f),
                startAngle = start,
                sweepAngle = sweep,
                useCenter = false,
                topLeft = Offset(topLeft.x + haloInset, topLeft.y + haloInset),
                size = Size(arcSize.width - haloInset * 2f, arcSize.height - haloInset * 2f),
                style = Stroke(stroke * 0.30f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
            )
            drawArc(
                color = Cyan.copy(alpha = 0.55f),
                startAngle = start,
                sweepAngle = sweep,
                useCenter = false,
                topLeft = Offset(topLeft.x + haloInset, topLeft.y + haloInset),
                size = Size(arcSize.width - haloInset * 2f, arcSize.height - haloInset * 2f),
                style = Stroke(stroke * 0.10f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
            )

            // Remate sport integrado en el propio arco: transición naranja-rojo
            // que se desvanece suavemente, sin puntos ni trazos exteriores.
            val sportSegmentCount = 8
            val sportSegmentSweep = 1.65f
            val sportGap = 0.70f
            val sportStartAngle =
                start + sweep - sportSegmentCount * (sportSegmentSweep + sportGap)
            repeat(sportSegmentCount) { index ->
                val progress = index / (sportSegmentCount - 1f)
                drawArc(
                    color = Color(
                        red = 1f,
                        green = 0.54f - progress * 0.30f,
                        blue = 0.12f - progress * 0.04f,
                        alpha = 0.78f - progress * 0.62f
                    ),
                    startAngle = sportStartAngle + index * (sportSegmentSweep + sportGap),
                    sweepAngle = sportSegmentSweep,
                    useCenter = false,
                    topLeft = topLeft,
                    size = arcSize,
                    style = Stroke(stroke * 0.34f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                )
            }

            drawCircle(Color(0xFF07131E), radius = diameter * 0.27f, center = center)
            drawCircle(Color(0xFF0A2638), radius = diameter * 0.27f, center = center, style = Stroke(2f))
        }

        Text("20", color = Text, fontSize = 10.sp, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopStart).offset(x = 39.dp, y = 61.dp))
        Text("30", color = Text, fontSize = 10.sp, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopCenter).offset(y = 34.dp))
        Text("40", color = Text, fontSize = 10.sp, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).offset(x = (-39).dp, y = 61.dp))
        Text("10", color = Text, fontSize = 9.sp, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterStart).offset(x = 26.dp, y = 9.dp))
        Text("50", color = Text, fontSize = 9.sp, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterEnd).offset(x = (-26).dp, y = 9.dp))
        Text("0", color = Text, fontSize = 9.sp, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomStart).offset(x = 44.dp, y = (-35).dp))
        Text("60", color = Text, fontSize = 9.sp, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomEnd).offset(x = (-40).dp, y = (-35).dp))

        WarningIcon(
            color = alertColor,
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(58.dp)
                .clickable { onAlert() }
        )
    }
}

private enum class DashboardIcon { BLUETOOTH, ALERT, VOICE, MIC, CACHE, FIRMWARE, INFO, BOLT, THERMOMETER, ROUTE, ROAD, LEAF, CLOCK, MAP, LIGHT, BARS, HISTORY, HOME, SETTINGS, COMMUNITY, TROPHY }

@Composable
private fun DashboardIconView(type: DashboardIcon, color: Color, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Canvas(modifier) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val stroke = (size.minDimension * 0.10f).coerceAtLeast(2f)
        when (type) {
            DashboardIcon.ALERT -> {
            val p=Path().apply { moveTo(w*.50f,h*.10f); lineTo(w*.90f,h*.84f); lineTo(w*.10f,h*.84f); close() }
            drawPath(p,color.copy(alpha=.10f)); drawPath(p,color,style=Stroke(stroke*.65f,join=StrokeJoin.Round))
            drawLine(color,Offset(w*.50f,h*.34f),Offset(w*.50f,h*.60f),stroke*.65f,StrokeCap.Round)
            drawCircle(color,w*.045f,Offset(w*.50f,h*.72f))
        }
        DashboardIcon.VOICE -> {
                    drawRoundRect(color, Offset(size.width*.12f,size.height*.34f), Size(size.width*.28f,size.height*.32f), CornerRadius(3f,3f))
                    val p=Path().apply { moveTo(size.width*.38f,size.height*.34f); lineTo(size.width*.62f,size.height*.18f); lineTo(size.width*.62f,size.height*.82f); lineTo(size.width*.38f,size.height*.66f); close() }
                    drawPath(p,color)
                    drawArc(color,-48f,96f,false,Offset(size.width*.48f,size.height*.25f),Size(size.width*.38f,size.height*.50f),style=Stroke(stroke,cap=StrokeCap.Round))
                }
                DashboardIcon.MIC -> {
                    val cx = w * .50f
                    val micTop = h * .12f
                    val micBottom = h * .58f
                    drawRoundRect(
                        color = color,
                        topLeft = Offset(w * .38f, micTop),
                        size = Size(w * .24f, micBottom - micTop),
                        cornerRadius = CornerRadius(w * .12f, w * .12f),
                        style = Stroke(stroke * .70f)
                    )
                    drawArc(
                        color = color,
                        startAngle = 0f,
                        sweepAngle = 180f,
                        useCenter = false,
                        topLeft = Offset(w * .26f, h * .34f),
                        size = Size(w * .48f, h * .38f),
                        style = Stroke(stroke * .70f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                    )
                    drawLine(color, Offset(cx, h * .71f), Offset(cx, h * .87f), stroke * .68f, StrokeCap.Round)
                    drawLine(color, Offset(w * .35f, h * .88f), Offset(w * .65f, h * .88f), stroke * .68f, StrokeCap.Round)
                }
                DashboardIcon.CACHE -> {
                    drawRoundRect(color, Offset(size.width*.18f,size.height*.40f), Size(size.width*.64f,size.height*.38f), CornerRadius(3f,3f), style=Stroke(stroke))
                    drawLine(color,Offset(size.width*.32f,size.height*.40f),Offset(size.width*.40f,size.height*.20f),stroke,StrokeCap.Round)
                    drawLine(color,Offset(size.width*.40f,size.height*.20f),Offset(size.width*.70f,size.height*.28f),stroke,StrokeCap.Round)
                    repeat(3){i-> drawLine(color,Offset(size.width*(.30f+i*.17f),size.height*.52f),Offset(size.width*(.30f+i*.17f),size.height*.68f),stroke*.72f,StrokeCap.Round)}
                }
                DashboardIcon.FIRMWARE -> {
                    drawRoundRect(color,Offset(size.width*.27f,size.height*.27f),Size(size.width*.46f,size.height*.46f),CornerRadius(4f,4f),style=Stroke(stroke))
                    repeat(4){i-> val q=size.width*(.32f+i*.12f); drawLine(color,Offset(q,size.height*.15f),Offset(q,size.height*.27f),stroke*.75f); drawLine(color,Offset(q,size.height*.73f),Offset(q,size.height*.85f),stroke*.75f); drawLine(color,Offset(size.width*.15f,q),Offset(size.width*.27f,q),stroke*.75f); drawLine(color,Offset(size.width*.73f,q),Offset(size.width*.85f,q),stroke*.75f)}
                }
                DashboardIcon.INFO -> {
                    drawCircle(color,size.minDimension*.34f,center,style=Stroke(stroke))
                    drawCircle(color,size.minDimension*.035f,Offset(center.x,size.height*.34f))
                    drawLine(color,Offset(center.x,size.height*.46f),Offset(center.x,size.height*.68f),stroke,StrokeCap.Round)
                }
            DashboardIcon.BLUETOOTH -> {
                val p = Path().apply {
                    moveTo(w * .48f, h * .08f); lineTo(w * .78f, h * .32f); lineTo(w * .50f, h * .52f)
                    lineTo(w * .78f, h * .75f); lineTo(w * .48f, h * .94f); close()
                }
                drawPath(p, color.copy(alpha = .14f), style = Stroke(stroke * 2.4f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))
                drawPath(p, color, style = Stroke(stroke, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))
                drawLine(color, Offset(w*.22f,h*.27f), Offset(w*.66f,h*.70f), stroke, StrokeCap.Round)
                drawLine(color, Offset(w*.22f,h*.76f), Offset(w*.66f,h*.32f), stroke, StrokeCap.Round)
            }
            DashboardIcon.BOLT -> {
                val p = Path().apply {
                    moveTo(w*.58f, h*.02f); lineTo(w*.20f, h*.55f); lineTo(w*.48f, h*.55f)
                    lineTo(w*.37f, h*.98f); lineTo(w*.82f, h*.38f); lineTo(w*.54f, h*.38f); close()

                drawPath(p, color)
            }
            DashboardIcon.THERMOMETER -> {
                drawRoundRect(color, Offset(w*.40f,h*.08f), Size(w*.20f,h*.62f), cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(w*.10f,w*.10f), style = Stroke(stroke*.65f))
                drawCircle(color, w*.22f, Offset(w*.50f,h*.76f), style = Stroke(stroke*.65f))
                drawLine(color, Offset(w*.50f,h*.34f), Offset(w*.50f,h*.77f), stroke*.72f, StrokeCap.Round)

            DashboardIcon.ROUTE -> {

@Composable
private fun BatteryIcon(soc: Int) {
    Canvas(Modifier.padding(vertical = 6.dp).width(46.dp).height(78.dp)) {
        val bodyLeft = size.width * 0.12f
        val bodyTop = size.height * 0.12f
        val bodyRight = size.width * 0.82f
        val bodyBottom = size.height * 0.96f
        val corner = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(7f, 7f)

        drawRoundRect(
            color = Muted,
            topLeft = Offset(bodyLeft, bodyTop),
            size = Size(bodyRight - bodyLeft, bodyBottom - bodyTop),
            cornerRadius = corner,
            style = Stroke(2.8f)
        )
        drawRoundRect(
            color = Muted,
            topLeft = Offset(size.width * 0.34f, size.height * 0.035f),
            size = Size(size.width * 0.27f, size.height * 0.07f),
            cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(3f, 3f)
        )
        val innerLeft = bodyLeft + size.width * 0.09f
        val innerRight = bodyRight - size.width * 0.09f
        val innerTop = bodyTop + size.height * 0.08f
        val innerBottom = bodyBottom - size.height * 0.07f
        val gap = size.height * 0.035f
        val cellHeight = (innerBottom - innerTop - gap * 4f) / 5f
        val cellColors = listOf(Green, Green, Green, Yellow, Red)
        repeat(5) { index ->
            val y = innerTop + index * (cellHeight + gap)
            drawRoundRect(
                color = cellColors[index],
                topLeft = Offset(innerLeft, y),
                size = Size(innerRight - innerLeft, cellHeight),
                cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(3f, 3f)
            )
        }
    }
}
