@Composable
private fun TelemetryScreen(
    bluetooth: Boolean,
    powerOn: Boolean,
    savedRoutes: List<TelemetryRoute>,
    currentRouteId: Long?,
    currentSamples: List<TelemetrySample>,
    liveSamples: List<TelemetrySample>,
    orientation: AppOrientation
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var telemetryFullscreen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var selectedMetric by remember { mutableStateOf(TelemetryMetric.POWER) }
    LaunchedEffect(telemetryFullscreen) {
        val activity = context as? ComponentActivity
        activity?.requestedOrientation = if (telemetryFullscreen) {
            ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        } else {
            when (orientation) {
                AppOrientation.AUTO -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_UNSPECIFIED
                AppOrientation.PORTRAIT -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT
                AppOrientation.LANDSCAPE -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
            }
        }
    }
    BackHandler(enabled = telemetryFullscreen) { telemetryFullscreen = false }
    var selectedRouteId by remember { mutableStateOf<Long?>(null) }
    val emptyLiveSample = TelemetrySample(
        recordedAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        elapsedSeconds = 0,
        distanceKm = 0.0,
        speedKmh = 0.0,
        voltage = 0.0,
        currentA = 0.0,
        powerW = 0.0,
        soc = 0,
        temperatureBms = 0.0,
        temperatureCells = 0.0,
        remainingAh = 0.0,
        cells = emptyList()
    )
    val liveRoute = TelemetryRoute(
        id = Long.MIN_VALUE,
        samples = liveSamples.ifEmpty { listOf(emptyLiveSample) },
        live = true
    )
    val currentRoute = if (currentRouteId != null && currentSamples.isNotEmpty()) {
        TelemetryRoute(currentRouteId, currentSamples)
    } else null
    val routes = listOf(liveRoute) +
        listOfNotNull(currentRoute) +
        savedRoutes.filter { it.id != currentRouteId }

    LaunchedEffect(routes.map { it.id }) {
        if (routes.none { it.id == selectedRouteId }) selectedRouteId = routes.firstOrNull()?.id
    }

    val selectedRoute = routes.firstOrNull { it.id == selectedRouteId } ?: routes.firstOrNull()

    if (telemetryFullscreen && selectedRoute != null) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(Bg).padding(10.dp)) {
            TelemetryGraph(
                samples = selectedRoute.samples,
                metric = selectedMetric,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(top = 44.dp)
            )
            Surface(
                Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).size(44.dp).clickable { telemetryFullscreen = false },
                color = Panel.copy(alpha = .94f),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Cyan),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
            ) {
                Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Text("↙", color = Cyan, fontSize = 23.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                }
            }
        }
        return
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(bottom = 10.dp)) {
        Header(null, bluetooth, powerOn)
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            DashboardIconView(DashboardIcon.BARS, Cyan, Modifier.size(28.dp))
            Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
            Column {
                Text("TELEMETRÍA EN DIRECTO", color = Text, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                Text("Datos actuales del BMS y GPS", color = Muted, fontSize = 10.sp)
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))

        if (selectedRoute == null) {
            Surface(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(260.dp).padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                color = Panel,
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp)
            ) {
                Column(
                    Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
                ) {
                    DashboardIconView(DashboardIcon.BARS, Cyan.copy(alpha = .55f), Modifier.size(64.dp))
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(14.dp))
                    Text("Todavía no hay telemetría", color = Text, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                    Text(
                        "Busca una ruta en el mapa y pulsa Play. Los datos se guardarán automáticamente.",
                        color = Muted,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        lineHeight = 17.sp,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                    )
                }
            }
            return@Column
        }

        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp)
        ) {
            routes.forEach { route ->
                val selected = route.id == selectedRoute.id
                Surface(
                    Modifier.clickable { selectedRouteId = route.id },
                    color = if (selected) Cyan else Panel,
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (selected) Cyan else Border),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                ) {
                    Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 13.dp, vertical = 8.dp)) {
                        Text(
                            if (route.live) "● EN DIRECTO" else telemetryRouteDate(route.id),
                            color = if (selected) Bg else if (route.live) Green else Text,
                            fontSize = 10.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Black
                        )
                        Text(
                            "${format1(route.samples.lastOrNull()?.distanceKm ?: 0.0)} km",
                            color = if (selected) Bg.copy(alpha = .78f) else Muted,
                            fontSize = 9.sp
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
        val samples = selectedRoute.samples
        val lastSample = samples.last()
        val maximumSpeed = samples.maxOfOrNull { it.speedKmh } ?: 0.0
        val consumedSoc = ((samples.firstOrNull()?.soc ?: lastSample.soc) - lastSample.soc).coerceAtLeast(0)
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(72.dp).padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp)
        ) {
            TelemetryRouteSummary("DISTANCIA", "${format1(lastSample.distanceKm)} km", Modifier.weight(1f))
            TelemetryRouteSummary("DURACIÓN", telemetryDuration(lastSample.elapsedSeconds), Modifier.weight(1f))
            TelemetryRouteSummary("VEL. MÁX.", "${format1(maximumSpeed)} km/h", Modifier.weight(1f))
            TelemetryRouteSummary(
                "BATERÍA",
                if (selectedRoute.live) "${lastSample.soc} %" else "-$consumedSoc %",
                Modifier.weight(1f)
            )
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
        TelemetryMetric.values().toList().chunked(3).forEach { row ->
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 3.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
            ) {
                row.forEach { metric ->
                    TelemetryMetricButton(metric, metric == selectedMetric, Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        selectedMetric = metric
                    }
                }
                repeat(3 - row.size) { Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f)) }
            }
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(7.dp))
        val values = samples.map { it.metricValue(selectedMetric) }
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(270.dp).padding(horizontal = 12.dp)) {
            TelemetryGraph(
                samples = samples,
                metric = selectedMetric,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
            )
            Surface(
                Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).padding(8.dp).size(40.dp).clickable { telemetryFullscreen = true },
                color = Panel.copy(alpha = .94f),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Cyan),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)
            ) {
                Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Text("↗", color = Cyan, fontSize = 21.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                }
            }
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(9.dp))
        val minimum = values.minOrNull() ?: 0.0
        val maximum = values.maxOrNull() ?: 0.0
        val average = if (values.isEmpty()) 0.0 else values.average()
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(70.dp).padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp)
        ) {
            TelemetryStatCard("MÍNIMO", minimum, selectedMetric, Modifier.weight(1f))
            TelemetryStatCard("MEDIA", average, selectedMetric, Modifier.weight(1f))
            TelemetryStatCard("MÁXIMO", maximum, selectedMetric, Modifier.weight(1f))
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
            color = Panel,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
        ) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(13.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Column {
                    Text("ÚLTIMA LECTURA", color = Muted, fontSize = 9.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Text(
                        "${telemetryValue(lastSample.metricValue(selectedMetric), selectedMetric)} ${selectedMetric.unit}",
                        color = selectedMetric.accent,
                        fontSize = 23.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black
                    )
                }
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
                    Text("${lastSample.soc}% batería", color = Text, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Text("${format1(lastSample.remainingAh)} Ah restantes", color = Muted, fontSize = 10.sp)
                    Text("${samples.size} muestras", color = Muted, fontSize = 9.sp)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun TelemetryGraph(
    samples: List<TelemetrySample>,
    metric: TelemetryMetric,
    modifier: Modifier
) {
    val chartSamples = if (samples.size <= 240) samples else {
        (0 until 240).map { index ->
            samples[(index.toDouble() * samples.lastIndex / 239.0).roundToInt()]
        }
    }
    val chartValues = chartSamples.map { it.metricValue(metric) }
    val minimum = chartValues.minOrNull() ?: 0.0
    val maximum = chartValues.maxOrNull() ?: 0.0
    val middle = (minimum + maximum) / 2.0
    val spread = (maximum - minimum).takeIf { it > 0.0001 } ?: 1.0
    var selectedIndex by remember(metric, chartSamples.size) {
        mutableIntStateOf(chartSamples.lastIndex.coerceAtLeast(0))
    }
    val selectedSample = chartSamples.getOrNull(selectedIndex)
    val selectedValue = chartValues.getOrNull(selectedIndex) ?: 0.0

    fun selectAt(horizontalPosition: Float, width: Float) {
        if (chartSamples.isEmpty()) return
        val leftInset = 52f
        val rightInset = 18f
        val usableWidth = (width - leftInset - rightInset).coerceAtLeast(1f)
        val ratio = ((horizontalPosition - leftInset) / usableWidth).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        selectedIndex = (ratio * chartSamples.lastIndex).roundToInt()
    }

    Surface(
        modifier,
        color = Panel,
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, metric.accent),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
    ) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 10.dp)) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Box(
                    Modifier.size(8.dp).background(metric.accent, CircleShape)
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.width(7.dp))
                Text(
                    metric.label.uppercase(Locale.ROOT),
                    color = metric.accent,
                    fontSize = 10.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    letterSpacing = .7.sp
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
                    Text(
                        "${telemetryValue(selectedValue, metric)} ${metric.unit}",
                        color = Text,
                        fontSize = 19.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black
                    )
                    Text(
                        if (selectedIndex == chartSamples.lastIndex) "ÚLTIMA LECTURA" else "LECTURA SELECCIONADA",
                        color = if (selectedIndex == chartSamples.lastIndex) Green else Muted,
                        fontSize = 7.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        letterSpacing = .6.sp
                    )
                }
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(5.dp))
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .weight(1f)
                    .pointerInput(chartSamples.size, metric) {
                        detectTapGestures { position ->
                            selectAt(position.x, size.width.toFloat())
                        }
                    }
                    .pointerInput(chartSamples.size, metric) {
                        detectDragGestures(
                            onDragStart = { position ->
                                selectAt(position.x, size.width.toFloat())
                            },
                            onDrag = { change, _ ->
                                selectAt(change.position.x, size.width.toFloat())
                                change.consume()
                            }
                        )
                    }
            ) {
                Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                    val left = 52f
                    val right = size.width - 18f
                    val top = 12f
                    val bottom = size.height - 12f

                    repeat(5) { index ->
                        val y = top + (bottom - top) * index / 4f
                        drawLine(
                            Border.copy(alpha = if (index == 0 || index == 4) .34f else .22f),
                            Offset(left, y),
                            Offset(right, y),
                            strokeWidth = 1f
                        )
                    }
                    repeat(7) { index ->
                        val x = left + (right - left) * index / 6f
                        drawLine(
                            Border.copy(alpha = .12f),
                            Offset(x, top),
                            Offset(x, bottom),
                            strokeWidth = 1f
                        )
                    }

                    if (chartValues.isNotEmpty()) {
                        fun point(index: Int, value: Double): Offset {
                            val x = if (chartValues.size == 1) {
                                left
                            } else {
                                left + (right - left) * index / chartValues.lastIndex.toFloat()
                            }
                            val normalized = ((value - minimum) / spread).toFloat()
                            return Offset(x, bottom - normalized * (bottom - top))
                        }

                        val points = chartValues.mapIndexed(::point)
                        val line = Path().apply {
                            moveTo(points.first().x, points.first().y)
                            for (index in 1 until points.size) {
                                val previous = points[index - 1]
                                val current = points[index]
                                val middleX = (previous.x + current.x) / 2f
                                cubicTo(
                                    middleX, previous.y,
                                    middleX, current.y,
                                    current.x, current.y
                                )
                            }
                        }
                        val fill = Path().apply {
                            moveTo(points.first().x, bottom)
                            lineTo(points.first().x, points.first().y)
                            for (index in 1 until points.size) {
                                val previous = points[index - 1]
                                val current = points[index]
                                val middleX = (previous.x + current.x) / 2f
                                cubicTo(
                                    middleX, previous.y,
                                    middleX, current.y,
                                    current.x, current.y
                                )
                            }
                            lineTo(points.last().x, bottom)
                            close()
                        }

                        drawPath(
                            fill,
                            brush = Brush.verticalGradient(
                                listOf(
                                    metric.accent.copy(alpha = .42f),
                                    metric.accent.copy(alpha = .12f),
                                    Color.Transparent
                                ),
                                startY = top,
                                endY = bottom
                            )
                        )
                        drawPath(
                            line,
                            metric.accent.copy(alpha = .18f),
                            style = Stroke(12f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                        )
                        drawPath(
                            line,
                            metric.accent,
                            style = Stroke(3.2f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                        )

                        val minimumIndex = chartValues.indexOfFirst { it == minimum }
                        val maximumIndex = chartValues.indexOfFirst { it == maximum }
                        listOf(minimumIndex, maximumIndex).distinct().forEach { index ->
                            if (index >= 0) {
                                val marker = points[index]
                                drawCircle(Panel, radius = 6.5f, center = marker)
                                drawCircle(metric.accent, radius = 5f, center = marker)
                            }
                        }

                        val cursor = points[selectedIndex.coerceIn(points.indices)]
                        drawLine(
                            metric.accent.copy(alpha = .48f),
                            Offset(cursor.x, top),
                            Offset(cursor.x, bottom),

private fun telemetryValue(value: Double, metric: TelemetryMetric): String = when (metric) {
    TelemetryMetric.POWER,
    TelemetryMetric.BATTERY,
    TelemetryMetric.CELL_DELTA -> value.roundToInt().toString()
    else -> String.format(Locale("es", "ES"), "%.1f", value)
}

private fun telemetryDuration(totalSeconds: Int): String {
    val hours = totalSeconds / 3600
    val minutes = (totalSeconds % 3600) / 60
    return if (hours > 0) "${hours}h ${minutes}m" else "${minutes} min"
}

private fun telemetryRouteDate(timestamp: Long): String {
    return try {
        java.text.SimpleDateFormat("dd MMM · HH:mm", Locale("es", "ES")).format(java.util.Date(timestamp))
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        "Ruta guardada"
    }
}

@Composable
private fun MapScreen(
    s: DemoState,
    session: MapNavigationSession,
    bluetooth: Boolean,
    powerOn: Boolean,
    stopwatchSeconds: Int,
    stopwatchRunning: Boolean,
    navigationActive: Boolean,
    stopwatchOwner: StopwatchOwner,
    gpsDistanceKm: Double,
    gpsMaximumSpeedKmh: Double,
    fullscreen: Boolean,
    orientation: AppOrientation,
    voiceEnabled: Boolean,
    voiceVolume: Float,
    voiceRate: Float,
    onVoiceEnabledChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    currentRouteId: Long?,
    routeRecordingActive: Boolean,
    routeRecordingPaused: Boolean,
    onRecordToggle: () -> Unit,
    onSharedPauseToggle: () -> Unit,
    onFullscreenChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    onResetGpsDistance: () -> Unit,
    onResetTrip: () -> Unit,
    onStopwatchStart: () -> Unit,
    onStopwatchPause: () -> Unit,
    onStopwatchReset: () -> Unit
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
    val keyboardController = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current
    BackHandler(enabled = fullscreen) { onFullscreenChange(false) }
    var query by session.query
    var routingProfile by session.routingProfile
    var satelliteView by session.satelliteView
    var routeData by session.routeData
    var routeStatus by session.routeStatus
    var searching by session.searching
    var currentPosition by session.currentPosition
    var currentInstruction by session.currentInstruction
    var currentInstructionDistanceMeters by session.currentInstructionDistanceMeters
    var instructionIndex by session.instructionIndex
    var currentSpeedKmh by session.currentSpeedKmh
    var currentBearingDegrees by session.currentBearingDegrees
    var altitudeMeters by session.altitudeMeters
    var recenterSignal by session.recenterSignal
    var profileFullscreen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var pendingRoutePhoto by remember { mutableStateOf<Bitmap?>(null) }
    var routePhotoLimitReached by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val routeCameraLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.TakePicturePreview()) { bitmap ->
        if (bitmap != null && currentRouteId != null) {
            val count = loadRoutePhotos(context, currentRouteId!!, System.currentTimeMillis()).size
            if (count >= MAX_ROUTE_PHOTOS) routePhotoLimitReached = true else pendingRoutePhoto = bitmap
        } else {
            pendingRoutePhoto = bitmap
        }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(profileFullscreen) {
        onFullscreenChange(profileFullscreen)
        val activity = context as? ComponentActivity
        activity?.requestedOrientation = if (profileFullscreen) {
            ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        } else {
            when (orientation) {
                AppOrientation.AUTO -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_UNSPECIFIED
                AppOrientation.PORTRAIT -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT
                AppOrientation.LANDSCAPE -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
            }
        }
    }
    BackHandler(enabled = profileFullscreen) {
        profileFullscreen = false
        onFullscreenChange(false)
    }
    var ttsReady by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val textToSpeech = remember(context) { TextToSpeech(context) { status -> ttsReady = status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS } }
    LaunchedEffect(ttsReady) {
        if (ttsReady) {
            textToSpeech.language = Locale("es", "ES")
            textToSpeech.setAudioAttributes(
                AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ASSISTANCE_NAVIGATION_GUIDANCE)
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                    .build()
            )
        }
    }
    DisposableEffect(Unit) {
        onDispose { textToSpeech.shutdown() }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(voiceRate) {
        textToSpeech.setSpeechRate(voiceRate)
    }
    fun speakNavigation(text: String) {
        if (!ttsReady || !voiceEnabled) return
        val params = Bundle().apply {
            putFloat(TextToSpeech.Engine.KEY_PARAM_VOLUME, voiceVolume.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
        }
        textToSpeech.speak(text, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, params, "eskate-navigation")
    }
    LaunchedEffect(navigationActive, routeData) {
        val instructions = routeData?.instructions.orEmpty()
        instructionIndex = if (navigationActive && instructions.size > 1) 1 else 0
        currentInstruction = if (navigationActive) {
            instructions.getOrNull(instructionIndex)?.text ?: "Sigue la ruta marcada"
        } else null
        currentInstructionDistanceMeters = if (navigationActive) {
            val position = currentPosition
            val maneuver = instructions.getOrNull(instructionIndex)
            if (position != null && maneuver != null) distanceBetweenMeters(position, maneuver.location) else null
        } else null
    }
    LaunchedEffect(routeData?.destination, routeData?.profilePoints) {
        val baseRoute = routeData ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        if (baseRoute.profilePoints.size < 2 || baseRoute.highlights.isNotEmpty()) return@LaunchedEffect
        val loadedHighlights = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            runCatching {
                fetchRouteHighlights(
                    baseRoute.profilePoints.map { it.latitude to it.longitude },
                    baseRoute.elevationsMeters
                )
            }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        }
        val currentRoute = routeData
        if (currentRoute?.destination == baseRoute.destination && loadedHighlights.isNotEmpty()) {
            routeData = currentRoute.copy(highlights = loadedHighlights)
        }
    }
    var offRouteSinceMs by remember(routeData?.destination) { mutableStateOf<Long?>(null) }
    var lastRerouteAtMs by remember(routeData?.destination) { mutableStateOf(0L) }
    var rerouting by remember(routeData?.destination) { mutableStateOf(false) }

    LaunchedEffect(currentPosition, navigationActive, routeData?.points, rerouting) {
        if (!navigationActive || !stopwatchRunning || rerouting) return@LaunchedEffect
        val position = currentPosition ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        val currentRoute = routeData ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        if (currentRoute.points.size < 2) return@LaunchedEffect

        val now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        val distanceFromRoute = distanceToRouteMeters(position, currentRoute.points)
        // Do not reroute on ordinary phone-GPS drift. A reroute requires a clear,
        // sustained departure from the actual route segments.
        val leaveThresholdMeters = if (currentRoute.routingProfile == RoutingProfile.TRAIL) 55.0 else 45.0
        val returnThresholdMeters = if (currentRoute.routingProfile == RoutingProfile.TRAIL) 38.0 else 30.0
        if (distanceFromRoute > leaveThresholdMeters) {
            if (offRouteSinceMs == null) offRouteSinceMs = now
        } else if (distanceFromRoute < returnThresholdMeters) {
            offRouteSinceMs = null
        }
        // A genuine missed turn must be caught quickly. GPS drift is still filtered by
        // the segment-distance hysteresis above, but a sustained departure no longer
        // leaves the rider travelling hundreds of metres before a new route is requested.
        val sustainedOffRoute = offRouteSinceMs?.let { now - it >= 6_000L } == true
        if (sustainedOffRoute && now - lastRerouteAtMs >= 20_000L) {
            rerouting = true
            offRouteSinceMs = null
            lastRerouteAtMs = now
            routeStatus = "Recalculando…"
            speakNavigation("Recalculando ruta")
            try {
                routeData = rerouteToDestination(position, currentRoute.destination, currentRoute.routingProfile)
                instructionIndex = if (routeData?.instructions.orEmpty().size > 1) 1 else 0
                currentInstruction = routeData?.instructions?.getOrNull(instructionIndex)?.text
                currentInstructionDistanceMeters = routeData?.instructions?.getOrNull(instructionIndex)
                    ?.let { distanceBetweenMeters(position, it.location) }
                routeStatus = "Ruta recalculada"
                recenterSignal += 1
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                routeStatus = "No se pudo recalcular · seguimos con la ruta actual"
            } finally {
                rerouting = false
            }
        }
    }

    var lastSpokenInstructionIndex by remember(routeData?.destination) { mutableIntStateOf(-1) }
    var lastSpokenDistanceBand by remember(routeData?.destination) { mutableIntStateOf(-1) }
    LaunchedEffect(currentPosition, navigationActive, routeData, instructionIndex, ttsReady, voiceEnabled) {
        if (!navigationActive || !stopwatchRunning) return@LaunchedEffect
        val instructions = routeData?.instructions.orEmpty()
        val position = currentPosition ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        val candidate = instructions.getOrNull(instructionIndex) ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        var maneuverDistance = distanceBetweenMeters(position, candidate.location)

        // GPS updates can jump over the exact manoeuvre point. Do not leave the navigator
        // stuck forever on a turn that is already behind us: if the rider is now clearly
        // closer to the following manoeuvre, advance immediately.
        if (instructionIndex < instructions.lastIndex) {
            val nextDistance = distanceBetweenMeters(position, instructions[instructionIndex + 1].location)
            if (maneuverDistance > 55.0 && nextDistance + 35.0 < maneuverDistance) {
                instructionIndex += 1
                lastSpokenDistanceBand = -1
                val advanced = instructions[instructionIndex]
                currentInstruction = advanced.text
                maneuverDistance = distanceBetweenMeters(position, advanced.location)
            }
        }
        val activeCandidate = instructions.getOrNull(instructionIndex) ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        currentInstructionDistanceMeters = maneuverDistance

        val band = when {
            maneuverDistance <= 40.0 -> 0
            maneuverDistance <= 120.0 -> 1
            maneuverDistance <= 300.0 -> 2
            else -> -1
        }
        if (band >= 0 && (lastSpokenInstructionIndex != instructionIndex || lastSpokenDistanceBand != band)) {
            currentInstruction = activeCandidate.text
            speakNavigation(
                if (band == 0) activeCandidate.text
                else "En ${formatNavigationDistance(maneuverDistance)}, ${activeCandidate.text.lowercase(Locale("es", "ES"))}"
            )
            lastSpokenInstructionIndex = instructionIndex
            lastSpokenDistanceBand = band
        }

        if (maneuverDistance < 25.0 && instructionIndex < instructions.lastIndex) {
            instructionIndex += 1
            lastSpokenDistanceBand = -1
            val next = instructions[instructionIndex]
            currentInstruction = next.text
            currentInstructionDistanceMeters = distanceBetweenMeters(position, next.location)
        }
    }
    var locationGranted by remember {
        mutableStateOf(
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED ||
                ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        )
    }

    val permissionLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()
    ) { result ->
        locationGranted = result.values.any { it }
        if (!locationGranted) routeStatus = "Activa la ubicación para usar el navegador"
    }

    DisposableEffect(locationGranted) {
        val locationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE) as LocationManager
        var lastAcceptedLocation: Location? = null
        val listener = object : LocationListener {
            override fun onLocationChanged(location: Location) {
                if (location.hasAccuracy() && location.accuracy > 30f) return
                if (location.time > 0L && System.currentTimeMillis() - location.time > 15_000L) return
                val rawSpeedKmh = if (location.hasSpeed()) location.speed * 3.6 else 0.0
                val previous = lastAcceptedLocation
                val movedMeters = previous?.distanceTo(location)?.toDouble() ?: Double.MAX_VALUE
                val reportedAccuracyMeters = if (location.hasAccuracy()) location.accuracy.toDouble() else 12.0
                val stationaryHoldMeters = maxOf(18.0, reportedAccuracyMeters * 1.5)
                val stationary = previous != null && rawSpeedKmh < 2.5 && movedMeters < stationaryHoldMeters
                val implausibleStationaryJump = previous != null && rawSpeedKmh < 1.5 && movedMeters <= 60.0
                val holdPosition = stationary || implausibleStationaryJump
                val firstFix = currentPosition == null
                if (!holdPosition) {
                    currentPosition = GpsPoint(location.latitude, location.longitude)
                    lastAcceptedLocation = Location(location)
                }
                currentSpeedKmh = if (holdPosition || rawSpeedKmh < 1.5) 0.0 else rawSpeedKmh
                if (!holdPosition && location.hasBearing() && rawSpeedKmh >= 2.5) currentBearingDegrees = location.bearing
                if (!holdPosition && location.hasAltitude()) altitudeMeters = location.altitude
                if (firstFix && currentPosition != null) {
                    routeStatus = "GPS conectado"
                    recenterSignal += 1
                }
            }
        }

        if (locationGranted) {
            try {
                val activeProvider = when {
                    locationManager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER) -> LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER
                    locationManager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER) -> LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER
                    else -> null
                }
                if (activeProvider != null) {
                    locationManager.getLastKnownLocation(activeProvider)?.let { listener.onLocationChanged(it) }
                    locationManager.requestLocationUpdates(activeProvider, 1000L, 1f, listener, Looper.getMainLooper())
                } else {
                    routeStatus = "Activa el GPS del teléfono"
                }
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                routeStatus = "No se pudo iniciar el GPS"
            }
        }

        onDispose {
            try {
                locationManager.removeUpdates(listener)
            } catch (_: Exception) {
            }
        }
    }

    val stableNavigationRoutePoints = remember(routeData?.destination, navigationActive, routeData?.points, routeData?.profilePoints) {
        val primary = routeData?.points.orEmpty()
        if (primary.size > 1) primary.toList() else routeData?.profilePoints?.toList().orEmpty()
    }
    val visibleRoutePoints = when {
        stableNavigationRoutePoints.size > 1 -> stableNavigationRoutePoints
        routeData?.points.orEmpty().size > 1 -> routeData?.points.orEmpty()
        else -> routeData?.profilePoints.orEmpty()
    }

    val plannedDistanceKm = routeData?.distanceKm ?: 0.0
    val distanceKm = when {
        routeData == null -> gpsDistanceKm
        navigationActive -> remainingRouteDistanceKm(currentPosition, routeData?.points.orEmpty(), plannedDistanceKm)
        else -> plannedDistanceKm
    }
    val distanceLabel = if (routeData != null) "DISTANCIA AL DESTINO" else "DISTANCIA"
    val estimatedMinutes = routeData?.durationMinutes ?: 0
    val energyKwh = plannedDistanceKm * s.whKm / 1000.0

    if (profileFullscreen) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(Bg)) {
            RouteProfilePanel(
                routeData = routeData,
                currentPosition = currentPosition,
                currentSpeedKmh = currentSpeedKmh,
                currentBatteryPercent = s.soc,
                currentGpsAltitudeMeters = altitudeMeters,
                expanded = true,
                onClick = { }
            )
            Surface(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).padding(14.dp).size(46.dp).clickable {
                    profileFullscreen = false

@Composable
private fun StopwatchActionButton(
    action: StopwatchAction,
    active: Boolean,
    enabled: Boolean,
    blinkWhenActive: Boolean = false,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    var blinkVisible by remember(action, active, blinkWhenActive) { mutableStateOf(true) }
    LaunchedEffect(action, active, blinkWhenActive) {
        blinkVisible = true
        while (action == StopwatchAction.PAUSE && active && blinkWhenActive) {
            delay(450L)
            blinkVisible = !blinkVisible
        }
        blinkVisible = true
    }
    val accent = when (action) {
        StopwatchAction.START -> Green
        StopwatchAction.PAUSE -> Orange
        StopwatchAction.RESET -> Red
    }
    val visibleAccent = if (enabled || active) accent else Muted.copy(alpha = .55f)
    val pauseBlinking = action == StopwatchAction.PAUSE && active && blinkWhenActive
    val renderedAccent = if (pauseBlinking && !blinkVisible) Red.copy(alpha = .20f) else if (pauseBlinking) Red else visibleAccent

    Surface(
        modifier = Modifier.size(30.dp).clickable(enabled = enabled) { onClick() },
        color = if (active) renderedAccent.copy(alpha = if (pauseBlinking && blinkVisible) .42f else .18f) else Color.Transparent,
        border = BorderStroke(if (pauseBlinking && blinkVisible) 2.dp else 1.dp, renderedAccent),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)
    ) {
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(7.dp)) {
            val iconAccent = if (pauseBlinking) renderedAccent else visibleAccent
            when (action) {
                StopwatchAction.START -> {
                    val play = Path().apply {
                        moveTo(size.width * .30f, size.height * .16f)
                        lineTo(size.width * .82f, size.height * .50f)
                        lineTo(size.width * .30f, size.height * .84f)
                        close()
                    }
                    drawPath(play, iconAccent)
                }
                StopwatchAction.PAUSE -> {
                    drawRoundRect(
                        color = iconAccent,
                        topLeft = Offset(size.width * .20f, size.height * .14f),
                        size = Size(size.width * .20f, size.height * .72f),
                        cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(2f, 2f)
                    )
                    drawRoundRect(
                        color = iconAccent,
                        topLeft = Offset(size.width * .60f, size.height * .14f),
                        size = Size(size.width * .20f, size.height * .72f),
                        cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(2f, 2f)
                    )
                }
                StopwatchAction.RESET -> {
                    // STOP + reset: the square makes "finish" unmistakable while the
                    // circular arrow keeps the existing "put everything back to zero" meaning.
                    drawRoundRect(
                        color = visibleAccent,
                        topLeft = Offset(size.width * .29f, size.height * .29f),
                        size = Size(size.width * .42f, size.height * .42f),
                        cornerRadius = CornerRadius(2f, 2f),
                        style = Stroke(width = size.minDimension * .10f)
                    )
                    drawArc(
                        color = visibleAccent,
                        startAngle = -55f,
                        sweepAngle = 285f,
                        useCenter = false,
                        style = Stroke(width = size.minDimension * .11f)
                    )
                    val arrow = Path().apply {
                        moveTo(size.width * .13f, size.height * .26f)
                        lineTo(size.width * .13f, size.height * .57f)
                        lineTo(size.width * .39f, size.height * .41f)
                        close()
                    }
                    drawPath(arrow, visibleAccent)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun LiveMapPanel(
    currentPosition: GpsPoint?,
    destination: GpsPoint?,
    routePoints: List<GpsPoint>,
    navigationActive: Boolean,
    bearingDegrees: Float,
    instruction: String?,
    instructionDistanceMeters: Double?,
    status: String,
    locationGranted: Boolean,
    recenterSignal: Int,
    fullscreen: Boolean,
    satellite: Boolean,
    onToggleSatellite: () -> Unit,
    onToggleFullscreen: () -> Unit,
    onRequestPermission: () -> Unit,
    onRecenter: () -> Unit
) {
    if (!locationGranted) {
        Surface(
            if (fullscreen) Modifier.fillMaxSize() else Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 10.dp).height(260.dp),
            color = Panel,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Orange),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
        ) {
            Column(
                Modifier.fillMaxSize().clickable { onRequestPermission() },
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
            ) {
                DashboardIconView(DashboardIcon.ROUTE, Cyan, Modifier.size(42.dp))
                Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                Text("PERMISO DE UBICACIÓN", color = Text, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(5.dp))
                Text("Toca aquí para activar el mapa GPS", color = Color(0xFFA9C4FF), fontSize = 10.sp)
            }
        }
        return
    }

    var mapCenter by remember { mutableStateOf(currentPosition ?: GpsPoint(39.4699, -0.3763)) }
    var mapZoom by remember { mutableIntStateOf(15) }
    var centeredOnGps by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var followGps by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }

    LaunchedEffect(currentPosition, navigationActive, followGps) {
        currentPosition?.let {
            if (navigationActive || followGps) {
                mapCenter = it
                if (!centeredOnGps) {
                    mapZoom = if (navigationActive) 17 else 17
                    centeredOnGps = true
                }
            }
        }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(routePoints, navigationActive) {
        if (!navigationActive && routePoints.size > 1) {
            val minLat = routePoints.minOf { it.latitude }
            val maxLat = routePoints.maxOf { it.latitude }
            val minLon = routePoints.minOf { it.longitude }
            val maxLon = routePoints.maxOf { it.longitude }
            followGps = false
            mapCenter = GpsPoint((minLat + maxLat) / 2.0, (minLon + maxLon) / 2.0)
            mapZoom = chooseRouteZoom(minLat, maxLat, minLon, maxLon)
        }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(recenterSignal) {
        currentPosition?.let {
            followGps = true
            mapCenter = it
            mapZoom = if (navigationActive) 17 else 17
        }
    }

    val tileX = floor(longitudeToWorldX(mapCenter.longitude, mapZoom) / 256.0).toInt()

@Composable
private fun MapLibreCarNavigation(
    currentPosition: GpsPoint,
    routePoints: List<GpsPoint>,
    bearingDegrees: Float,
    satellite: Boolean,
    recenterSignal: Int
) {
    // Visual navigation intentionally trails real GPS by ~1 s. Statistics, alerts,
    // voice and recorded telemetry continue to use currentPosition directly.
    data class VisualGpsFix(val point: GpsPoint, val bearing: Float, val receivedAtMs: Long)
    val visualFixes = remember { mutableStateListOf<VisualGpsFix>() }
    var visualPosition by remember { mutableStateOf(currentPosition) }
    var visualBearing by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(bearingDegrees) }

    LaunchedEffect(currentPosition, bearingDegrees) {
        val now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        visualFixes.add(VisualGpsFix(currentPosition, bearingDegrees, now))
        while (visualFixes.size > 6) visualFixes.removeAt(0)
    }

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        val visualDelayMs = 1000L
        while (true) {
            val targetTime = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - visualDelayMs
            if (visualFixes.isNotEmpty()) {
                var older = visualFixes.first()
                var newer = visualFixes.last()
                for (i in 0 until visualFixes.lastIndex) {
                    val a = visualFixes[i]
                    val b = visualFixes[i + 1]
                    if (targetTime in a.receivedAtMs..b.receivedAtMs) {
                        older = a
                        newer = b
                        break
                    }
                }
                val span = (newer.receivedAtMs - older.receivedAtMs).coerceAtLeast(1L)
                val t = ((targetTime - older.receivedAtMs).toDouble() / span.toDouble()).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
                val interpolatedPosition = GpsPoint(
                    older.point.latitude + (newer.point.latitude - older.point.latitude) * t,
                    older.point.longitude + (newer.point.longitude - older.point.longitude) * t
                )
                // Keep the proven ~1 s interpolation, but visually snap normal GPS drift
                // to the planned route. Real departures remain visible and are not hidden.
                val projection = nearestNavigationRouteProjection(interpolatedPosition, routePoints)
                visualPosition = if (projection != null && projection.distanceMeters <= 30.0) {
                    projection.point
                } else {
                    interpolatedPosition
                }
                val deltaBearing = (((newer.bearing - older.bearing + 540f) % 360f) - 180f)
                visualBearing = (older.bearing + deltaBearing * t.toFloat() + 360f) % 360f
            }
            delay(33L)
        }
    }
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var mapLibreMap by remember(satellite) { mutableStateOf<MapLibreMap?>(null) }
    var routePolyline by remember(satellite) { mutableStateOf<Polyline?>(null) }
    val mapView = remember(context, satellite) {
        MapLibre.getInstance(context)
        MapView(context).apply { onCreate(null) }
    }

    DisposableEffect(mapView) {
        mapView.onStart()
        mapView.onResume()
        onDispose {
            mapView.onPause()
            mapView.onStop()
            mapView.onDestroy()
        }
    }

    AndroidView(
        factory = {
            mapView.apply {
                getMapAsync { map ->
                    map.uiSettings.isCompassEnabled = false
                    map.uiSettings.isLogoEnabled = true
                    map.uiSettings.isAttributionEnabled = true
                    val styleBuilder = if (satellite) {
                        Style.Builder().fromJson(ESKATE_SATELLITE_STYLE)
                    } else {
                        Style.Builder().fromUri(ESKATE_MOUNTAIN_STYLE_URL)
                    }
                    map.setStyle(styleBuilder) {
                        mapLibreMap = map
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
    )

    val persistentRoutePoints = remember(routePoints) { routePoints.toList() }
    LaunchedEffect(mapLibreMap, persistentRoutePoints) {
        val map = mapLibreMap ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        routePolyline?.let { try { map.removePolyline(it) } catch (_: Exception) {} }
        routePolyline = if (persistentRoutePoints.size > 1) {
            map.addPolyline(
                PolylineOptions()
                    .addAll(persistentRoutePoints.map { LatLng(it.latitude, it.longitude) })
                    .color(android.graphics.Color.rgb(19, 207, 255))
                    .width(12f)
            )
        } else null
    }

    LaunchedEffect(mapLibreMap, visualPosition, visualBearing, recenterSignal) {
        val map = mapLibreMap ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        val cameraTarget = pointAhead(visualPosition, visualBearing, 55.0)
        val targetCamera = CameraPosition.Builder()
            .target(LatLng(cameraTarget.latitude, cameraTarget.longitude))
            .zoom(18.0)
            .tilt(62.0)
            .bearing(visualBearing.toDouble())
            .build()
        // The visual position is already interpolated at ~30 fps, so use a tiny camera
        // transition rather than stacking long animations between raw GPS fixes.
        map.animateCamera(CameraUpdateFactory.newCameraPosition(targetCamera), 45)
    }
}

private fun pointAhead(start: GpsPoint, bearingDegrees: Float, distanceMeters: Double): GpsPoint {
    val bearing = bearingDegrees * PI / 180.0
    val latitudeOffset = distanceMeters * cos(bearing) / 111320.0
    val longitudeScale = (111320.0 * cos(start.latitude * PI / 180.0)).coerceAtLeast(1.0)
    val longitudeOffset = distanceMeters * sin(bearing) / longitudeScale
    return GpsPoint(start.latitude + latitudeOffset, start.longitude + longitudeOffset)
}

private fun formatNavigationDistance(distanceMeters: Double?): String {
    if (distanceMeters == null) return "—"
    return if (distanceMeters < 1000.0) {
        "${(distanceMeters / 10.0).roundToInt() * 10} m"
    } else {
        "${format1(distanceMeters / 1000.0)} km"
    }
}

private suspend fun loadMapTiles(zoom: Int, centerX: Int, centerY: Int, satellite: Boolean): List<LoadedMapTile> =
    withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val count = 1 shl zoom
        val loaded = mutableListOf<LoadedMapTile>()
        for (dy in -2..2) {
            val y = centerY + dy
            if (y !in 0 until count) continue
            for (dx in -2..2) {
                val rawX = centerX + dx
                val x = ((rawX % count) + count) % count
                try {
                    val tileUrl = if (satellite) {
                        "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/" + zoom + "/" + y + "/" + x
                    } else {
                        "https://tile.openstreetmap.org/" + zoom + "/" + x + "/" + y + ".png"
                    }
                    val connection = URL(tileUrl).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
                    connection.connectTimeout = 8000
                    connection.readTimeout = 12000
                    connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "E-SKATE-Skatesuv/0.4 Android")
                    connection.inputStream.use { input ->
                        BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input)?.asImageBitmap()?.let {
                            loaded.add(LoadedMapTile(MapTileKey(zoom, x, y, rawX), it))
                        }
                    }
                    connection.disconnect()
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                }
            }
        }
        loaded
    }


private fun longitudeToWorldX(lon: Double, zoom: Int): Double =
    (lon + 180.0) / 360.0 * 256.0 * (1 shl zoom)

private fun latitudeToWorldY(lat: Double, zoom: Int): Double {
    val radians = lat.coerceIn(-85.0511, 85.0511) * PI / 180.0
    return (1.0 - ln(tan(radians) + 1.0 / cos(radians)) / PI) / 2.0 * 256.0 * (1 shl zoom)
}

private fun worldXToLongitude(worldX: Double, zoom: Int): Double =
    worldX / (256.0 * (1 shl zoom)) * 360.0 - 180.0

private fun worldYToLatitude(worldY: Double, zoom: Int): Double {
    val n = PI - 2.0 * PI * worldY / (256.0 * (1 shl zoom))
    return 180.0 / PI * atan(sinh(n))
}

private fun chooseRouteZoom(minLat: Double, maxLat: Double, minLon: Double, maxLon: Double): Int {
    for (zoom in 17 downTo 3) {
        val width = abs(longitudeToWorldX(maxLon, zoom) - longitudeToWorldX(minLon, zoom))
        val height = abs(latitudeToWorldY(maxLat, zoom) - latitudeToWorldY(minLat, zoom))
        if (width < 520.0 && height < 330.0) return zoom
    }
    return 3
}

private fun buildRoadRouteUrl(start: GpsPoint, destination: GpsPoint): String =
    "https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/" +
        "${start.longitude},${start.latitude};${destination.longitude},${destination.latitude}" +
        "?overview=full&geometries=geojson&steps=true"

private fun decodeValhallaPolyline6(encoded: String): List<GpsPoint> {
    if (encoded.isBlank()) return emptyList()
    val points = mutableListOf<GpsPoint>()
    var index = 0
    var latitude = 0
    var longitude = 0
    while (index < encoded.length) {
        fun nextDelta(): Int {
            var result = 0
            var shift = 0
            var value: Int
            do {
                value = encoded[index++].code - 63
                result = result or ((value and 0x1f) shl shift)
                shift += 5
            } while (value >= 0x20 && index < encoded.length)
            return if (result and 1 != 0) (result shr 1).inv() else result shr 1
        }
        latitude += nextDelta()
        longitude += nextDelta()
        points += GpsPoint(latitude / 1_000_000.0, longitude / 1_000_000.0)
    }
    return points
}

private suspend fun findRoute(
    start: GpsPoint,
    query: String,
    profile: RoutingProfile = RoutingProfile.ROAD
): RouteData = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
    val encodedQuery = URLEncoder.encode(query, StandardCharsets.UTF_8.toString())
    val searchUrl = "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&limit=8&countrycodes=es&q=$encodedQuery"
    val searchResults = JSONArray(httpGet(searchUrl))
    if (searchResults.length() == 0) error("Destination not found")

    // Hay muchos municipios con nombres repetidos en España. Elegimos el resultado
    // geocodificado más cercano al GPS actual para no mandar al usuario a otra provincia.
    val destination = (0 until searchResults.length())
        .mapNotNull { index ->
            runCatching {
                val item = searchResults.getJSONObject(index)
                GpsPoint(item.getString("lat").toDouble(), item.getString("lon").toDouble())
            }.getOrNull()
        }
        .minByOrNull { distanceBetweenMeters(start, it) }
        ?: error("Destination not found")

    if (profile == RoutingProfile.ROAD) {
        parseRoadRoute(httpGet(buildRoadRouteUrl(start, destination)), destination)
    } else {
        val cityReference = runCatching {
            parseRoadRoute(httpGet(buildRoadRouteUrl(start, destination)), destination)
        }.getOrNull()
        parseTrailRoute(start, destination, cityReference)
    }
}

private suspend fun rerouteToDestination(
    start: GpsPoint,
    destination: GpsPoint,
    profile: RoutingProfile = RoutingProfile.ROAD
): RouteData = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
    if (profile == RoutingProfile.ROAD) {
        parseRoadRoute(httpGet(buildRoadRouteUrl(start, destination)), destination)
    } else {
        val cityReference = runCatching {
            parseRoadRoute(httpGet(buildRoadRouteUrl(start, destination)), destination)
        }.getOrNull()
        parseTrailRoute(start, destination, cityReference)
    }
}

private fun parseRoadRoute(response: String, destination: GpsPoint): RouteData {
    val routeRoot = JSONObject(response)
    val routes = routeRoot.getJSONArray("routes")
    if (routes.length() == 0) error("Route not found")
    val route = routes.getJSONObject(0)
    val coordinates = route.getJSONObject("geometry").getJSONArray("coordinates")
    val points = ArrayList<GpsPoint>(coordinates.length())
    for (index in 0 until coordinates.length()) {
        val coordinate = coordinates.getJSONArray(index)
        points.add(GpsPoint(coordinate.getDouble(1), coordinate.getDouble(0)))
    }
    val instructions = mutableListOf<NavigationInstruction>()
    val legs = route.optJSONArray("legs")
    if (legs != null) {
        for (legIndex in 0 until legs.length()) {
            val steps = legs.getJSONObject(legIndex).optJSONArray("steps") ?: continue
            for (stepIndex in 0 until steps.length()) {
                val step = steps.getJSONObject(stepIndex)
                val maneuver = step.optJSONObject("maneuver") ?: continue
                val location = maneuver.optJSONArray("location") ?: continue
                instructions += NavigationInstruction(
                    GpsPoint(location.getDouble(1), location.getDouble(0)),
                    navigationText(maneuver.optString("type"), maneuver.optString("modifier"), step.optString("name"))
                )
            }
        }
    }
    val profilePoints = sampleRoutePoints(points, 72)
    val elevationsMeters = runCatching { fetchRouteElevations(profilePoints) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
    return RouteData(
        destination = destination,
        routingProfile = RoutingProfile.ROAD,
        points = points,
        distanceKm = route.getDouble("distance") / 1000.0,
        durationMinutes = (route.getDouble("duration") / 60.0).roundToInt(),
        instructions = instructions,
        profilePoints = profilePoints,
        elevationsMeters = elevationsMeters,
        highlights = emptyList()
    )
}

private fun parseTrailRoute(
    start: GpsPoint,
    destination: GpsPoint,
    cityReference: RouteData? = null
): RouteData {
    val candidates = buildList {
        runCatching { requestTrailRoute(start, destination, TrailVariant.MOUNTAIN) }.getOrNull()?.let(::add)
        runCatching { requestTrailRoute(start, destination, TrailVariant.HYBRID) }.getOrNull()?.let(::add)
        runCatching { requestTrailRoute(start, destination, TrailVariant.ADVENTURE) }.getOrNull()?.let(::add)
    }
    if (candidates.isEmpty()) error("Route not found")

    val cityPoints = cityReference?.points.orEmpty()
    val cityDistanceKm = cityReference?.distanceKm?.takeIf { it > 0.1 }

    // No basta con cambiar el nombre del perfil: elegimos el candidato que de verdad
    // se separa más del corredor de carretera, siempre que no haga un rodeo absurdo.
    return candidates.minByOrNull { candidate ->
        val overlap = if (cityPoints.size > 1) routeOverlapRatio(candidate.points, cityPoints) else 0.5
        val detourPenalty = cityDistanceKm?.let { cityKm ->
            ((candidate.distanceKm / cityKm) - 1.65).coerceAtLeast(0.0) * 0.8
        } ?: 0.0
        overlap + detourPenalty
    } ?: candidates.first()
}

private enum class TrailVariant { MOUNTAIN, HYBRID, ADVENTURE }

private fun requestTrailRoute(start: GpsPoint, destination: GpsPoint, variant: TrailVariant): RouteData {
    val routeRequest = JSONObject().apply {
        put("locations", JSONArray().apply {
            put(JSONObject().apply {
                put("lat", start.latitude)
                put("lon", start.longitude)
                put("type", "break")
            })
            put(JSONObject().apply {
                put("lat", destination.latitude)
                put("lon", destination.longitude)
                put("type", "break")
            })
        })
        val adventure = variant == TrailVariant.ADVENTURE
        put("costing", if (adventure) "motorcycle" else "bicycle")
        put("costing_options", JSONObject().apply {
            if (adventure) {
                put("motorcycle", JSONObject().apply {
                    put("use_trails", 1.0)
                    put("use_highways", 0.0)
                    put("use_tolls", 0.0)
                    put("use_ferry", 0.0)
                })
            } else {
                put("bicycle", JSONObject().apply {
                    put("bicycle_type", if (variant == TrailVariant.MOUNTAIN) "mountain" else "hybrid")
                    put("use_roads", if (variant == TrailVariant.MOUNTAIN) 0.0 else 0.18)
                    put("use_hills", if (variant == TrailVariant.MOUNTAIN) 0.65 else 0.40)
                    put("use_ferry", 0.0)
                    put("avoid_bad_surfaces", 0.0)
                })
            }
        })
        put("directions_options", JSONObject().apply {
            put("language", "es-ES")
            put("units", "kilometers")
        })
    }

    val routeRoot = JSONObject(
        httpPostJson("https://valhalla1.openstreetmap.de/route", routeRequest.toString())
    )
    val trip = routeRoot.optJSONObject("trip") ?: error("Route not found")
    val legs = trip.optJSONArray("legs") ?: error("Route not found")
    if (legs.length() == 0) error("Route not found")

    val points = mutableListOf<GpsPoint>()
    val instructions = mutableListOf<NavigationInstruction>()
    for (legIndex in 0 until legs.length()) {
        val leg = legs.getJSONObject(legIndex)
        val legPoints = decodeValhallaPolyline6(leg.optString("shape"))
        val pointOffset = points.size
        if (points.isNotEmpty() && legPoints.isNotEmpty() && points.last() == legPoints.first()) {
            points.addAll(legPoints.drop(1))
        } else {
            points.addAll(legPoints)
        }
        val maneuvers = leg.optJSONArray("maneuvers") ?: continue
        for (maneuverIndex in 0 until maneuvers.length()) {
            val maneuver = maneuvers.getJSONObject(maneuverIndex)
            val beginIndex = (pointOffset + maneuver.optInt("begin_shape_index", 0))
                .coerceIn(0, points.lastIndex.coerceAtLeast(0))
            val location = points.getOrNull(beginIndex) ?: continue
            val text = maneuver.optString("verbal_pre_transition_instruction")
                .takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                ?: maneuver.optString("instruction").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                ?: "Continúa por la ruta"
            instructions.add(NavigationInstruction(location, text))
        }
    }
    if (points.isEmpty()) error("Route geometry missing")

    val summary = trip.optJSONObject("summary")
    val profilePoints = sampleRoutePoints(points, 72)
    val elevationsMeters = runCatching { fetchRouteElevations(profilePoints) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
    return RouteData(
        destination = destination,
        routingProfile = RoutingProfile.TRAIL,
        points = points,
        distanceKm = summary?.optDouble("length", 0.0) ?: 0.0,
        durationMinutes = ((summary?.optDouble("time", 0.0) ?: 0.0) / 60.0).roundToInt(),
        instructions = instructions,
        profilePoints = profilePoints,
        elevationsMeters = elevationsMeters,
        highlights = emptyList()
    )
}

private fun routeOverlapRatio(candidate: List<GpsPoint>, road: List<GpsPoint>): Double {
    if (candidate.size < 2 || road.size < 2) return 1.0
    val samples = sampleRoutePoints(candidate, 80)
    val close = samples.count { point -> distanceToRouteMeters(point, road) <= 45.0 }
    return close.toDouble() / samples.size.coerceAtLeast(1)
}

private data class NavigationRouteProjection(val point: GpsPoint, val distanceMeters: Double)

private fun nearestNavigationRouteProjection(position: GpsPoint, points: List<GpsPoint>): NavigationRouteProjection? {
    if (points.isEmpty()) return null
    if (points.size == 1) return NavigationRouteProjection(points.first(), distanceBetweenMeters(position, points.first()))

    val latScale = 111320.0
    val lonScale = 111320.0 * cos(position.latitude * PI / 180.0).coerceAtLeast(0.01)
    var bestPoint = points.first()
    var bestDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE

    for (index in 0 until points.lastIndex) {
        val a = points[index]
        val b = points[index + 1]
        val ax = (a.longitude - position.longitude) * lonScale
        val ay = (a.latitude - position.latitude) * latScale
        val bx = (b.longitude - position.longitude) * lonScale
        val by = (b.latitude - position.latitude) * latScale
        val dx = bx - ax
        val dy = by - ay
        val lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy
        val t = if (lengthSquared <= 0.0001) 0.0 else (-(ax * dx + ay * dy) / lengthSquared).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
        val px = ax + dx * t
        val py = ay + dy * t
        val distance = kotlin.math.sqrt(px * px + py * py)
        if (distance < bestDistance) {
            bestDistance = distance
            bestPoint = GpsPoint(
                a.latitude + (b.latitude - a.latitude) * t,
                a.longitude + (b.longitude - a.longitude) * t
            )
        }
    }
    return NavigationRouteProjection(bestPoint, bestDistance)
}

private fun distanceToRouteMeters(position: GpsPoint, points: List<GpsPoint>): Double =
    nearestNavigationRouteProjection(position, points)?.distanceMeters ?: Double.MAX_VALUE

private fun upcomingRouteGradePercent(position: GpsPoint, points: List<GpsPoint>, elevations: List<Double>, lookAheadMeters: Double = 120.0): Double? {
    if (points.size < 2 || elevations.size != points.size) return null
    var nearestIndex = 0
    var nearestDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE
    points.forEachIndexed { index, point ->
        val distance = distanceBetweenMeters(position, point)
        if (distance < nearestDistance) { nearestDistance = distance; nearestIndex = index }
    }
    if (nearestDistance > 80.0 || nearestIndex >= points.lastIndex) return null
    var distanceAhead = 0.0
    var endIndex = nearestIndex
    while (endIndex < points.lastIndex && distanceAhead < lookAheadMeters) {
        distanceAhead += distanceBetweenMeters(points[endIndex], points[endIndex + 1])
        endIndex += 1
    }
    if (distanceAhead < 35.0 || endIndex <= nearestIndex) return null
    return ((elevations[endIndex] - elevations[nearestIndex]) / distanceAhead) * 100.0
}

private fun remainingRouteDistanceKm(position: GpsPoint?, points: List<GpsPoint>, fallbackKm: Double): Double {
    if (position == null || points.size < 2) return fallbackKm.coerceAtLeast(0.0)

    val latScale = 111320.0
    val lonScale = 111320.0 * cos(position.latitude * PI / 180.0).coerceAtLeast(0.01)
    var bestSegment = 0
    var bestT = 0.0
    var bestDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE

    for (index in 0 until points.lastIndex) {
        val a = points[index]
        val b = points[index + 1]
        val ax = (a.longitude - position.longitude) * lonScale
        val ay = (a.latitude - position.latitude) * latScale
        val bx = (b.longitude - position.longitude) * lonScale
        val by = (b.latitude - position.latitude) * latScale
        val dx = bx - ax
        val dy = by - ay
        val lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy
        val t = if (lengthSquared <= 0.0001) 0.0 else (-(ax * dx + ay * dy) / lengthSquared).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
        val px = ax + dx * t
        val py = ay + dy * t
        val distance = kotlin.math.sqrt(px * px + py * py)
        if (distance < bestDistance) {
            bestDistance = distance
            bestSegment = index
            bestT = t
        }
    }

    var remainingMeters = distanceBetweenMeters(points[bestSegment], points[bestSegment + 1]) * (1.0 - bestT)
    for (index in bestSegment + 1 until points.lastIndex) {
        remainingMeters += distanceBetweenMeters(points[index], points[index + 1])
    }
    return (remainingMeters / 1000.0).coerceIn(0.0, fallbackKm.coerceAtLeast(remainingMeters / 1000.0))
}

private fun sampleRoutePoints(points: List<GpsPoint>, maximumPoints: Int): List<GpsPoint> {
    if (points.size <= maximumPoints) return points
    return (0 until maximumPoints).map { index ->
        points[(index * (points.lastIndex.toDouble() / (maximumPoints - 1))).roundToInt()]
    }
}

private fun fetchRouteElevations(points: List<GpsPoint>): List<Double> {
    if (points.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
    val latitudes = points.joinToString(",") { String.format(Locale.US, "%.6f", it.latitude) }
    val longitudes = points.joinToString(",") { String.format(Locale.US, "%.6f", it.longitude) }
    val root = JSONObject(
        httpGet("https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/elevation?latitude=$latitudes&longitude=$longitudes")
    )
    val values = root.optJSONArray("elevation") ?: return emptyList()
    if (values.length() != points.size) return emptyList()
    return (0 until values.length()).map { values.optDouble(it) }
}

private fun navigationText(type: String, modifier: String, road: String): String {
    val roadText = road.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { " por $it" } ?: ""
    return when (type) {
        "depart" -> "Sal de tu ubicación$roadText"
        "arrive" -> "Has llegado a tu destino"
        "roundabout" -> "En la rotonda, continúa$roadText"
        "turn" -> when (modifier) {
            "left", "sharp left", "slight left" -> "Gira a la izquierda$roadText"
            "right", "sharp right", "slight right" -> "Gira a la derecha$roadText"
            else -> "Continúa recto$roadText"
        }
        "merge" -> "Incorpórate$roadText"
        "on ramp", "off ramp" -> "Toma la salida$roadText"
        else -> "Continúa$roadText"
    }
}

private fun httpGet(urlText: String): String {
    val connection = URL(urlText).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
    return try {
        connection.connectTimeout = 12000
        connection.readTimeout = 15000
        connection.requestMethod = "GET"
        connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "E-SKATE-Skatesuv/0.2")
        connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Language", "es")
        connection.inputStream.bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
    } finally {
        connection.disconnect()
    }
}

private fun httpPostJson(urlText: String, body: String): String {
    val connection = URL(urlText).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
    return try {
        connection.connectTimeout = 12000
        connection.readTimeout = 15000
        connection.requestMethod = "POST"
        connection.doOutput = true
        connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Language", "es")
        connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "E-SKATE-Skatesuv/0.2")
        connection.setRequestProperty("X-Client-Id", "e-skate-skatesuv")
        connection.outputStream.bufferedWriter(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).use { it.write(body) }
        val stream = if (connection.responseCode in 200..299) connection.inputStream else connection.errorStream
        val response = stream?.bufferedReader()?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
        if (connection.responseCode !in 200..299) error("Routing HTTP ${connection.responseCode}: $response")
        response
    } finally {
        connection.disconnect()
    }
}

private fun distanceBetweenMeters(a: GpsPoint, b: GpsPoint): Double {
    val results = FloatArray(1)
    Location.distanceBetween(a.latitude, a.longitude, b.latitude, b.longitude, results)
    return results[0].toDouble()
}

private fun format2(value: Double): String = String.format("%.2f", value).replace('.', ',')

@Composable
private fun RouteProfilePanel(
    routeData: RouteData?,
    currentPosition: GpsPoint?,
    currentSpeedKmh: Double = 0.0,
    currentBatteryPercent: Int = 0,
    currentGpsAltitudeMeters: Double? = null,
    expanded: Boolean = false,
    onClick: (() -> Unit)? = null
) {
    val elevations = routeData?.elevationsMeters.orEmpty()
    val profilePoints = routeData?.profilePoints.orEmpty()
    val usableCount = minOf(elevations.size, profilePoints.size)
    val usableElevations = elevations.take(usableCount)
    val usablePoints = profilePoints.take(usableCount)
    val totalDistanceKm = routeData?.distanceKm ?: 0.0

    val nearestIndex = if (currentPosition != null && usablePoints.isNotEmpty()) {
        usablePoints.indices.minByOrNull { distanceBetweenMeters(currentPosition, usablePoints[it]) }
    } else null
    val nearestDistance = if (nearestIndex != null && currentPosition != null) {
        distanceBetweenMeters(currentPosition, usablePoints[nearestIndex])
    } else Double.MAX_VALUE
    val progressIndex = if (nearestDistance <= 1000.0) nearestIndex ?: 0 else 0
    val progress = if (usableCount > 1) progressIndex.toFloat() / (usableCount - 1) else 0f
    val progressPercent = (progress * 100f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 100)

    val minimumAltitude = usableElevations.minOrNull() ?: 0.0
    val maximumAltitude = usableElevations.maxOrNull() ?: 0.0
    val maximumIndex = usableElevations.indexOfFirst { it == maximumAltitude }.coerceAtLeast(0)
    val ascent = usableElevations.zipWithNext().sumOf { (a, b) -> (b - a).coerceAtLeast(0.0) }
    val descent = usableElevations.zipWithNext().sumOf { (a, b) -> (a - b).coerceAtLeast(0.0) }
    val currentAltitude = usableElevations.getOrNull(progressIndex)
    val routeHighlights = routeData?.highlights.orEmpty()
        .mapNotNull { highlight ->
            if (usableCount <= 0) null else highlight.copy(profileIndex = highlight.profileIndex.coerceIn(0, usableCount - 1))
        }
    val adaptivePeaks = adaptiveElevationPeaks(usableElevations)
    val namedPeakIndices = routeHighlights.filter { it.kind == RouteHighlightKind.PEAK }.map { it.profileIndex }
    val unnamedPeaks = adaptivePeaks.filter { index -> namedPeakIndices.none { abs(it - index) <= 2 } }
    val cumulativeDistanceKm = buildList {
        if (usablePoints.isNotEmpty()) {
            add(0.0)
            var total = 0.0
            for (index in 1 until usablePoints.size) {
                total += distanceBetweenMeters(usablePoints[index - 1], usablePoints[index]) / 1000.0
                add(total)
            }
        }
    }
    val sampledDistanceKm = cumulativeDistanceKm.lastOrNull()?.takeIf { it > 0.0 } ?: totalDistanceKm
    fun routeKmAt(index: Int): Double {
        if (usableCount <= 1) return 0.0
        val sampled = cumulativeDistanceKm.getOrNull(index) ?: 0.0
        return if (sampledDistanceKm > 0.0) sampled / sampledDistanceKm * totalDistanceKm else 0.0
    }
    fun niceKmStep(totalKm: Double): Double {
        if (totalKm <= 0.0) return 1.0
        val raw = totalKm / 10.0
        val magnitude = 10.0.pow(kotlin.math.floor(kotlin.math.log10(raw)))
        val normalized = raw / magnitude
        val nice = when {
            normalized <= 1.0 -> 1.0
            normalized <= 2.0 -> 2.0
            normalized <= 5.0 -> 5.0
            else -> 10.0
        }
        return nice * magnitude
    }

    Surface(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(horizontal = if (expanded) 0.dp else 10.dp)
            .then(if (expanded) Modifier.fillMaxHeight() else Modifier.height(150.dp))
            .then(if (onClick != null) Modifier.clickable { onClick() } else Modifier),
        color = Panel,
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
    ) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = if (expanded) 8.dp else 10.dp, vertical = if (expanded) 4.dp else 7.dp)) {
            if (!expanded) {
                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                ) {
                    Text("PERFIL DE RUTA", color = Color(0xFFB8CBFF), fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text("PULSA PARA AMPLIAR", color = Muted, fontSize = 6.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Text("⛶", color = Cyan, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                    Text(if (routeData == null) "SIN RUTA" else "RECORRIDO ${progressPercent}%", color = if (routeData == null) Muted else Green, fontSize = 7.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                }
            }
            if (usableElevations.isNotEmpty()) {
                if (!expanded) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(3.dp))
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                        Text("MÁX ${maximumAltitude.roundToInt()} m", color = Orange, fontSize = 7.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        Text("↑ ${ascent.roundToInt()} m", color = Green, fontSize = 7.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        Text("↓ ${descent.roundToInt()} m", color = Color(0xFF58A6FF), fontSize = 7.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        Text("AHORA ${currentAltitude?.roundToInt() ?: 0} m", color = Cyan, fontSize = 7.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                }
                Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f).padding(top = if (expanded) 0.dp else 4.dp)) {
                    val left = 4f
                    val right = size.width - 4f
                    // Reserve a real POI lane above the altitude profile. The chart starts lower so
                    // labels and stems never collide with the top edge of the fullscreen panel.
                    val top = if (expanded) 168f else 20f
                    val bottom = if (expanded) size.height - 34f else size.height - 18f
                    val poiLaneTop = if (expanded) 18f else 6f
                    val poiLaneBottom = if (expanded) 144f else 18f
                    val spread = (maximumAltitude - minimumAltitude).coerceAtLeast(1.0)

                    fun chartPoint(index: Int): Offset {
                        val routeKm = routeKmAt(index)
                        val x = if (totalDistanceKm <= 0.0) left
                            else left + (right - left) * (routeKm / totalDistanceKm).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                        val normalized = ((usableElevations[index] - minimumAltitude) / spread).toFloat()
                        return Offset(x, bottom - normalized * (bottom - top))
                    }

                    val kmPaint = android.graphics.Paint().apply {
                        isAntiAlias = true
                        color = android.graphics.Color.rgb(169, 196, 255)
                        textSize = if (expanded) 20f else 13f
                        textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER
                    }
                    val kmStep = niceKmStep(totalDistanceKm)
                    var kmMark = kmStep
                    while (kmMark < totalDistanceKm) {
                        val x = left + (right - left) * (kmMark / totalDistanceKm).toFloat()
                        drawLine(Color(0x66173648), Offset(x, top), Offset(x, bottom), 1f)
                        drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(
                            if (kmMark >= 10.0) "${kmMark.roundToInt()} km" else "${format1(kmMark)} km",
                            x,
                            bottom + if (expanded) 22f else 14f,
                            kmPaint
                        )
                        kmMark += kmStep
                    }

                    repeat(3) { index ->
                        val y = top + (bottom - top) * index / 2f
                        drawLine(Color(0xFF173648), Offset(left, y), Offset(right, y), 1f)
                    }
                    repeat(5) { index ->
                        val x = left + (right - left) * index / 4f
                        drawLine(Color(0x99173648), Offset(x, top), Offset(x, bottom), 1f)
                    }

                    val points = usableElevations.indices.map(::chartPoint)
                    val line = Path().apply {
