                        moveTo(points.first().x, points.first().y)
                        points.drop(1).forEach { lineTo(it.x, it.y) }
                    }
                    val area = Path().apply {
                        moveTo(points.first().x, bottom)
                        points.forEach { lineTo(it.x, it.y) }
                        lineTo(points.last().x, bottom)
                        close()
                    }
                    drawPath(
                        area,
                        brush = Brush.verticalGradient(
                            listOf(Cyan.copy(alpha = .30f), Cyan.copy(alpha = .02f)),
                            startY = top,
                            endY = bottom
                        )
                    )
                    drawPath(line, Cyan.copy(alpha = .18f), style = Stroke(9f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))
                    drawPath(line, Cyan, style = Stroke(2.8f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))

                    if (progressIndex > 0) {
                        val completed = Path().apply {
                            moveTo(points.first().x, points.first().y)
                            for (index in 1..progressIndex.coerceAtMost(points.lastIndex)) {
                                lineTo(points[index].x, points[index].y)
                            }
                        }
                        // Tramo ya recorrido: halo y línea intensa para mostrar el avance.
                        drawPath(completed, Green.copy(alpha = .24f), style = Stroke(10f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))
                        drawPath(completed, Green, style = Stroke(4.6f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))
                    }

                    adaptivePeaks.forEach { index ->
                        val peakPoint = chartPoint(index)
                        drawCircle(Orange.copy(alpha = .35f), 7f, peakPoint, style = Stroke(2f))
                    }
                    val labelPaint = android.graphics.Paint().apply {
                        isAntiAlias = true
                        textSize = if (expanded) 28f else 12f
                        textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER
                    }
                    routeHighlights.forEachIndexed { highlightIndex, highlight ->
                        val markerPoint = chartPoint(highlight.profileIndex)
                        val markerColor = when (highlight.kind) {
                            RouteHighlightKind.PEAK -> Orange
                            RouteHighlightKind.PLACE -> Cyan
                            RouteHighlightKind.VIEWPOINT -> Color.White
                            RouteHighlightKind.LAKE -> Color(0xFF58A6FF)
                            RouteHighlightKind.PASS -> Orange.copy(alpha = .85f)
                            RouteHighlightKind.REFUGE -> Green
                            RouteHighlightKind.MONUMENT -> Color(0xFFB8CBFF)
                        }
                        drawCircle(markerColor.copy(alpha = .22f), if (expanded) 15f else 7f, markerPoint)
                        drawCircle(markerColor, if (expanded) 8f else 4f, markerPoint)
                        labelPaint.color = markerColor.toArgb()
                        if (expanded) {
                            // Four vertical lanes. Nearby POIs are deliberately staggered so their
                            // names remain readable instead of forming a single crowded top row.
                            val lane = highlightIndex % 4
                            val labelY = poiLaneTop + 20f + lane * 30f
                            val stemEndY = poiLaneBottom
                            drawLine(markerColor.copy(alpha = .72f), markerPoint, Offset(markerPoint.x, stemEndY), 3f)
                            // Fallback landmarks are already named "Cota N m". Do not append the
                            // same elevation again. Real named POIs still receive their altitude.
                            val label = if (highlight.name.startsWith("Cota ")) highlight.name
                                else highlight.elevationMeters?.roundToInt()?.let { "${highlight.name}  $it m" } ?: highlight.name
                            val safeX = markerPoint.x.coerceIn(110f, size.width - 110f)
                            drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(label.take(28), safeX, labelY, labelPaint)
                        } else {
                            // Compact profile still shows the most useful named POIs instead of dots only.
                            if (highlightIndex < 4) {
                                val compactPaint = android.graphics.Paint(labelPaint).apply { textSize = 10f }
                                val label = highlight.name.take(14)
                                val safeX = markerPoint.x.coerceIn(45f, size.width - 45f)
                                drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(label, safeX, poiLaneTop + 9f, compactPaint)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (expanded) {
                        unnamedPeaks.forEach { index ->
                            val peakPoint = chartPoint(index)
                            labelPaint.color = Orange.toArgb()
                            // Unnamed elevation peaks stay below the named POI lane, never clipped at y=0.
                            drawLine(Orange.copy(alpha = .55f), peakPoint, Offset(peakPoint.x, top - 10f), 1.25f)
                            drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText("${usableElevations[index].roundToInt()} m", peakPoint.x, top - 18f, labelPaint)
                        }
                    }

                    val highestPoint = chartPoint(maximumIndex)
                    drawCircle(Orange.copy(alpha = .24f), 9f, highestPoint)
                    drawCircle(Orange, 4.5f, highestPoint)

                    val riderPoint = chartPoint(progressIndex.coerceIn(0, points.lastIndex))
                    drawLine(Cyan.copy(alpha = .30f), Offset(riderPoint.x, top), Offset(riderPoint.x, bottom), 1.5f)
                    // El usuario manda visualmente: punto grande y tarjeta de telemetría legible de un vistazo.
                    drawCircle(Cyan.copy(alpha = .20f), 21f, riderPoint)
                    drawCircle(Cyan.copy(alpha = .38f), 15f, riderPoint)
                    drawCircle(Color.White, 10.5f, riderPoint)
                    drawCircle(Cyan, 6.5f, riderPoint)

                    if (currentPosition != null) {
                        val cardWidth = if (expanded) 330f else 112f
                        val cardHeight = if (expanded) 150f else 56f
                        val stemHeight = if (expanded) 52f else 20f
                        val margin = 6f
                        val desiredLeft = riderPoint.x - cardWidth / 2f
                        val cardLeft = desiredLeft.coerceIn(margin, (size.width - cardWidth - margin).coerceAtLeast(margin))
                        val cardBottom = (riderPoint.y - stemHeight).coerceAtLeast(cardHeight + margin)
                        val cardTop = cardBottom - cardHeight
                        val stemTargetX = riderPoint.x.coerceIn(cardLeft + 12f, cardLeft + cardWidth - 12f)
                        drawLine(Cyan.copy(alpha = .82f), riderPoint, Offset(stemTargetX, cardBottom), if (expanded) 2.5f else 1.6f)
                        drawRoundRect(
                            color = Color(0xF205111B),
                            topLeft = Offset(cardLeft, cardTop),
                            size = Size(cardWidth, cardHeight),
                            cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(if (expanded) 14f else 9f, if (expanded) 14f else 9f)
                        )
                        drawRoundRect(
                            color = Cyan.copy(alpha = .90f),
                            topLeft = Offset(cardLeft, cardTop),
                            size = Size(cardWidth, cardHeight),
                            cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(if (expanded) 14f else 9f, if (expanded) 14f else 9f),
                            style = Stroke(if (expanded) 2.2f else 1.4f)
                        )
                        val primaryPaint = android.graphics.Paint().apply {
                            isAntiAlias = true
                            color = android.graphics.Color.WHITE
                            textSize = if (expanded) 48f else 17f
                            typeface = android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                            textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.LEFT
                        }
                        val batteryPaint = android.graphics.Paint().apply {
                            isAntiAlias = true
                            color = android.graphics.Color.rgb(0, 229, 255)
                            textSize = if (expanded) 36f else 13f
                            typeface = android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                            textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.LEFT
                        }
                        val altitudePaint = android.graphics.Paint().apply {
                            isAntiAlias = true
                            color = android.graphics.Color.rgb(169, 196, 255)
                            textSize = if (expanded) 28f else 10f
                            typeface = android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                            textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.LEFT
                        }
                        val padX = if (expanded) 20f else 8f
                        drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(
                            "${currentSpeedKmh.roundToInt()} km/h",
                            cardLeft + padX,
                            cardTop + if (expanded) 55f else 21f,
                            primaryPaint
                        )
                        drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(
                            "BAT ${currentBatteryPercent.coerceIn(0, 100)}%",
                            cardLeft + padX,
                            cardTop + if (expanded) 101f else 37f,
                            batteryPaint
                        )
                        drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(
                            currentGpsAltitudeMeters?.let { "ALT ${it.roundToInt()} m" } ?: "ALT —",
                            cardLeft + padX,
                            cardBottom - if (expanded) 14f else 5f,
                            altitudePaint
                        )
                    }
                }
                if (expanded) {
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(52.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly, verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text("▲  MÁX ${maximumAltitude.roundToInt()} m", color = Orange, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                        Text("↑  ${ascent.roundToInt()} m", color = Green, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                        Text("↓  ${descent.roundToInt()} m", color = Color(0xFF58A6FF), fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                        Text("⌁  ${format1(totalDistanceKm)} km", color = Text, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                        Text("◷  ${routeData?.durationMinutes ?: 0} min", color = Text, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                    }
                } else {
                    Text(if (routeHighlights.isEmpty()) "Elevación: Open-Meteo · Copernicus DEM" else "Elevación: Open-Meteo · Copernicus DEM · Lugares: © OpenStreetMap", color = Color(0xFF6687A6), fontSize = 5.5.sp, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.End))
                }
            } else {
                Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Text(
                        if (routeData == null) "Calcula una ruta para ver su altitud y tu avance"
                        else "Perfil de elevación no disponible",
                        color = Color(0xFFA9C4FF),
                        fontSize = 8.sp,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                    )
                }
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                    Text("0 km", color = Muted, fontSize = 6.5.sp)
                    Text("${format1(totalDistanceKm)} km", color = Muted, fontSize = 6.5.sp)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun HistoryScreen(
    bluetooth: Boolean,
    powerOn: Boolean,
    savedRoutes: List<TelemetryRoute>,
    orientation: AppOrientation,
    onFullscreenChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    onRouteDeleted: (Long) -> Unit
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val configuration = LocalConfiguration.current
    var selectedRoute by remember { mutableStateOf<TelemetryRoute?>(null) }
    var historyFilter by remember { mutableStateOf("Todas") }
    var routePendingDelete by remember { mutableStateOf<TelemetryRoute?>(null) }
    var gpxRoutePendingExport by remember { mutableStateOf<TelemetryRoute?>(null) }
    val gpxCreateDocument = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/gpx+xml")
    ) { uri ->
        val route = gpxRoutePendingExport
        if (uri != null && route != null) {
            telemetryRouteGpx(route)?.let { gpx ->
                runCatching {
                    context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri)?.bufferedWriter()?.use { it.write(gpx) }
                }
            }
        }
        gpxRoutePendingExport = null
    }
    var historyFullscreen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    LaunchedEffect(historyFullscreen) {
        onFullscreenChange(historyFullscreen)
        val activity = context as? ComponentActivity
        activity?.requestedOrientation = if (historyFullscreen) {
            ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        } else {
            when (orientation) {
                AppOrientation.AUTO -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_UNSPECIFIED
                AppOrientation.PORTRAIT -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT
                AppOrientation.LANDSCAPE -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
            }
        }
    }
    BackHandler(enabled = historyFullscreen) { historyFullscreen = false }
    val allHistoryRoutes = savedRoutes.filter { it.samples.isNotEmpty() }
    val routes = when (historyFilter) {
        "Favoritas" -> allHistoryRoutes.filter { isFavoriteRoute(context, it.id) }
        "Con GPS" -> allHistoryRoutes.filter { route -> route.samples.count { it.latitude != null && it.longitude != null } >= 2 }
        "Con fotos" -> allHistoryRoutes.filter { route ->
            val end = route.samples.lastOrNull()?.recordedAtMs ?: route.id
            loadRoutePhotos(context, route.id, end).isNotEmpty()
        }
        else -> allHistoryRoutes
    }
    val totalDistance = routes.sumOf { it.samples.lastOrNull()?.distanceKm ?: 0.0 }
    val totalSeconds = routes.sumOf { it.samples.lastOrNull()?.elapsedSeconds ?: 0 }
    val allSamples = routes.flatMap { it.samples }
    val averageSpeed = if (totalSeconds > 0) totalDistance / (totalSeconds / 3600.0) else 0.0
    val totalEnergyKwh = routes.sumOf { route ->
        route.samples.zipWithNext().sumOf { (a, b) ->
            val seconds = (b.recordedAtMs - a.recordedAtMs).coerceAtLeast(0L) / 1000.0
            ((a.powerW + b.powerW) / 2.0) * seconds / 3_600_000.0
        }
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(bottom = 8.dp)) {
        if (!historyFullscreen) Header("Historial", bluetooth, powerOn)
        if (selectedRoute != null) {
            val route = selectedRoute!!
            val samples = route.samples
            val maxSpeedSample = samples.maxByOrNull { it.speedKmh }
            val routeSeconds = samples.lastOrNull()?.elapsedSeconds ?: 0
            val routeDistance = samples.lastOrNull()?.distanceKm ?: 0.0
            val routeAverage = if (routeSeconds > 0) routeDistance / (routeSeconds / 3600.0) else 0.0
            val altitudeSamples = samples.filter { it.altitudeMeters != null }
            val maxAltitudeSample = altitudeSamples.maxByOrNull { it.altitudeMeters ?: Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY }
            var historyRouteHighlights by remember(route.id) { mutableStateOf<List<RouteHighlight>>(emptyList()) }
            LaunchedEffect(route.id) {
                val gpsSamples = samples.filter { it.latitude != null && it.longitude != null }
                if (gpsSamples.size >= 2) {
                    val stride = maxOf(1, gpsSamples.size / 180)
                    val selectedGps = gpsSamples.filterIndexed { index, _ -> index % stride == 0 }.toMutableList().apply {
                        val last = gpsSamples.last()
                        if (lastOrNull() !== last) add(last)
                    }
                    val profile = selectedGps.map { it.latitude!! to it.longitude!! }
                    val elevations = selectedGps.map { it.altitudeMeters ?: 0.0 }
                    historyRouteHighlights = kotlinx.coroutines.withContext(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.IO) {
                        fetchRouteHighlights(profile, elevations).filterNot { it.name.startsWith("Cota ") }
                    }
                } else historyRouteHighlights = emptyList()
            }
            val ascentMeters = altitudeSamples.zipWithNext().sumOf { (a, b) ->
                val gain = (b.altitudeMeters ?: 0.0) - (a.altitudeMeters ?: 0.0)
                if (gain >= 3.0) gain else 0.0
            }
            val descentMeters = altitudeSamples.zipWithNext().sumOf { (a, b) ->
                val loss = (a.altitudeMeters ?: 0.0) - (b.altitudeMeters ?: 0.0)
                if (loss >= 3.0) loss else 0.0
            }
            val minAltitudeMeters = altitudeSamples.minOfOrNull { it.altitudeMeters ?: Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY } ?: 0.0
            val maxAltitudeMeters = maxAltitudeSample?.altitudeMeters ?: 0.0
            val elevationRangeMeters = (maxAltitudeMeters - minAltitudeMeters).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
            val movingSeconds = samples.zipWithNext().sumOf { (a, b) ->
                val dt = ((b.recordedAtMs - a.recordedAtMs).coerceAtLeast(0L) / 1000L).toInt()
                if ((a.speedKmh + b.speedKmh) / 2.0 >= 2.0) dt else 0
            }.coerceAtMost(routeSeconds)
            val stoppedSeconds = (routeSeconds - movingSeconds).coerceAtLeast(0)
            val batterySamples = samples.filter { it.soc in 1..100 }
            val batteryStart = batterySamples.firstOrNull()?.soc
            val batteryEnd = batterySamples.lastOrNull()?.soc
            val batteryUsed = if (batteryStart != null && batteryEnd != null) (batteryStart - batteryEnd).coerceAtLeast(0) else null
            val routeEnergyWh = samples.zipWithNext().sumOf { (a, b) ->
                val seconds = (b.recordedAtMs - a.recordedAtMs).coerceAtLeast(0L) / 1000.0
                ((a.powerW + b.powerW) / 2.0).coerceAtLeast(0.0) * seconds / 3600.0
            }
            val averageWhKm = if (routeDistance > 0.05) routeEnergyWh / routeDistance else 0.0
            val maxPowerW = samples.maxOfOrNull { it.powerW } ?: 0.0
            var routeFavorite by remember(route.id) { mutableStateOf(isFavoriteRoute(context, route.id)) }
            var routeNoteText by remember(route.id) { mutableStateOf(routeNote(context, route.id)) }
            var editingRouteNote by remember(route.id) { mutableStateOf(false) }
            var showAllRoutePhotos by remember(route.id) { mutableStateOf(false) }
            val routeEndMs = samples.lastOrNull()?.recordedAtMs ?: route.id
            val routePhotos = remember(route.id, routeEndMs) { loadRoutePhotos(context, route.id, routeEndMs) }
            val routeGpsPoints = remember(route.id, samples.size) {
                samples.mapNotNull { sample ->
                    if (sample.latitude != null && sample.longitude != null) GpsPoint(sample.latitude, sample.longitude) else null
                }
            }
            if (!historyFullscreen) {
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Text("←", color = Text, fontSize = 30.sp, modifier = Modifier.clickable { selectedRoute = null })
                Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text("RUTA · ${java.text.SimpleDateFormat("dd MMM", Locale("es", "ES")).format(java.util.Date(route.id)).uppercase(Locale("es", "ES"))}", color = Text, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                    Text(java.text.SimpleDateFormat("EEEE, dd MMM yyyy · HH:mm", Locale("es", "ES")).format(java.util.Date(route.id)), color = Muted, fontSize = 11.sp)
                }
                Text(
                    if (routeFavorite) "★" else "☆",
                    color = if (routeFavorite) Yellow else Muted,
                    fontSize = 27.sp,
                    modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                        routeFavorite = !routeFavorite
                        setFavoriteRoute(context, route.id, routeFavorite)
                    }
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                Text(
                    "↗",
                    color = Cyan,
                    fontSize = 25.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                    modifier = Modifier.clickable { shareTelemetryRouteGpx(context, route) }
                )
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
            if (routeGpsPoints.size > 1) {
                SectionTitle("MAPA DE LA RUTA")
                Surface(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(260.dp).padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                    color = Panel,
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
                ) {
                    MapLibreRouteOverview(routeGpsPoints)
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
            }
            Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 10.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(126.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    MetricCard("VELOCIDAD MEDIA", "${format1(routeAverage)} km/h", "◔", Modifier.weight(1f))
                    MetricCard("VELOCIDAD MÁX.", "${format1(maxSpeedSample?.speedKmh ?: 0.0)} km/h", "⚡", Modifier.weight(1f))
                    MetricCard("DISTANCIA", "${format1(routeDistance)} km", "⌖", Modifier.weight(1f))
                }
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(118.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    MetricCard("DURACIÓN", telemetryDuration(routeSeconds), "◷", Modifier.weight(1f))
                    MetricCard("EN MOVIMIENTO", telemetryDuration(movingSeconds), "▶", Modifier.weight(1f))
                    MetricCard("PARADO", telemetryDuration(stoppedSeconds), "Ⅱ", Modifier.weight(1f))
                }
                if (altitudeSamples.isNotEmpty()) {
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(118.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        MetricCard("ALTITUD MÁX.", "${maxAltitudeMeters.roundToInt()} m", "▲", Modifier.weight(1f), Orange)
                        MetricCard("ALTITUD MÍN.", "${minAltitudeMeters.roundToInt()} m", "▼", Modifier.weight(1f), Cyan)
                        MetricCard("RANGO ELEVACIÓN", "${elevationRangeMeters.roundToInt()} m", "↕", Modifier.weight(1f), Color(0xFFA9C4FF))
                    }
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(110.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        MetricCard("ASCENSO GPS", "${ascentMeters.roundToInt()} m", "↗", Modifier.weight(1f), Green)
                        MetricCard("DESCENSO GPS", "${descentMeters.roundToInt()} m", "↘", Modifier.weight(1f), Orange)
                    }
                }
                if (batteryUsed != null || routeEnergyWh > 0.0 || maxPowerW > 0.0) {
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(118.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        MetricCard("BATERÍA", batteryUsed?.let { "$it% usado" } ?: "—", "▣", Modifier.weight(1f))
                        MetricCard("ENERGÍA", if (routeEnergyWh > 0.0) "${routeEnergyWh.roundToInt()} Wh" else "—", "⚡", Modifier.weight(1f))
                        MetricCard("CONSUMO", if (averageWhKm > 0.0) "${format1(averageWhKm)} Wh/km" else "—", "∿", Modifier.weight(1f))
                    }
                    if (maxPowerW > 0.0 || batteryStart != null) {
                        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(110.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                            MetricCard("POTENCIA MÁX.", if (maxPowerW > 0.0) "${maxPowerW.roundToInt()} W" else "—", "⚡", Modifier.weight(1f))
                            MetricCard("BATERÍA INICIO/FIN", if (batteryStart != null && batteryEnd != null) "$batteryStart% → $batteryEnd%" else "—", "▣", Modifier.weight(1f))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
            }
  if (!historyFullscreen) SectionTitle(if (altitudeSamples.size > 1) "PERFIL DE ALTITUD" else "VELOCIDAD DURANTE LA RUTA")
            val historyChartHeight = when (routePhotos.size) {
                0 -> 390.dp
                1 -> 350.dp
                2 -> 330.dp
                else -> 300.dp
            }
            Surface(
                (if (historyFullscreen) Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(configuration.screenHeightDp.dp) else Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(historyChartHeight).padding(horizontal = 12.dp)),
                color = Panel,
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(if (historyFullscreen) 0.dp else 14.dp)
            ) {
                var historySelectedIndex by remember(route.id) { mutableIntStateOf(samples.lastIndex.coerceAtLeast(0)) }
      val historySelectedSample = samples.getOrNull(historySelectedIndex)
      Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(10.dp)) {
          Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
              Text("${format1(historySelectedSample?.distanceKm ?: 0.0)} km", color = Text, fontSize = if (historyFullscreen) 18.sp else 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
              Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
              Text("${format1(historySelectedSample?.speedKmh ?: 0.0)} km/h", color = Cyan, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
              Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
              Text(historySelectedSample?.altitudeMeters?.let { "${it.roundToInt()} m" } ?: "ALT —", color = Color(0xFFA9C4FF), fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
              Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
              val selectedWhKm = historySelectedSample?.let { sample ->
                  if (sample.speedKmh > 1.0 && sample.powerW > 0.0) sample.powerW / sample.speedKmh else null
              }
              Text("BAT ${historySelectedSample?.soc ?: 0}%", color = Green, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
              selectedWhKm?.let { Text("  ${format1(it)} Wh/km", color = Orange, fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
              Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
              Surface(
                  Modifier.size(38.dp).clickable { historyFullscreen = !historyFullscreen },
                  color = Color(0xDD0A2235), border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Cyan), shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)
              ) { Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { FullscreenSquareIcon(expanded = historyFullscreen) } }
          }
          Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f).padding(6.dp).pointerInput(samples.size) {
              detectTapGestures { pos ->
                  if (samples.isNotEmpty()) historySelectedIndex = ((pos.x / size.width.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f) * samples.lastIndex).roundToInt()
              }
          }.pointerInput(samples.size) {
              detectDragGestures(
                  onDragStart = { pos -> if (samples.isNotEmpty()) historySelectedIndex = ((pos.x / size.width.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f) * samples.lastIndex).roundToInt() },
                  onDrag = { change, _ ->
                      if (samples.isNotEmpty()) historySelectedIndex = ((change.position.x / size.width.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f) * samples.lastIndex).roundToInt()
                      change.consume()
                  }
              )
          }) {
                    if (samples.size > 1) {
                        val maxDistance = routeDistance.coerceAtLeast(0.1)
                        repeat(4) { i ->
                            val y = i * (size.height - 28f) / 3f
                            drawLine(Color(0xFF173648), Offset(0f, y), Offset(size.width, y), 1f)
                        }
                        if (altitudeSamples.size > 1) {
                            val minAltitude = altitudeSamples.minOf { it.altitudeMeters ?: 0.0 }
                            val maxAltitude = altitudeSamples.maxOf { it.altitudeMeters ?: 0.0 }
                            val altitudeRange = (maxAltitude - minAltitude).coerceAtLeast(1.0)
                            fun altitudePoint(sample: TelemetrySample): Offset {
                                val x = (sample.distanceKm / maxDistance).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f) * size.width
                                val altitude = sample.altitudeMeters ?: minAltitude
                                val y = size.height - ((altitude - minAltitude) / altitudeRange).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f) * (size.height - 36f)
                                return Offset(x, y)
                            }
                            val path = Path().apply {
                                val first = altitudePoint(altitudeSamples.first()); moveTo(first.x, first.y)
                                altitudeSamples.drop(1).forEach { val pt = altitudePoint(it); lineTo(pt.x, pt.y) }
                            }
                            drawPath(path, Cyan.copy(alpha = .18f), style = Stroke(9f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))
                            drawPath(path, Cyan, style = Stroke(3f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))
                            maxAltitudeSample?.let { sample ->
                                val pt = altitudePoint(sample)
                                drawCircle(Orange.copy(alpha = .25f), 13f, pt)
                                drawCircle(Orange, 6f, pt)
                                val paint = android.graphics.Paint().apply { isAntiAlias = true; color = android.graphics.Color.rgb(255, 159, 67); textSize = 21f; textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER }
                                drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText("MÁX ${sample.altitudeMeters?.roundToInt() ?: 0} m", pt.x, (pt.y - 16f).coerceAtLeast(20f), paint)
                            }
                            if (historyRouteHighlights.isNotEmpty()) {
                                val gpsSamples = samples.filter { it.latitude != null && it.longitude != null }
                                val stride = maxOf(1, gpsSamples.size / 180)
                                val selectedGps = gpsSamples.filterIndexed { index, _ -> index % stride == 0 }.toMutableList().apply {
                                    val last = gpsSamples.lastOrNull()
                                    if (last != null && lastOrNull() !== last) add(last)
                                }
                                val poiPaint = android.graphics.Paint().apply {
                                    isAntiAlias = true
                                    textSize = if (historyFullscreen) 24f else 16f
                                    typeface = android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                                    textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER
                                }
                                historyRouteHighlights.forEach { highlight ->
                                    val sourceSample = selectedGps.getOrNull(highlight.profileIndex) ?: return@forEach
                                    val pt = altitudePoint(sourceSample)
                                    val poiColor = when (highlight.kind) {
                                        RouteHighlightKind.PEAK, RouteHighlightKind.PASS -> Orange
                                        RouteHighlightKind.PLACE -> Cyan
                                        RouteHighlightKind.VIEWPOINT -> Color.White
                                        RouteHighlightKind.LAKE -> Color(0xFF58A6FF)
                                        RouteHighlightKind.REFUGE -> Green
                                        RouteHighlightKind.MONUMENT -> Color(0xFFB8CBFF)
                                    }
                                    val labelY = (pt.y - if (historyFullscreen) 54f else 38f).coerceAtLeast(if (historyFullscreen) 26f else 18f)
                                    drawLine(poiColor.copy(alpha=.72f), pt, Offset(pt.x, labelY + 8f), if (historyFullscreen) 2.5f else 1.5f)
                                    drawCircle(poiColor.copy(alpha=.25f), if (historyFullscreen) 12f else 8f, pt)
                                    drawCircle(poiColor, if (historyFullscreen) 6f else 4f, pt)
                                    poiPaint.color = poiColor.toArgb()
                                    drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(highlight.name.take(if (historyFullscreen) 28 else 18), pt.x, labelY, poiPaint)
                                }
                            }
                            maxSpeedSample?.let { sample ->
                                val x = (sample.distanceKm / maxDistance).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f) * size.width
                                drawLine(Orange.copy(alpha = .75f), Offset(x, 0f), Offset(x, size.height), 2f)
                                val paint = android.graphics.Paint().apply { isAntiAlias = true; color = android.graphics.Color.rgb(255, 159, 67); textSize = 18f; textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER }
                                drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText("${format1(sample.speedKmh)} km/h", x, size.height - 6f, paint)
                            }
                        } else {
                            val maxSpeed = (samples.maxOfOrNull { it.speedKmh } ?: 1.0).coerceAtLeast(1.0)
                            fun speedPoint(sample: TelemetrySample): Offset {
                                val x = (sample.distanceKm / maxDistance).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f) * size.width
                                val y = size.height - (sample.speedKmh / maxSpeed).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f) * (size.height - 28f)
                                return Offset(x, y)
                            }
                            val path = Path().apply {
                                val first = speedPoint(samples.first()); moveTo(first.x, first.y)
                                samples.drop(1).forEach { val pt = speedPoint(it); lineTo(pt.x, pt.y) }
                            }
                            drawPath(path, Cyan.copy(alpha = .18f), style = Stroke(9f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))
                            drawPath(path, Cyan, style = Stroke(3f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round))
                            maxSpeedSample?.let { sample ->
                                val pt = speedPoint(sample)
                                drawCircle(Orange.copy(alpha = .25f), 13f, pt)
                                drawCircle(Orange, 6f, pt)
                            }
                        }
                    }
              if (samples.isNotEmpty()) {
                  val selected = samples[historySelectedIndex.coerceIn(0, samples.lastIndex)]
                  val cursorX = (selected.distanceKm / routeDistance.coerceAtLeast(0.1)).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f) * size.width
                  drawLine(Color.White.copy(alpha = .65f), Offset(cursorX, 0f), Offset(cursorX, size.height), 1.5f)
                  listOf(50, 20, 10).forEach { threshold ->
                      samples.zipWithNext().firstOrNull { (a, b) -> a.soc > threshold && b.soc <= threshold }?.second?.let { sample ->
                          val x = (sample.distanceKm / routeDistance.coerceAtLeast(0.1)).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f) * size.width
                          drawLine(Orange.copy(alpha = .35f), Offset(x, 0f), Offset(x, size.height), 1f)
                          drawCircle(Orange, 4f, Offset(x, 10f))
                          val eventPaint = android.graphics.Paint().apply {
                              isAntiAlias = true
                              color = android.graphics.Color.rgb(255, 138, 31)
                              textSize = 18f
                              typeface = android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                              textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER
                          }
                          drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText("$threshold%", x, 32f, eventPaint)
                      }
                  }
              }
          }
          Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 4.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
              Text("INICIO", color = Green, fontSize = 8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
              Text("TOCA O DESLIZA", color = Muted, fontSize = 8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
              Text("FIN", color = Red, fontSize = 8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
          }
      }
  }
  if (!historyFullscreen) Text(
      if (altitudeSamples.size > 1) "Perfil reconstruido con el GPS guardado durante esta ruta · la velocidad máxima queda marcada en su kilómetro exacto"
                else "Esta ruta no contiene altitud GPS histórica; se muestran únicamente los datos realmente registrados",
                color = Muted, fontSize = 9.sp, modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp), textAlign = TextAlign.Center
            )
            if (showAllRoutePhotos) {
                AlertDialog(
                    onDismissRequest = { showAllRoutePhotos = false },
                    title = { Text("FOTOS DE LA RUTA (${routePhotos.size})", color = Text, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black) },
                    text = {
                        LazyColumn(
                            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(max = 520.dp),
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                        ) {
                            items(routePhotos.size) { index ->
                                val photo = routePhotos[index]
                                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(photo.file.path)
                                bitmap?.let {
                                    Image(
                                        bitmap = it.asImageBitmap(),
                                        contentDescription = "Foto ${index + 1} de la ruta",
                                        contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(180.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    confirmButton = {
                        TextButton(onClick = { showAllRoutePhotos = false }) { Text("CERRAR", color = Cyan) }
                    },
                    containerColor = Panel
                )
            }
            if (routePhotos.isNotEmpty()) {
                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Text("FOTOS DE LA RUTA (${routePhotos.size})", color = Text, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontSize = 14.sp)
                    if (routePhotos.size > 2) Text(
                        "Ver todas  ›",
                        color = Cyan,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable { showAllRoutePhotos = true }
                    )
                }
                when (routePhotos.size) {
                    1 -> {
                        val bitmap = remember(routePhotos[0].file.path) { BitmapFactory.decodeFile(routePhotos[0].file.path) }
                        bitmap?.let {
                            Image(
                                bitmap = it.asImageBitmap(),
                                contentDescription = "Foto de la ruta",
                                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(118.dp).padding(horizontal = 12.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    2 -> {
                        Row(
                            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                        ) {
                            routePhotos.take(2).forEach { photo ->
                                val bitmap = remember(photo.file.path) { BitmapFactory.decodeFile(photo.file.path) }
                                bitmap?.let {
                                    Image(
                                        bitmap = it.asImageBitmap(),
                                        contentDescription = "Foto de la ruta",
                                        contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(96.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else -> LazyRow(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                    ) {
                        items(minOf(routePhotos.size, 3)) { index ->
                            val bitmap = remember(routePhotos[index].file.path) { BitmapFactory.decodeFile(routePhotos[index].file.path) }
                            bitmap?.let {
                                Image(
                                    bitmap = it.asImageBitmap(),
                                    contentDescription = "Foto de la ruta",
                                    contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                                    modifier = Modifier.size(150.dp, 92.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.height(if (routePhotos.size <= 2) 6.dp else 10.dp))
            }
            Surface(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                color = Panel,
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
            ) {
                Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    Text("DATOS DE LA RUTA", color = Text, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontSize = 14.sp)
                    Text("TRACK GPS  ·  ${routeGpsPoints.size} puntos", color = Cyan, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Text(
                        if (altitudeSamples.isNotEmpty()) "Altitud GPS registrada  ·  ${altitudeSamples.size} muestras" else "Altitud: no registrada",
                        color = Muted, fontSize = 10.sp
                    )
                    Text(
                        if (routePhotos.isNotEmpty()) "${routePhotos.size} fotos asociadas a esta ruta" else "Fotos: ninguna asociada",
                        color = Muted, fontSize = 10.sp
                    )
                }
            }
            Surface(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
                color = Panel,
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
            ) {
                Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween, verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text("NOTAS", color = Text, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, fontSize = 14.sp)
                        Text(if (editingRouteNote) "GUARDAR" else "EDITAR", color = Cyan, fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                            modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                                if (editingRouteNote) setRouteNote(context, route.id, routeNoteText)
                                editingRouteNote = !editingRouteNote
                            })
                    }
                    if (editingRouteNote) {
                        BasicTextField(
                            value = routeNoteText,
                            onValueChange = { if (it.length <= 240) routeNoteText = it },
                            textStyle = LocalTextStyle.current.copy(color = Text, fontSize = 12.sp),
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 58.dp).background(Bg, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).padding(8.dp)
                        )
                    } else {
                        Text(if (routeNoteText.isBlank()) "Sin notas para esta ruta" else routeNoteText, color = if (routeNoteText.isBlank()) Muted else Text, fontSize = 11.sp)
                    }
                }
            }
            OutlinedButton(
                onClick = {
                    routeFavorite = !routeFavorite
                    setFavoriteRoute(context, route.id, routeFavorite)
                },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (routeFavorite) Yellow else Border)
            ) {
                Text(if (routeFavorite) "★  RUTA FAVORITA" else "☆  GUARDAR FAVORITA", color = if (routeFavorite) Yellow else Text, fontSize = 10.sp)
            }
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
                OutlinedButton(
                    onClick = { routePendingDelete = route },
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Red)
                ) { Text("ELIMINAR", color = Red, fontSize = 10.sp) }
                OutlinedButton(
                    onClick = {
                        gpxRoutePendingExport = route
                        gpxCreateDocument.launch("E-SKATE_${route.id}.gpx")
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Cyan)
                ) { Text("DESCARGAR GPX", color = Cyan, fontSize = 10.sp) }
            }
        } else {
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)) {
                listOf("Todas", "Con GPS", "Con fotos", "Favoritas").forEach { t ->
                    val active = historyFilter == t
                    Surface(
                        Modifier.weight(1f).clickable { historyFilter = t },
                        color = if (active) Cyan else Panel,
                        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(t, color = if (active) Bg else Muted, textAlign = TextAlign.Center, modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 10.dp, horizontal = 2.dp), fontSize = 10.sp, maxLines = 1)
                    }
                }
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(160.dp).padding(horizontal = 10.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                MetricCard("DISTANCIA TOTAL", "${format1(totalDistance)} km", "⌖", Modifier.weight(1f))
                MetricCard("TIEMPO TOTAL", telemetryDuration(totalSeconds), "◴", Modifier.weight(1f))
                MetricCard("VEL. MEDIA", "${format1(averageSpeed)} km/h", "◔", Modifier.weight(1f))
                MetricCard("ENERGÍA", "${format1(totalEnergyKwh)} kWh", "▣", Modifier.weight(1f))
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
            SectionTitle("ÚLTIMOS VIAJES")
            if (routes.isEmpty()) {
                Text(if (historyFilter == "Todas") "Todavía no hay rutas guardadas" else "No hay rutas en este filtro", color = Muted, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(24.dp), textAlign = TextAlign.Center)
            }
            routes.forEach { route ->
                val last = route.samples.lastOrNull() ?: return@forEach
                val avg = if (last.elapsedSeconds > 0) last.distanceKm / (last.elapsedSeconds / 3600.0) else 0.0
                Surface(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 4.dp), color = Panel, border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border), shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)) {
                    Box {
                        Row(
                            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(12.dp).padding(end = 42.dp).pointerInput(route.id) {
                                detectTapGestures(
                                    onTap = { selectedRoute = route },
                                    onLongPress = { routePendingDelete = route }
                                )
                            },
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            Text("⌁", color = Cyan, fontSize = 28.sp)
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                            Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                Text(java.text.SimpleDateFormat("dd MMM yyyy · HH:mm", Locale("es", "ES")).format(java.util.Date(route.id)), color = Text, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                                Text("${format1(last.distanceKm)} km   ·   ${telemetryDuration(last.elapsedSeconds)}   ·   ${format1(avg)} km/h", color = Muted, fontSize = 12.sp)
                            }
                            Text("›", color = Text, fontSize = 28.sp)
                        }
                        var menuOpen by remember(route.id) { mutableStateOf(false) }
                        Box(Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).padding(3.dp)) {
                            TextButton(onClick = { menuOpen = true }) { Text("⋮", color = Text, fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black) }
                            DropdownMenu(expanded = menuOpen, onDismissRequest = { menuOpen = false }) {
                                DropdownMenuItem(
                                    text = { Text("🗑  Eliminar ruta", color = Red, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
                                    onClick = { menuOpen = false; routePendingDelete = route }
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            routePendingDelete?.let { route ->
                AlertDialog(
                    onDismissRequest = { routePendingDelete = null },
                    title = { Text("¿Eliminar esta ruta?") },
                    text = { Text("Se eliminarán permanentemente la ruta y sus datos registrados.") },
                    confirmButton = {
                        TextButton(onClick = {
                            if (deleteTelemetryRoute(context, route.id)) {
                                if (selectedRoute?.id == route.id) selectedRoute = null
                                onRouteDeleted(route.id)
                            }
                            routePendingDelete = null
                        }) { Text("Eliminar", color = Red, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black) }
                    },
                    dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { routePendingDelete = null }) { Text("Cancelar") } }
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BarChart() {
    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp), color = Panel, border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border), shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)) {
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(170.dp).padding(16.dp)) {
            val values = listOf(17f,31f,24f,40f,16f,25f,34f)
            val max = 45f
            val gap = 12f
            val barW = (size.width-gap*(values.size-1))/values.size
            values.forEachIndexed { i, v ->
                val h = size.height*(v/max)
                drawRoundRect(Cyan, Offset(i*(barW+gap), size.height-h), Size(barW,h), cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(8f,8f))
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable

@Composable
private fun SystemScreen(
    bluetooth: Boolean,
    activeAlerts: List<String>,
    voiceEnabled: Boolean,
    keepScreenOn: Boolean,
    orientation: AppOrientation,
    onKeepScreenOnChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    onOrientationChange: (AppOrientation) -> Unit,
    onRestoreSettings: () -> Unit,
    onBack: () -> Unit
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val bluetoothManager = remember {
        context.getSystemService(Context.BLUETOOTH_SERVICE) as BluetoothManager
    }
    val gpsPermission = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
        context,
        Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
    ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED || ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
        context,
        Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
    ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    val locationManager = remember {
        context.getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE) as LocationManager
    }
    var gpsRefreshPulse by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val gpsEnabled = remember(gpsRefreshPulse) {
        runCatching {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) locationManager.isLocationEnabled
            else locationManager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER) ||
                locationManager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)
        }.getOrDefault(false)
    }
    val gpsOperational = gpsPermission && gpsEnabled
    val bluetoothAvailable = bluetoothManager.adapter != null
    val bluetoothEnabled = runCatching { bluetoothManager.adapter?.isEnabled == true }.getOrDefault(false)
    val internetAvailable = remember {
        val connectivity = context.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE) as ConnectivityManager
        val network = connectivity.activeNetwork
        val capabilities = network?.let { connectivity.getNetworkCapabilities(it) }
        capabilities?.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET) == true
    }
    val versionName = remember {
        runCatching {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(context.packageName, 0).versionName ?: "—"
        }.getOrDefault("—")
    }
    var diagnosticChecked by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var showRestoreDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val systemReady = gpsOperational && bluetoothAvailable && bluetoothEnabled && internetAvailable && bluetooth
    val heroColor = if (systemReady) Green else Orange
    val heroTitle = if (systemReady) "Sistema preparado" else "Revisión necesaria"
    val heroSubtitle = when {
        !gpsPermission -> "Falta el permiso de ubicación"
        !gpsEnabled -> "Activa la ubicación/GPS del teléfono"
        !bluetoothAvailable -> "Bluetooth no disponible en este teléfono"
        !bluetoothEnabled -> "Activa el Bluetooth del teléfono"
        !internetAvailable -> "Sin conexión para cargar mapas"
        !bluetooth -> "Sistema correcto · BMS sin conectar"
        else -> "GPS, Bluetooth, BMS y mapas operativos"
    }

    if (showRestoreDialog) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { showRestoreDialog = false },
            title = { Text("Restablecer ajustes") },
            text = { Text("La voz, los avisos, la orientación y la pantalla activa volverán a sus valores iniciales.") },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    onRestoreSettings()
                    showRestoreDialog = false
                }) { Text("RESTABLECER", color = Orange, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black) }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { showRestoreDialog = false }) { Text("CANCELAR") }
            },
            containerColor = Panel2,
            titleContentColor = Text,
            textContentColor = Muted
        )
    }

    Column(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            .padding(bottom = 12.dp)
    ) {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(78.dp).padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 7.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.width(68.dp), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                BluetoothStatusIcon(bluetooth, Modifier.size(40.dp))
                Text(
                    if (bluetooth) "Conectado" else "Sin conexión",
                    color = if (bluetooth) Cyan else Orange,
                    fontSize = 9.sp,
                    maxLines = 1
                )
            }
            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                Text("E-SKATE", color = Text, fontSize = 27.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                Text("Sistema y alertas", color = Cyan, fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
            }
            Text(
                "←",
                color = Text,
                fontSize = 32.sp,
                modifier = Modifier.width(68.dp).clickable { onBack() },
                textAlign = TextAlign.Center
            )
        }

        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
            color = heroColor.copy(alpha = .08f),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, heroColor),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
        ) {
            Row(Modifier.padding(15.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Surface(
                    Modifier.size(46.dp),
                    color = heroColor.copy(alpha = .14f),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, heroColor),
                    shape = CircleShape
                ) {
                    Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        Text(if (systemReady) "✓" else "!", color = heroColor, fontSize = 28.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                    }
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.width(12.dp))
                Column {
                    Text(heroTitle, color = heroColor, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                    Text(heroSubtitle, color = Muted, fontSize = 11.sp)
                }
            }
        }

        Surface(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp), color = if (activeAlerts.isEmpty()) Panel else Red.copy(alpha=.10f), border=BorderStroke(1.dp,if(activeAlerts.isEmpty()) Border else Red), shape=RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)) {
            Row(Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalAlignment=Alignment.Top) {
                Text(if(activeAlerts.isEmpty()) "✓" else "⚠", color=if(activeAlerts.isEmpty()) Green else Red, fontSize=30.sp, fontWeight=FontWeight.Black)
                Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp)); Column { Text(if(activeAlerts.isEmpty()) "Sin alertas activas" else "Alerta activa",color=if(activeAlerts.isEmpty()) Green else Red,fontSize=18.sp,fontWeight=FontWeight.Bold); if(activeAlerts.isEmpty()) Text("Todos los parámetros dentro de los límites establecidos",color=Muted,fontSize=11.sp) else activeAlerts.forEach { Text("• $it",color=Text,fontSize=12.sp,lineHeight=16.sp,fontWeight=FontWeight.SemiBold) } }
            }
        }

        VoiceSectionTitle("ESTADO DEL SISTEMA")
        Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp)) {
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp)) {
                SystemStatusCard("GPS", when { !gpsPermission -> "Sin permiso"; !gpsEnabled -> "Desactivado"; else -> "Operativo" }, gpsOperational, Modifier.weight(1f))
                SystemStatusCard("BLUETOOTH", if (bluetoothEnabled) "Activo" else "Desactivado", bluetoothEnabled, Modifier.weight(1f))
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(7.dp))
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp)) {
                SystemStatusCard("BMS", if (bluetooth) "Conectado" else "Sin conectar", bluetooth, Modifier.weight(1f))
                SystemStatusCard("MAPAS", if (internetAvailable) "Disponibles" else "Sin conexión", internetAvailable, Modifier.weight(1f))
            }
        }

        Button(
            onClick = { diagnosticChecked = true; gpsRefreshPulse += 1 },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp).height(42.dp),
            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = Cyan, contentColor = Color(0xFF03131D)),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(11.dp)
        ) {
            Text(
                if (diagnosticChecked) "COMPROBACIÓN ACTUALIZADA" else "COMPROBAR SISTEMA",
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontSize = 12.sp
            )
        }

        VoiceSectionTitle("PANTALLA Y NAVEGACIÓN")
        VoiceToggleCard(
            "Mantener pantalla encendida",
            "Evita que se apague durante el uso de la aplicación",
            "☀",
            keepScreenOn,
            onKeepScreenOnChange
        )
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
            color = Panel,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp)) {
                Text("Orientación de pantalla", color = Text, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Text("El navegador se adapta a la posición elegida", color = Muted, fontSize = 10.sp)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(9.dp))
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    listOf(
                        AppOrientation.AUTO to "Automática",
                        AppOrientation.PORTRAIT to "Vertical",
                        AppOrientation.LANDSCAPE to "Horizontal"
                    ).forEach { (mode, label) ->
                        val selected = orientation == mode
                        Surface(
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(36.dp).clickable { onOrientationChange(mode) },
                            color = if (selected) Cyan else Panel2,
                            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (selected) Cyan else Border),
                            shape = RoundedCornerShape(9.dp)
                        ) {
                            Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                                Text(
                                    label,
                                    color = if (selected) Color(0xFF03131D) else Text,
                                    fontSize = 10.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                    maxLines = 1
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        SystemInfoRow("UNIDADES", "Métrico · km · km/h · °C", "km")
        SystemInfoRow("VOZ DEL NAVEGADOR", if (voiceEnabled) "Activada" else "Desactivada", "◖")

        VoiceSectionTitle("DATOS Y AJUSTES")

@Composable
private fun LightsScreen(
    bluetooth: Boolean,
    powerOn: Boolean,
    lightsConnected: Boolean,
    lightsStatus: String,
    lightsPowerOn: Boolean,
    brightness: Float,
    selectedColor: Color,
    blinkEnabled: Boolean,
    blinkSpeed: Float,
    onBluetooth: () -> Unit,
    onPowerChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    onBrightnessChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    onColorChange: (Color) -> Unit,
    onBlinkEnabledChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    onBlinkSpeedChange: (Float) -> Unit
) {
    val presets = listOf(
        Color.White, Cyan, Color(0xFF1457FF), Color(0xFF7A43FF),
        Color(0xFFFFD13C), Orange, Red, Green
    )
    var wheelColor by remember(selectedColor) { mutableStateOf(selectedColor) }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(horizontal = 12.dp)) {
        Header(bluetooth = bluetooth, powerOn = powerOn)
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            color = Panel,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (lightsConnected) Green else Border),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
        ) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text("LUCES", color = Text, fontSize = 22.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                    Text(lightsStatus, color = if (lightsConnected) Green else Muted, fontSize = 11.sp, maxLines = 1)
                }
                Surface(
                    Modifier.size(42.dp).clickable { onBluetooth() },
                    color = if (lightsConnected) Green.copy(alpha = .12f) else Cyan.copy(alpha = .08f),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (lightsConnected) Green else Border),
                    shape = CircleShape
                ) {
                    Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        DashboardIconView(DashboardIcon.BLUETOOTH, if (lightsConnected) Green else Cyan, Modifier.size(21.dp))
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            color = Panel,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp)
        ) {
            Column(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(14.dp),
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
            ) {
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        Text("COLOR", color = Muted, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        Text(
                            if (lightsPowerOn) "Iluminación encendida" else "Iluminación apagada",
                            color = if (lightsPowerOn) selectedColor else Muted,
                            fontSize = 14.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                    Switch(
                        checked = lightsPowerOn,
                        onCheckedChange = onPowerChange,
                        enabled = lightsConnected,
                        colors = SwitchDefaults.colors(
                            checkedThumbColor = Color.White,
                            checkedTrackColor = selectedColor,
                            uncheckedThumbColor = Muted,
                            uncheckedTrackColor = Panel2
                        )
                    )
                }

                Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
                Box(Modifier.size(218.dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    fun chooseColor(position: Offset) {
                        val center = Offset(109f, 109f)
                        val dx = position.x - center.x
                        val dy = position.y - center.y
                        val hue = ((atan2(dy, dx) * 180f / PI.toFloat()) + 360f) % 360f
                        val saturation = (kotlin.math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) / 109f).coerceIn(.18f, 1f)
                        val color = Color.hsv(hue, saturation, 1f)
                        wheelColor = color
                        onColorChange(color)
                    }
                    Canvas(
                        Modifier
                            .fillMaxSize()
                            .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures { chooseColor(it) } }
                            .pointerInput(Unit) {
                                detectDragGestures { change, _ ->
                                    change.consume()
                                    chooseColor(change.position)
                                }
                            }
                    ) {
                        val radius = size.minDimension * .46f
                        repeat(180) { index ->
                            val hue = index * 2f
                            drawArc(
                                color = Color.hsv(hue, 1f, 1f),
                                startAngle = hue - 90f,
                                sweepAngle = 2.8f,
                                useCenter = false,
                                topLeft = Offset(size.width / 2f - radius, size.height / 2f - radius),
                                size = Size(radius * 2f, radius * 2f),
                                style = Stroke(size.minDimension * .18f)
                            )
                        }
                        drawCircle(Panel2, radius = size.minDimension * .25f)
                        drawCircle(wheelColor.copy(alpha = .30f), radius = size.minDimension * .22f)
                        drawCircle(wheelColor, radius = size.minDimension * .13f)
                        drawCircle(Color.White.copy(alpha = .75f), radius = size.minDimension * .13f, style = Stroke(2f))
                    }
                }

                Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Text("BRILLO", color = Muted, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Text(
                        "${(brightness * 100).roundToInt()}%",
                        color = Text,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )
                }
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text("☼", color = Muted, fontSize = 18.sp)
                    Slider(
                        value = brightness,
                        onValueChange = onBrightnessChange,
                        enabled = lightsConnected,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(horizontal = 8.dp),
                        colors = SliderDefaults.colors(
                            thumbColor = selectedColor,
                            activeTrackColor = selectedColor,
                            inactiveTrackColor = Border
                        )
                    )
                }

                Box(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(1.dp).background(Border.copy(alpha = .45f))
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(9.dp))
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        Text("PARPADEO", color = Muted, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        Text(
                            if (blinkEnabled) "Activado" else "Desactivado",
                            color = if (blinkEnabled) Orange else Muted,
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                    Switch(
                        checked = blinkEnabled,
                        onCheckedChange = onBlinkEnabledChange,
                        enabled = lightsConnected && lightsPowerOn,
                        colors = SwitchDefaults.colors(
                            checkedThumbColor = Color.White,
                            checkedTrackColor = Orange,
                            uncheckedThumbColor = Muted,
                            uncheckedTrackColor = Panel2
                        )
                    )
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.height(2.dp))
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text("LENTO", color = Muted, fontSize = 8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Slider(
                        value = blinkSpeed,
                        onValueChange = onBlinkSpeedChange,
                        enabled = lightsConnected && lightsPowerOn && blinkEnabled,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(horizontal = 8.dp),
                        colors = SliderDefaults.colors(
                            thumbColor = Orange,
                            activeTrackColor = Orange,
                            inactiveTrackColor = Border
                        )
                    )
                    Text("RÁPIDO", color = Muted, fontSize = 8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            color = Panel,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Border),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(14.dp)) {
                Text("COLORES RÁPIDOS", color = Muted, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                    presets.forEach { color ->
                        Box(
                            Modifier.size(34.dp).background(color, CircleShape).clip(CircleShape)
                                .clickable(enabled = lightsConnected) { onColorChange(color) }
