@Composable
private fun BluetoothScreen(
    bluetooth: Boolean,
    connectedAddress: String?,
    targetAddress: String?,
    connectionStatus: String,
    onConnect: (FoundBluetoothDevice) -> Unit,
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    screenTitle: String = "BLUETOOTH",
    preferredKeywords: List<String> = listOf("bewatt", "skate", "bici", "xiaoxiang")
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val deleteRevealPx = with(density) { 108.dp.toPx() }
    val bluetoothManager = remember {
        context.getSystemService(Context.BLUETOOTH_SERVICE) as BluetoothManager
    }
    val adapter = bluetoothManager.adapter
    val devices = remember { mutableStateListOf<FoundBluetoothDevice>() }
    val dismissedAddresses = remember { mutableStateListOf<String>() }
    var scanning by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var scanRequested by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var status by remember { mutableStateOf("Preparando búsqueda…") }

    fun permissionsGranted(): Boolean =
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED &&
                ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        } else {
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        }

    var permissionGranted by remember { mutableStateOf(permissionsGranted()) }
    val permissionLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()
    ) { result ->
        permissionGranted = result.values.all { it }
        status = if (permissionGranted) "Permisos concedidos" else "Permiso Bluetooth necesario"
        if (permissionGranted) scanRequested = true
    }

    val scanCallback = remember {
        object : ScanCallback() {
            override fun onScanResult(callbackType: Int, result: ScanResult) {
                val device = result.device
                val deviceName = try {
                    device.name?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "Dispositivo sin nombre"
                } catch (_: SecurityException) {
                    "Dispositivo sin nombre"
                }
                val item = FoundBluetoothDevice(deviceName, device.address, result.rssi)
                if (item.address in dismissedAddresses) return
                val existing = devices.indexOfFirst { it.address == item.address }
                if (existing >= 0) devices[existing] = item else devices.add(item)
                status = "${devices.size} dispositivo(s) encontrado(s)"
            }

            override fun onScanFailed(errorCode: Int) {
                scanning = false
                scanRequested = false
                status = "No se pudo realizar la búsqueda"
            }
        }
    }

    fun startScan() {
        if (adapter == null) {
            status = "Este teléfono no dispone de Bluetooth"
            return
        }
        if (!adapter.isEnabled) {
            status = "Activa el Bluetooth del teléfono"
            return
        }
        if (!permissionsGranted()) {
            permissionLauncher.launch(
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
                    arrayOf(Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN, Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT)
                } else {
                    arrayOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)
                }
            )
            return
        }
        devices.clear()
        dismissedAddresses.clear()
        scanRequested = true
    }

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { startScan() }

    LaunchedEffect(scanRequested, permissionGranted) {
        if (scanRequested && permissionGranted) {
            try {
                adapter?.bluetoothLeScanner?.startScan(scanCallback)
                scanning = true
                status = "Buscando dispositivos cercanos…"
            } catch (_: SecurityException) {
                scanning = false
                scanRequested = false
                status = "Permiso Bluetooth necesario"
            }
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(scanning) {
        if (scanning) {
            delay(12000)
            try {
                adapter?.bluetoothLeScanner?.stopScan(scanCallback)
            } catch (_: SecurityException) {
            }
            scanning = false
            scanRequested = false
            status = if (devices.isEmpty()) "No se encontraron dispositivos" else "${devices.size} dispositivo(s) encontrado(s)"
        }
    }

    DisposableEffect(Unit) {
        onDispose {
            try {
                adapter?.bluetoothLeScanner?.stopScan(scanCallback)
            } catch (_: SecurityException) {
            }
        }
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)) {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(58.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Text(
                "‹",
                color = Cyan,
                fontSize = 40.sp,
                modifier = Modifier.width(50.dp).clickable { onBack() },
                textAlign = TextAlign.Center
            )
            Column(Modifier.weight(1f), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                Text(screenTitle, color = Text, fontSize = 21.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                val displayedStatus = if (bluetooth || connectionStatus.startsWith("Conectando")) connectionStatus else status
                Text(displayedStatus, color = if (bluetooth) Green else if (scanning) Cyan else Muted, fontSize = 10.sp, textAlign = TextAlign.Center)
            }
            Box(Modifier.width(50.dp))
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        Surface(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(52.dp).clickable(enabled = !scanning) { startScan() },
            color = if (scanning) Cyan.copy(alpha = .16f) else Panel,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (scanning) Cyan else Border),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
        ) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                if (scanning) {
                    CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.size(22.dp), color = Cyan, strokeWidth = 2.dp)
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    Text("BUSCANDO…", color = Cyan, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                } else {
                    Text("BUSCAR DISPOSITIVOS", color = Cyan, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        }

        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        Column(Modifier.weight(1f).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
            // Orden estable: los BMS reconocibles aparecen primero y el RSSI no
            // reorganiza la lista mientras la persona intenta pulsar un dispositivo.
            devices.sortedWith(
                compareBy<FoundBluetoothDevice> {
                    val name = it.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                    val preferred = preferredKeywords.any(name::contains)
                    if (preferred) 0 else 1
                }
            ).forEach { device ->
                val isConnected = connectedAddress == device.address
                val isConnecting = !isConnected && targetAddress == device.address && connectionStatus.startsWith("Conectando")
                var dragOffset by remember(device.address) { mutableStateOf(0f) }
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .padding(vertical = 4.dp)
                        .background(Red.copy(alpha = .88f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                ) {
                    Row(
                        Modifier
                            .align(Alignment.CenterEnd)
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .width(108.dp)
                            .clickable {
                                dismissedAddresses.add(device.address)
                                devices.removeAll { it.address == device.address }
                                status = if (devices.isEmpty()) "Lista vacía" else "${devices.size} dispositivo(s) encontrado(s)"
                            }
                            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
                    ) {
                        Text("⌫", color = Color.White, fontSize = 23.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(5.dp))
                        Text("ELIMINAR", color = Color.White, fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black)
                    }
                    Surface(
                        Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .offset { IntOffset(dragOffset.roundToInt(), 0) }
                            .pointerInput(device.address) {
                                detectHorizontalDragGestures(
                                    onHorizontalDrag = { _, amount ->
                                        dragOffset = (dragOffset + amount).coerceIn(-deleteRevealPx * 1.15f, 0f)
                                    },
                                    onDragCancel = { dragOffset = 0f },
                                    onDragEnd = {
                                        dragOffset = if (dragOffset <= -deleteRevealPx * .35f) {
                                            -deleteRevealPx
                                        } else {
                                            0f
                                        }
                                    }
                                )
                            }
                            .clickable(enabled = !isConnecting && dragOffset == 0f) {
                                try {
                                    adapter?.bluetoothLeScanner?.stopScan(scanCallback)
                                } catch (_: SecurityException) {
                                }
                                scanning = false
                                scanRequested = false
                                onConnect(device)
                            },
                        color = if (isConnected) Color(0xFF071D23) else Panel,
                        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (isConnected) Green else if (isConnecting) Cyan else Border),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
                    ) {
                        Row(
                            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(14.dp),
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            BluetoothStatusIcon(true, Modifier.size(38.dp))
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(12.dp))
                            Column(Modifier.weight(1f).padding(end = 10.dp)) {
                                Text(device.name, color = Text, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, maxLines = 1)
                                Text(device.address, color = Muted, fontSize = 11.sp, maxLines = 1)
                            }
                            Box(
                                Modifier.width(112.dp),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterEnd
                            ) {
                                Column(
                                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        when {
                                            isConnected -> "CONECTADO"
                                            isConnecting -> "CONECTANDO…"
                                            else -> "${device.rssi} dBm"
                                        },
                                        color = if (isConnected) Green else Cyan,
                                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                                        maxLines = 1
                                    )
                                    Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                                    BluetoothSignalBars(device.rssi)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BluetoothSignalBars(rssi: Int) {
    val activeBars = when {
        rssi >= -55 -> 4
        rssi >= -67 -> 3
        rssi >= -78 -> 2
        else -> 1
    }
    val activeColor = when (activeBars) {
        4 -> Green
        3 -> Cyan
        2 -> Yellow
        else -> Red
    }
    Row(
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom,
        modifier = Modifier.height(18.dp)
    ) {
        repeat(4) { index ->
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .width(4.dp)
                    .height((6 + index * 3).dp)
                    .background(
                        if (index < activeBars) activeColor else Muted.copy(alpha = .20f),
                        RoundedCornerShape(1.dp)
                    )
            )
        }
    }
}
